BakedPoteitr.d: Neither boiled nor mashed nor in a stew. Still delicious though! Baked Poteitr is a Deep North eitr food, made by baking Unbaked Poteitr in a stone oven. It restores 34 health and 17 stamina and grants 100 eitr over 25 minutes at 5 health regeneration. Baking actually costs it a little of each: the unbaked stage carries 37 health, 19 stamina and 110 eitr on the same 25 minute timer. It stacks to 10. Food Health 34 Stamina 17 Eitr 100 Regen 5 hp/tick Duration 25 min

TrophyBarka.d: The frozen head of a once-living tree. Barka Trophy is the trophy dropped by Barka in the Deep North, on roughly one kill in ten, where the Frozen Branch the same creature carries drops every time. It weighs 2, stacks to 20 and can be carried through a portal. It mounts on an item stand, and swung by hand it counts as an improvised club for 10 blunt.

Upgrader5Weapon.d: This mysterious idol is brimming with the potential of the gods. It could grant a powerful boon, or demand a great sacrifice. Black Marble Battle Idol is the tier 5 upgrade material for weapons, called for by 16 recipes and spent once at craft time plus once more for every quality level above 1. It rolls at 2.82% from Dvergr treasure chests in the ruined Mistlands guard towers, and again from Ashlands morgen holes and charred fortresses. Weapons above this tier call for the Flametal Battle Idol instead.

Upgrader5Armor.d: This mysterious idol is brimming with the potential of the gods. It could grant a powerful boon, or demand a great sacrifice. Black Marble Protection Idol is the tier 5 upgrade material for armour, called for by 10 recipes and spent once at craft time plus once more for every quality level above 1. At 5.65% a roll on the Dvergr tower table it is the most common idol in the game, out of the treasure chests in ruined Mistlands guard towers, with the Ashlands morgen holes, charred fortresses and Plains chests adding to it. Armour above this tier calls for the Flametal Protection Idol instead.

Upgrader4Weapon.d: This mysterious idol is brimming with the potential of the gods. It could grant a powerful boon, or demand a great sacrifice. Black Metal Battle Idol is the tier 4 upgrade material for weapons, called for by 12 recipes and spent once at craft time plus once more for every quality level above 1. It rolls at 1.36% on Hildir's Plains chest table, half the rate of the armour idol from the same chests, and shares the goblin trash piles in Fuling towers as a second, non-chest source. Weapons above this tier call for the Black Marble Battle Idol instead.

Upgrader4Armor.d: This mysterious idol is brimming with the potential of the gods. It could grant a powerful boon, or demand a great sacrifice. Black Metal Protection Idol is the tier 4 upgrade material for armour, called for by 13 recipes and spent once at craft time plus once more for every quality level above 1. It rolls at 2.72% on Hildir's Plains chest table, and also comes from Plains ruins and stone houses, Fuling towers, Mountain caves and log cabins. This is the one tier that also drops from a destructible rather than a chest, the goblin trash piles inside Fuling towers. Armour above this tier calls fo

BombBlob_Morkhalla.d: Swamp tier One Handed Weapon Blob Bomb: Pulp A dungeon is where the blob is. Blob Bomb: Pulp is a throwable bomb crafted at the Workbench from one Corked Vial , one Pulp Trophy and three Dead Pulp . The trophy is the bottleneck, a 10 percent drop from Shapeless Pulp , and one craft yields a single bomb. Throwing costs 8 stamina and consumes the item, and the impact itself carries only 5 blunt. Bombs stack to 50 at 0.3 weight each.

ArrowBloodGold.d: An arrow forged of perhaps the hardest materials in this world... Bloodgold Arrow is an arrow crafted at the Black Forge 20 at a time from 1 Bloodgold , 2 Feathers and 8 Timberwood . Each arrow deals 100 pierce, the highest damage of any arrow in the game. All of it is pierce, with no elemental half for a resistant enemy to shrug off the way one does against a Frost Arrow .

TurretBoltBloodgold.d: Your attacker shall stand no chance as this missile finds its target. Bloodgold Missile is ballista ammunition milled at the Artisan Table from 10 Timberwood and one Bloodgold . Each missile hits for 200 pierce, weighs 0.5 and stacks to 100. It cannot be equipped or fired by hand: it goes into a ballista's ammunition slot, and the turret picks its own targets from there.

AncientCoin.d: A relic of a lost age. Its surface still bears the trace of mysterious symbols. Ancient Coin is a Deep North material dropped one or two at a time by Captive Fuling and stored 11 to 55 at a time in the Ancient Chests and Jotun's Chests of Morkhalla. Breaking the rubble piles around the ruined city turns up more. Each coin carries a value of 10, and Morkhalla is the only place in the world they occur.

Gold.d: Precious metal, infused with the essence of a living thing. Bloodgold is a Deep North metal smelted from Petrified Tissue in a blast furnace. It runs through almost every Deep North recipe: 20 for a Nord weapon, another 20 for either essence upgrade, 15 for a round shield, 12 per Vanguard armour piece, 5 for a trinket or the Crown of Valheim and 1 per arrow or bolt. Like other metals it cannot pass through a portal, and at 14 weight with a 30 stack one full stack is 420 units of carry weight.

Upgrader1Armor.d: This mysterious idol is brimming with the potential of the gods. It could grant a powerful boon, or demand a great sacrifice. Bronze Protection Idol is the tier 1 upgrade material for armour, called for by 14 recipes and spent once at craft time plus once more for every quality level above 1. It is chest loot only, at 2.29% a roll on the Black Forest table from ruins, stone houses and Burial Chambers, with thinner odds in Meadows houses, ship settings and troll caves. Armour above this tier calls for the Iron Protection Idol instead.

Upgrader7Weapon.d: This mysterious idol is brimming with the potential of the gods. It could grant a powerful boon, or demand a great sacrifice. Bloodgold Battle Idol is the tier 7 upgrade material for weapons, called for by 36 recipes, the largest of any weapon idol, and spent once at craft time plus once more for every quality level above 1. At 0.20% a roll on the Mörkhalla table it is also the rarest, and it appears only in Mörkhalla's Ancient Chests and Jotun's Chests, the ship settings and the Deep North shipwrecks. Tier 7 is the ceiling, so the whole Nord weapon line, its upgrades included, is paced by thi

BoltBloodGold.d: A bolt forged of perhaps the hardest materials in this world... Bloodgold Bolt is crossbow ammunition crafted 20 at a time at the Black Forge from 1 Bloodgold , 8 Timberwood and 2 Feathers . Each bolt carries 92 pierce and no secondary damage type, so nothing about the target's resistances changes what it does. One Bloodgold covers the whole batch, which makes a quiver far cheaper than the Nord Crossbow that fires it, and bolts stack to 100.

Catapult_Ammo_BloodGold.d: Hit 'em hard and hit 'em bloody. Bloodgold Payload is catapult ammunition crafted at the Black Forge from 2 Ice , 2 Bloodgold and 3 Proustite Powder , which yields five at a time. It hits for 20 blunt and loads into a catapult in place of the Grausten Payload . Each shot weighs 0.3, they stack to 50, and they can be carried through a portal.

Upgrader7Armor.d: This mysterious idol is brimming with the potential of the gods. It could grant a powerful boon, or demand a great sacrifice. Bloodgold Protection Idol is the tier 7 upgrade material for armour, called for by 11 recipes and spent once at craft time plus once more for every quality level above 1. It rolls at 0.36% on the Mörkhalla Ancient Chest table and comes from nowhere outside Mörkhalla and the Deep North: the Ancient Chests and Jotun's Chests there, the ship settings, and the Deep North shipwrecks. Tier 7 is the ceiling, so no idol replaces it at higher levels and every end-game armour set

CookedSealBlubber.d: A chewy meat, with an aftertaste of remorse. Cooked Seal Blubber is a Deep North food cooked from one Seal Blubber in an oven rather than on a cooking station. It restores 60 health and 20 stamina with 5 health regen, and lasts 20 minutes. That leaves it 20 health, 7 stamina and 2 regen behind Cooked Moose Meat over the same duration. Food Health 60 Stamina 20 Regen 5 hp/tick Duration 20 min

Upgrader1Weapon.d: This mysterious idol is brimming with the potential of the gods. It could grant a powerful boon, or demand a great sacrifice. Bronze Battle Idol is the tier 1 upgrade material for weapons, called for by 19 recipes and spent once at craft time plus once more for every quality level above 1. It is chest loot only, at 1.14% a roll on the Black Forest table, which is half the rate its armour counterpart rolls from the same ruins, Burial Chambers and troll caves. Weapons above this tier call for the Iron Battle Idol instead.

CapeDeepNorthMage.d: A strange magic is woven into this cape, making it both light and warm. Cape of the Caller is a shoulder item crafted at the Galdr table from 6 Seal Pelt , 2 Nornathread , 5 Bloodgold , 15 Refined Eitr and one Bloodgold Protection Idol . It gives 12 armour, 2 more with each upgrade to quality 4, on 1200 durability, the same defence as Moose Hide Cape . On top of that it adds 0.2 eitr regeneration, which stacks with the rest of the Caller set. It is resistant to frost.

CookedMooseMeat.d: This meat is lean yet full of flavour. Cooked Moose Meat is a Deep North food made by cooking Moose Meat on an iron cooking station. It restores 80 health and 27 stamina, with 7 health regen across 20 minutes. It is also the meat component of Northern Morning Fare . Food Health 80 Stamina 27 Regen 7 hp/tick Duration 20 min

CrownJewel.d: A strange power surges within this gem, unlike anything you've felt before. Crown Jewel is a material dropped by Kall Fimbulbringer when its final phase dies. Its only use is the Crown of Valheim , which takes one jewel and 5 Bloodgold at the Black Forge. That crown has a single quality level, so one jewel is everything the recipe will ever ask for.

Voidplasm.d: A restless essence of a once living thing... Ectoplasm is a material with no recipe, no drop source and no loot table entry anywhere in the game files, which leaves the console as the only way to hold one. It weighs 2, stacks to 50 and can be carried through a portal. Its one listed use is the Voidcaller , so it reads as unfinished content rather than something the world produces.

HelmetRootCrown.d: A painful, yet intricate headpiece. Crown of Roots is a helmet with no crafting recipe and no drop source in the game files, so it can only be found. It gives 1 armour on 800 durability and gains 2 per upgrade level, reaching 7 at quality 4. That is the same protection curve as the Straw Hat , which puts it among the costume pieces rather than the armour.

TrophyElaking.d: Mean little eyes stare back at you. Elaking Trophy is a trophy dropped at a 10% rate by Elaking , counting both the plain form and the lantern-bearing one. No recipe consumes it, so it is a display piece. Elaking appear in groups rather than as single spawns, so the 20 stack fills faster than it does for trophies on the same drop rate.

OozeMork.d: It's best not to think about what this consists of. Dead Pulp is a material dropped by Shapeless Pulp and by the Tiny Pulp blobs that split off when one dies. It weighs 0.5 and stacks to 50. It is the crafting material for Blob Bomb: Pulp .

FaderEmber.d: Every flying ember is a burning wish to repent. Embers is a material picked up in the Ashlands from the burning embers the Fader leaves drifting. It stacks to 50 at 0.5 weight each and can be carried through a portal. It builds the Ember Charge and the Snow Shovel , which puts a Deep North tool behind an Ashlands material.

AncientGemstoneBlack.d: A dark, opaque gem with a smooth and polished surface. Draumyx is a Deep North gemstone worth 175, the most valuable of the four and more than three times what Grimvarn fetches. It drops from Imprisoned Dvergr on roughly a one in ten roll, can be picked from the carved eyes of Morkhalla, and appears in Ancient Chests there and in the chests of Deep North shipwrecks. Stacks cap at 20, so a single full slot carries 3,500 in value.

TrophyMole.d: Getting slashed by these claws would be very unpleasant. Eyeless One Trophy is a trophy dropped at a 10% rate by the Eyeless One . Each Winding Tunnels holds a single Eyeless One, so at that rate the trophy takes about ten dungeons rather than ten kills of a common spawn. No recipe consumes it. It weighs 1.5 and stacks to 20.

StaffOrbofAhri.d: A chill that goes right through to the bone. Echo Spike is a two-handed blood magic staff crafted at the Galdr table from 10 Bloodgold , 4 Nornathread , one Frostfire Essence and one Bloodgold Battle Idol . A cast costs 25 eitr and sends out a slow projectile at 10 speed. The staff itself carries no damage values, so what it does comes from the projectile it spawns and the caster's Blood Magic skill. It holds 400 durability, blocks for 48, costs 5% movement speed and upgrades to quality 4. The Frostfire Essence it consumes is the same one a Frostfire melee upgrade wants.

Upgrader6Weapon.d: This mysterious idol is brimming with the potential of the gods. It could grant a powerful boon, or demand a great sacrifice. Flametal Battle Idol is the tier 6 upgrade material for weapons, called for by 29 recipes, more than double its armour counterpart, and spent once at craft time plus once more for every quality level above 1. It rolls at 1.87% on the Deep North village table, from hut and lumber camp chests, with the Ashlands charred fortresses, morgen holes, ship settings and Mörkhalla Ancient Chests as the other sources. Weapons above this tier call for the Bloodgold Battle Idol inste

Upgrader6Armor.d: This mysterious idol is brimming with the potential of the gods. It could grant a powerful boon, or demand a great sacrifice. Flametal Protection Idol is the tier 6 upgrade material for armour, called for by 13 recipes and spent once at craft time plus once more for every quality level above 1. It rolls at 2.15% on the Deep North timber hall table, from the huts and lumber camps there, and also turns up in Ashlands morgen holes and charred fortresses, Mistlands Dvergr towers, ship settings and the Ancient Chests of Mörkhalla. Armour above this tier calls for the Bloodgold Protection Idol inste

ElakingHairBundle.d: The fur is dense, coarse, and surprisingly clean. Elaking Hair Bundle is a material dropped by Elaking , 1 to 2 per kill. It goes into Vanguard armour: 8 bundles and 12 Bloodgold for the Chestpiece of the Vanguard , and 8 more for the Trousers of the Vanguard . The Hood of the Vanguard uses hides instead, so 16 bundles cover the whole set. Stacks hold 50.

BombDynamite.d: Trapped embers, ready to burst. Caution is advised. Ember Charge is a thrown explosive crafted at the workbench from 2 Seal Pelt and one Embers , which yields ten at a time. It costs 8 stamina to throw and leaves the hand at a tenth the speed of every other bomb, so it drops close and you need room to back away before it goes off. Each charge weighs 0.3 and they stack to 50.

FrostCore.d: Terribly cold to the touch, filled with frozen energy. Frostcore is a material dropped by Frysling and picked from frostcore hangers in mountain frost caves. The hangers do not grow back, so the Frysling drop is the only renewable supply. It stacks to 20 and weighs 1 each.

AxeGold_FrostFire.d: Burn it all to the ground, or freeze it in an eternal moment of destruction... Frostfire Axe is a one-handed axe made at the Black Forge from a finished Nord Axe , 20 Bloodgold , one Frostfire Essence and one Black Metal Battle Idol . The essence takes 32 slash off the base axe and returns 88 frost and 12 fire, leaving 144 slash, while chop stays at 90 so tree felling is untouched. It blocks for 66 and costs 5% movement speed, and upgrades add 10 slash, 3 chop and 3 of each element.

BowGold_FrostFire.d: Keep your head cool as you draw, and then let your fury loose with your arrows. Frostfire Bow is a bow made at the Black Forge from a finished Nord Bow , 20 Bloodgold , one Frostfire Essence and one Bloodgold Battle Idol . It fires for 68 pierce, 88 frost, 12 fire and 10 spirit, which is 32 pierce given up for 100 points of elemental damage, so more of each shot now rides on the target's frost resistance than on its armour. The 2.5 second full draw is unchanged, and upgrades add 8 pierce, 5 spirit and 3 of each element.

FishSoup.d: Swimming with flavour! Fish Soup is a Deep North food cooked at a level 7 Cauldron from 3 Raw Fish , 2 Kale and 2 Ice . It gives 105 eitr alongside 37 health and 18 stamina, with 5 health regen over 30 minutes. Every ingredient is fished, farmed or picked, so the supply is renewable without hunting anything. Food Health 37 Stamina 18 Eitr 105 Regen 5 hp/tick Duration 30 min

TrophyBlob_Frost.d: It's like a shard of ice, only...slimy? Frost Blob Trophy is the trophy dropped by the Frost Blob , the frozen variant of the ordinary blob, at about a 10% chance. It weighs 1, stacks to 20 and can be carried through a portal, so a full stack is 20 carry weight. It mounts on an item stand.

MaceGold_FrostFire.d: Are those sparks that fly as this weapon finds its impact, or are they shards of ice? Frostfire Mace is a one-handed mace made at the Black Forge by working one Frostfire Essence into a finished Nord Mace , with 20 Bloodgold and one Bloodgold Battle Idol . It deals 142 blunt, 88 frost and 12 fire, trading 28 blunt off the Nord Mace for 100 points of elemental damage. Blunt gains 10 a level while frost and fire gain 3 each, reaching 172, 97 and 21 at quality 4, and every level costs another essence. Frost is the bulk of that elemental half, which is the wrong element against most of what lives

AtgeirGold_FrostFire.d: Let the flames begin to devour, while the ice claims whatever remains. Frostfire Atgeir is a two-handed polearm made at the Black Forge from a finished Nord Atgeir , 20 Bloodgold , one Frostfire Essence and one Bloodgold Battle Idol . The essence trades 34 of the atgeir's pierce for elemental damage, leaving 148 pierce, 88 frost and 12 fire, so the same spin now has to get past two resistances instead of one. It blocks for 88 and costs 5% movement speed like the base weapon, and each upgrade adds 10 pierce with 3 fire and 3 frost.

CrossbowGold_FrostFire.d: If your enemies don't freeze as you take aim, they are sure to do so once they are hit. Frostfire Crossbow is a crossbow made at the Black Forge from a finished Nord Crossbow , 20 Bloodgold , one Frostfire Essence and one Bloodgold Battle Idol . The essence trades physical damage for elemental: pierce drops from 264 to 232, and 88 frost and 12 fire are added, with 180 chop unchanged. Splitting the damage across three types means three chances to hit a resistance instead of one. Reload is 3.5 seconds, movement costs 5%, and each quality level adds 8 pierce plus 3 frost and 3 fire, to 300 durabi

OrbFrostFire.d: Somehow both hot and cold to the touch. Frostfire Essence is a material dropped by Fallen Warriors at the North Memorial Place on 50% of kills, and nothing else in the game drops one. Spent at the Black Forge with a finished Nord weapon, 20 Bloodgold and a Bloodgold Battle Idol , it converts that weapon to its Frostfire version, adding 88 frost and 12 fire and taking roughly 30 physical damage away: the Nord Sword goes from 170 slash to 138. Twelve Nord weapons accept the conversion, and one essence also goes into the cast for Echo Spike .

KnifeGold_FrostFire.d: A cut from this blade stings like ice, then burns like the flame. Frostfire Dagger is a one-handed knife made at the Black Forge by working one Frostfire Essence into a finished Nord Dagger , with 20 Bloodgold and one Bloodgold Battle Idol . It deals 62 slash, 62 pierce, 88 frost and 10 fire, trading 13 off each physical type for 98 points of elemental damage. Slash and pierce gain 5 a level while fire and frost gain 3 each, reaching 77, 77, 97 and 19 at quality 4, and every level costs another essence. Frost carries most of that elemental load, which is the wrong half against the Deep North's

BattleaxeGold_FrostFire.d: Strike your foes with a frozen inferno! Frostfire Greataxe is a two-handed axe made at the Black Forge from a finished Nord Greataxe , 20 Bloodgold , one Frostfire Essence and one Bloodgold Battle Idol . The essence trades 34 slash for 88 frost and 12 fire, leaving 154 slash and the chop untouched at 40. Its secondary still sweeps at half damage for 11 stamina and 4 times stagger, so the conversion changes what it hurts rather than how it is swung. Upgrades add 10 slash, 2.5 chop and 3 of each element.

SwordGold_FrostFire.d: Flames dance along this blade, but are they hot or cold? Frostfire Sword is a one-handed sword made at the Black Forge from one Nord Sword , 20 Bloodgold , one Frostfire Essence and one Bloodgold Battle Idol . It deals 138 slash, 88 frost and 12 fire, blocks for 66 and has 400 durability, gaining 10 slash and 3 of each element a level. The conversion takes 32 slash off the Nord Sword and hands back 100 points of elemental damage split 88 frost to 12 fire, which is a gain against anything that does not resist frost. The primary is a three-swing chain with double damage on the last hit at 16 sta

FistGold_FrostFire.d: A slight risk of frostbite is inevitable. Frostfire Knucklechains is a two-handed fist weapon made at the Black Forge from a finished Nord Knucklechains , 20 Bloodgold , one Frostfire Essence and one Bloodgold Battle Idol . Blunt damage falls from 114 to 80 and 88 frost and 12 fire replace it, a 34 point cut for 100 points of elemental. The attacks are unchanged from the base weapon, a 14 stamina chain and a 20 stamina kick. Each quality level adds 8 damage plus 3 frost and 3 fire, to 400 durability at quality 4.

THSwordGold_FrostFire.d: The choice between a fiery end and a frozen one is simple: Both at the same time. Frostfire Greatsword is a two-handed sword made at the Black Forge from one Nord Greatsword , 20 Bloodgold , one Frostfire Essence and one Bloodgold Battle Idol . It deals 186 slash, 88 frost and 12 fire, blocks for 76 and has 400 durability, gaining 10 slash and 3 of each element a level. The conversion trades 24 slash for 100 points of elemental damage, where the Thunderblood Greatsword adds 10 slash and 45 lightning for the same essence slot. The primary is a three-swing chain with double damage on the last hi

AncientGemstoneGreen.d: A striking green gem, the colour reminiscent of deep forests. Grimvarn is a Deep North gemstone worth 55, the cheapest of the four and under a third of Draumyx . It comes off Imprisoned Dvergr , out of the carved eyes in Morkhalla, and out of Ancient Chests and Deep North shipwreck chests, on the same rolls as the other three. Even at the bottom of the set one is worth five and a half Ancient Coin .

SledgeGold_FrostFire.d: Is it so cold that it's burning, or so hot that it's freezing? Frostfire Sledge is a two-handed club made at the Black Forge by working a finished Nord Sledge together with 20 Bloodgold , one Frostfire Essence and one Bloodgold Battle Idol . It deals 200 blunt, 88 frost and 12 fire, trading 25 points of the base sledge's blunt for 100 points of elemental damage. The 28 stamina area swing and the 20% movement penalty are unchanged, and quality 4 brings it to 400 durability, gaining 10 blunt and 3 of each element a level. A sledge can take this conversion or the Thunderblood Sledge , never both.

SpearGold_FrostFire.d: Dipped in frozen flames, this spear spells certain doom. Frostfire Spear is a one-handed spear made at the Black Forge from one Nord Spear , 20 Bloodgold , one Frostfire Essence and one Bloodgold Battle Idol . It deals 148 pierce, 88 frost and 12 fire, blocks for 66, trains Spears and holds 400 durability over four quality levels, gaining 10 pierce and 3 of each element a level. The primary attack is a thrust with 1.9 meters of reach at 16 stamina; the secondary throws the spear itself for 1.5x damage at 18 stamina and leaves it on the ground to be picked up. Frost carries 88 of its 248 damage

Ice.d: So cold... Ice is a material dropped by frozen Greydwarves and Deep North Skeletons , and broken out of black ice shards and frozen corpses. It weighs 1, stacks to 50 and can be carried through a portal. It is a cooking ingredient rather than a building material, going into Fish Soup , Seal Meat Soup , Oat Milk and Lingonberry Juice .

BarkaBranch.d: This piece of wood was once animated and alive. Still a strange, magical air clings to it. Frozen Branch is a material dropped by every Barka and by nothing else. Two of them cast a Nord Greatsword and eight go into a Spirit Caller . At 0.5 weight and a stack of 50 a full stack costs 25 carry weight, so the crafting quantities are easy to bring home in one trip.

GrapplingHook.d: For a dramatic entrance, or a swift retreat. Grappling Hook is a movement tool crafted at the Black Forge from 10 Yggdrasil Wood , 10 Refined Eitr , 4 Mandible and one Hook . Each shot costs 15 stamina and flies at 40 units a second, with a 2 second reload on the primary and no reload on the secondary. It trains no skill and its 10 pierce damage is incidental, but it blocks for 21, seven times what the Nord Crossbow manages. There is one quality level and 300 durability.

HelmetDNMage.d: and one Bloodgold Protection Idol . It gives 22 armour and 0.4 eitr regeneration on 1000 durability, and each upgrade level adds 2 armour for 28 at quality 4. Every level wants another Moose Trophy as well, seven in all by quality 4, which makes the trophy the gating cost rather than the thread.

TrophyJotunWitch.d: Before her death, her eyes sparked with magic. Now they're empty and void. Hexen Trophy is a trophy dropped at a 10% rate by Hexen . Two recipes consume one each, the Witch Crown and Northern Vengeance , so building both takes two separate drops and around 20 kills on average. It stacks to 20.

Hook.d: A finely wrought item, with a gripping potential. Hook is a material found in Dvergr treasure chests in the ruined guard towers of the Mistlands. It weighs 5, stacks to 50 and can be carried through a portal. Its only use is the Grappling Hook .

Upgrader2Armor.d: This mysterious idol is brimming with the potential of the gods. It could grant a powerful boon, or demand a great sacrifice. Iron Protection Idol is the tier 2 upgrade material for armour, called for by 12 recipes and spent once at craft time plus once more for every quality level above 1. It drops at 1.09% a roll on the Swamp table, from the chests in Sunken Crypts, Swamp graves and ruins, and at lower odds from Black Forest ruins, Burial Chambers and troll caves. Armour above this tier calls for the Silver Protection Idol instead.

IceShoes.d: Ice Shoes is a utility item that is found rather than crafted, and it cannot be upgraded past quality 1. It sits in the utility slot, so it competes directly with Megingjord and Wishbone and only one of the three can be worn at a time. What it does is hold footing on the Deep North's ice, which is otherwise slippery enough to be a movement problem. It weighs 2 and does not stack.

Kale.d: A versatile leafy green. Kale is a consumable picked wild and farmed from Kale Seeds . Eaten raw it fills a food slot with 35 health and 35 stamina for 15 minutes at the baseline 1 health regeneration. Its main use is as an input: 12 kale make a batch of four Raw Kale Chips at the Cauldron, and it also goes into Seal Meat Soup and Smoked Fish . Food Health 35 Stamina 35 Regen 1 hp/tick Duration 15 min

KaleChips.d: Crispy greens! Kale Chips is a consumable baked in an oven from Raw Kale Chips . It gives 35 health and 105 stamina for 25 minutes at 5 health regeneration, the same food line as Lingonberry Juice but off a farmed crop rather than foraged berries and ice. The uncooked chips are listed at 39 health and 115 stamina over the same 25 minutes, so the oven step costs 4 health and 10 stamina and returns something that can actually be eaten. Food Health 35 Stamina 105 Regen 5 hp/tick Duration 25 min

KaleSeeds.d: Plant to grow kale. Kale Seeds is a material picked from wild seed plants and pulled out of the barrels in Deep North villages. Planted in cultivated ground they grow into Kale , worth 35 health and 35 stamina eaten raw and 12 to a batch of Raw Kale Chips . They stack to 100 at 0.1 weight each, so a whole season of planting fits in one slot.

TrophyJotunWarrior.d: Once a mighty warrior, now nought but a husk remains. Krigen Trophy is a trophy dropped at a 10% rate by Krigen , including the dual-wielding form. No recipe consumes it, unlike the Hexen Trophy taken from the other jotun, which two recipes call for. It weighs 2 and stacks to 20.

IceSkates.d: Ice Skates are a utility item found in the world rather than crafted; no recipe produces them. They weigh 2, do not stack and can be carried through a portal. Worn in the utility slot they let you glide across frozen water, which is the fastest way to cross the Deep North.

TrophyBlob_Lava.d: It's probably dead, right? Lava Blob Trophy is the trophy dropped by the Lava Blob in the Ashlands, at about a 10% chance. It weighs 1 and stacks to 20, the same as the Frost Blob Trophy taken from the cold variant, and it can be carried through a portal. It mounts on an item stand.

BloodGoldKey.d: If there's a key, then surely there must be a lock. Intricate Key is a key dropped by Hexen in the Deep North at roughly a 10 percent chance. It can also be cast from a Mould: Intricate Key , which is the route that does not depend on the roll. Each key is a single item at 0.1 weight that does not stack, so carrying several means several slots.

Leatherstraps.d: A sturdy yet flexible material. Leather Straps is a material dropped by Krigen , both the single and the dual-wielding variant, and it has no other source. Four recipes call for it, all of them body armour: Chestpiece of the Vanguard and the casts for the Protector and Vanguard bodies, at 4 straps a craft. It stacks to 50 at 0.5 weight, so a couple of kills cover the whole requirement.

Upgrader2Weapon.d: This mysterious idol is brimming with the potential of the gods. It could grant a powerful boon, or demand a great sacrifice. Iron Battle Idol is the tier 2 upgrade material for weapons, called for by 11 recipes and spent once at craft time plus once more for every quality level above 1. At 0.55% a roll on the Swamp table it is the rarest idol before the Bloodgold pair, so Sunken Crypt runs supply iron weapon upgrades more slowly than the iron itself. Weapons above this tier call for the Silver Battle Idol instead.

Lingonberry.d: These tart berries can grow even in cold climates. Lingonberries are a food picked from lingonberry bushes in the Black Forest and dropped by Captive Fulings . They give 35 health and 35 stamina over 15 minutes with 1 health regen, weigh 0.1 and stack to 50. They are the only food a Moose will take while it is being tamed. Food Health 35 Stamina 35 Regen 1 hp/tick Duration 15 min

FrozenFuel.d: Magic has infused this ice, turning it into something else entirely. Liquid Frost is a fuel material made in a frost kiln, filling the role coal fills for a smelter in the Deep North crafting chain. It stacks to 50 and weighs 2 a piece, and it can be carried through a portal, so it can be produced at home and shipped north rather than made on site.

MoleClaws.d: A lethal weapon, if one can hold them without getting cut. Long Claws are a material dropped by the Eyeless One , 1 to 2 per kill, and nothing else in the world drops them. One Eyeless One lives in each Winding Tunnels, so supply is capped by the number of those dungeons cleared. The Neckstabber takes 5 claws with 5 Bloodgold and a Moose Trophy at the Black Forge, and Cast: Nord Knucklechains takes 2 more.

GlowWorm.d: Slimy, yet satisfying. Luminous Larva is a raw food that is picked and eaten as it is, with no cooking step. It gives 30 health and 30 stamina with 1 health regen, matching Fiddlehead on both numbers. Its duration is 10 minutes, half of what a cooked meat runs for. Stacks hold 50 at 0.2 weight each. Food Health 30 Stamina 30 Regen 1 hp/tick Duration 10 min

StaffThunderBlood.d: Simply point, and you shall summon the wrath of the sky. Lightning Strike is a two-handed elemental staff crafted at the Galdr table from 10 Bloodgold , 5 Nornathread , one Thunderblood Essence and one Bloodgold Battle Idol . A cast costs 40 eitr and fires a bolt at 30 speed for 300 lightning, rising 20 a quality level to 360 at quality 4. It holds 400 durability, blocks for 48, trains Elemental Magic and has no secondary attack. Carrying it costs 5% movement speed.

Lingondricka.d: Pairs well with most foods. Lingonberry Juice is a consumable brewed at the Cauldron from 5 Lingonberries and 5 Ice , one bottle per craft. It gives 35 health and 105 stamina for 25 minutes at 5 health regeneration, the same food line as Kale Chips . The ice is the awkward half of the recipe, since lingonberries grow in the Black Forest while ice has to be cut out of the frozen biomes. Food Health 35 Stamina 105 Regen 5 hp/tick Duration 25 min

MoldSmallParts.d: Mold Small Parts is a casting mould the game data leaves unfinished: it has no drop source, no recipe and no item description, and its name is untranslated where every other mould is named for the piece it casts. The cast it pairs with, Small Parts Gold Uncooked , is untranslated in the same way. Like the other moulds it weighs 1 and stacks to 10.

HelmetLox.d: See the world like a lox might. Lox Fur Hood is a helmet crafted at the Workbench from 4 Lox Pelt , 4 Bone Fragments , 2 Writhan Roots and one Black Metal Protection Idol . It gives 16 armour, rising 2 per level to 22 at quality 4, on 500 durability. Reaching quality 4 costs 16 lox pelts, 16 bone fragments and 8 writhan roots in total.

ArmorLoxChest.d: A heavy musk still clings to it. Lox Fur Jacket is a chest armour piece crafted at a level 2 Workbench from 5 Lox Pelt , 8 Bone Fragments , 2 Root and one Black Metal Protection Idol . It gives 16 armour, 2 more per quality level to 22 at quality 4, on 500 durability, half what the Deep North and Ashlands sets carry. It pairs with Lox Fur Trousers and the Lox Fur Hood .

MooseHide.d: This fur is perfectly adapted to northern climates. Moose Hide is a material dropped by the Moose , 2 to 3 per kill, and pulled from the bedrolls of Mörkhalla. Every Deep North armour line runs on it: 6 for the Moose Hide Cape , 6 each for the Robes of the Caller and its trousers, 5 for the Hood of the Vanguard , and 4 to 8 a piece for the Protector casts. Every upgrade level costs another 3 on top of that.

ArmorLoxLegs.d: Soft, silent and flexible. Lox Fur Trousers is a leg armour piece crafted at a level 2 Workbench from 5 Lox Pelt , 8 Bone Fragments , 2 Root and one Black Metal Protection Idol , an identical bill to the Lox Fur Jacket . It gives 16 armour, 2 more per quality level to 22 at quality 4, on 500 durability. The two pieces together are 32 armour for 10 Lox Pelt and 16 Bone Fragments, and neither costs any movement speed.

MooseKebab.d: A convenient meal, often favoured by travelling merchants. Meat In Bread is a Deep North food cooked at a level 7 cauldron from one Moose Meat , two Kale , one Oat Flour and two Lingonberries , and one craft makes two servings. Each gives 110 health, 37 stamina and 7 health regeneration over 30 minutes. Only the moose meat has to be hunted; the kale and oats are farmed and the lingonberries are picked. Food Health 110 Stamina 37 Regen 7 hp/tick Duration 30 min

MooseMeat.d: This meat is sure to provide a hearty meal once cooked. Moose Meat is the raw meat dropped by a Moose , 4 to 6 per kill. Eaten raw it gives 35 health and 12 stamina for 20 minutes at 2 regeneration, and cooked on an iron cooking station it becomes Cooked Moose Meat at 80 health and 7 regeneration. Four cauldron recipes take one apiece: Smoked Moose Meat , Meat In Bread , Meatballs and Poteitr and Oven Pancake Batter . Food Health 35 Stamina 12 Regen 2 hp/tick Duration 20 min

HatefulBlood.d: There's something unsettling about this clotted, frozen mass. Malicious Blood is a material broken out of black ice cores in the Deep North. It weighs 1, stacks to 50 and can be carried through a portal. Three are needed to summon Kall Fimbulbringer , and the cores only appear during a live Jotun invasion, which is the real gate on the endgame.

MeatballsMashedPoteitr.d: It doesn't get more iconic than this! Meatballs and Poteitr is a Deep North eitr food cooked at a level 7 cauldron from one Moose Meat , two Lingonberries and two Poteitr , one serving per craft. It gives 105 eitr, 35 health and 18 stamina for 25 minutes at 5 health regeneration. Fish Soup and Oven Pancake match that 105 eitr and last 30 minutes; this one is five minutes shorter and the only one of the three that needs neither fish nor an oven stage. Food Health 35 Stamina 18 Eitr 105 Regen 5 hp/tick Duration 25 min

SaddleMoose.d: A moose is a noble creature, but with a saddle this fine it might just allow a rider. Moose Saddle is a riding item crafted at the Black Forge from 4 Bloodgold , 5 Seal Pelt , 5 Timberwood and 15 Linen Thread . It attaches to a tamed Moose and fits nothing else. Three of its four ingredients are Deep North materials, which puts it a tier above the Asksvin Saddle in what it takes to build.

MemorialCoal.d: Somewhere deep within the hot, hazy glow, you can almost see an old memory play out... Memorial Coal is a material dropped by Krigen and broken out of the memorial coal piles and firepits of Mörkhalla. Nothing consumes it: no recipe, station or trader in the game accepts a single piece. At 2 weight each and 50 to a stack, a full stack is 100 weight carried for nothing.

TrophyMoose.d: The mighty ruler of the northern forests. Moose Trophy is a trophy dropped at a 10% rate by the Moose . Three recipes consume one each, the Headdress of the Caller , the Neckstabber and the Spirit Caller , so all three together need three drops. It weighs 2 and stacks to 20.

The mould comes from chests at the North Memorial Place, Mörkhalla weapon stands and the spawners and trash piles of the Winding Tunnels.

MooseSinew.d: Tough and hardy, this is sure to come in handy. Moose Sinew is a material dropped by the Moose , 2 to 3 per kill alongside the hide and the meat. Three items need it and none need much: 2 for the Headdress of the Caller , 2 for the Moose Hide Cape and 1 for the Hood of the Vanguard . Each upgrade level costs another 1 or 2, which is where a shortfall usually shows up.

AtgeirGold.d: The edge of this weapon is as deadly as it is shiny. Nord Atgeir is a two-handed polearm forged at the Black Forge from 20 Bloodgold , 10 Timberwood , one Mould: Nord Atgeir and one Bronze Battle Idol . It deals 182 pierce, blocks for 88 and trains Polearms. The primary attack is a three-thrust chain reaching 3.2 metres at 20 stamina a thrust, with double damage on the last hit; the secondary is a 360 degree spin for 40 stamina that multiplies knockback by 5 and stagger by 6. Wielding it costs 5% movement speed, and the three upgrades to quality 4 add 10 pierce each, on 400 durability.

AxeGold.d: A finely detailed axe, for finely cutting down your enemies. Nord Axe is a one-handed axe forged at the Black Forge from 20 Bloodgold , 10 Timberwood , one Mould: Nord Axe and one Black Metal Battle Idol . It deals 176 slash and 90 chop, blocks for 66 and trains Axes. Its tool tier of 6 is high enough to fell any tree in the game, so it works as a felling axe as well as a weapon. The primary is a three-swing chain at 16 stamina with double damage on the last hit; the secondary is an overhead chop for 1.5 times damage at 28 stamina. Upgrades to quality 4 add 10 slash and 3 chop each, on 400 dur

BowGold.d: This bow shall find its target with a golden precision. Nord Bow is a bow forged at the Black Forge from 20 Bloodgold , 10 Timberwood , one Mould: Nord Bow and one Bloodgold Battle Idol . It adds 100 pierce and 10 spirit to whatever arrow it fires, and it trains Bows. Reaching a full draw takes 2.5 seconds. Its spirit damage climbs 12 a level against 8 for pierce, so a quality 4 bow carries 46 spirit, well past what either essence version keeps.

ShieldGoldBuckler.d: An effective method of protection, with sufficient skill. Nord Buckler is a buckler forged at the Black Forge from 10 Bloodgold , 10 Timberwood , one Mould: Nord Buckler and one Bloodgold Protection Idol . It blocks for 88, trains Blocking and costs 5% movement speed, and at 4 weight it is the lightest of the three Nord shields. It has no bash damage, where the round and tower versions each deal 10, and like the round shield it parries. It upgrades to quality 3 at 5 bloodgold and 5 timberwood a level, reaching 400 durability.

CrossbowGold.d: An incredible force is bound to this weapon, waiting to be unleashed. Nord Crossbow is a crossbow forged at the Black Forge from 20 Bloodgold , 10 Timberwood , one Mould: Nord Crossbow and one Bloodgold Battle Idol . It fires for 264 pierce and 180 chop, blocks for 3, trains Crossbows and triples backstab damage. Every shot needs a 3.5 second reload, and carrying it costs 5% movement speed. It upgrades to quality 4, adding 8 pierce a level and reaching 300 durability.

KnifeGold.d: A flash of gold is the last thing your foes will ever see. Nord Dagger is a one-handed knife forged at the Black Forge from 20 Bloodgold , 10 Timberwood , one Mould: Nord Dagger and one Bloodgold Battle Idol . It deals 75 slash and 75 pierce, an even split that no single resistance covers, and trains Knives. The primary is a three-hit chain at 14 stamina a swing, the secondary stabs for triple damage at 42, and a backstab on an unaware target multiplies by 6. It reaches quality 4 at 5 of each damage type per level, 90 and 90 on 400 durability, for a further 60 bloodgold and 30 timberwood.

BattleaxeGold.d: A mighty axe fit for a mighty warrior. Nord Greataxe is a two-handed axe forged at the Black Forge from 20 Bloodgold , 10 Timberwood , one Mould: Nord Greataxe and one Bloodgold Battle Idol . It deals 188 slash and 40 chop, blocks for 76, and trains Axes. The primary attack is a three-swing chain with double damage on the last hit at 22 stamina a swing; the secondary sweeps for half damage at 11 stamina and multiplies stagger by 4. Wielding it costs 20% movement speed. It upgrades to quality 4, reaching 400 durability.

The Long Claws come off the Eyeless One down in the Winding Tunnels, and the Moose Trophy is the same drop the Spirit Caller recipe wants. It is the health half of the Bloodgold pair, with the Witch Crown built on the same 5 Bloodgold for stamina instead.

MaceGold.d: Hit hard and fast, and leave your foe no time to recover. Nord Mace is a one-handed mace forged at the Black Forge from 20 Bloodgold , 10 Timberwood , one Mould: Nord Mace and one Bloodgold Battle Idol . It deals 170 blunt, blocks for 66, costs 5% movement speed and trains Clubs. The primary attack is a three-swing chain with double damage on the last hit at 16 stamina a swing; the secondary is an overhead for 2.5 times damage at 28 stamina, with double force and double stagger. It reaches quality 4 at 10 blunt a level, 200 on 400 durability, for a further 60 bloodgold and 30 timberwood.

ShieldGold.d: Stay safe, and do so in style. Nord Shield is a round shield forged at the Black Forge from 15 Bloodgold , 10 Timberwood , one Mould: Nord Shield and one Bloodgold Protection Idol . It blocks for 132, bashes for 10 blunt and trains Blocking, and carrying it costs 5% movement speed. Being a round shield it parries, unlike the Nord Greatshield , which blocks harder but cannot. It upgrades to quality 3 at 8 bloodgold and 5 timberwood a level, reaching 400 durability.

SledgeGold.d: With this weapon, your blows will be heavy as that of a troll. Nord Sledge is a two-handed club forged at the Black Forge from 20 Bloodgold , 10 Timberwood , one Mould: Nord Sledge and one Bloodgold Battle Idol . It deals 225 blunt, blocks for 52 and trains Clubs. Its only attack is an area swing that hits everything within 2 metres across a 90 degree arc for 28 stamina, at double the usual stagger. Wielding it costs 20% movement speed, and it upgrades to quality 4 at 10 bloodgold and 5 timberwood a level, reaching 400 durability and 255 blunt.

SpearGold.d: A golden opportunity to strike. Nord Spear is a one-handed spear forged at the Black Forge from 20 Bloodgold , 10 Timberwood , one Mould: Nord Spear and one Bloodgold Battle Idol . It deals 170 pierce, blocks for 66 and trains Spears. The primary is a 1.9 metre thrust through a narrow 40 degree arc for 16 stamina; the secondary throws the spear for 1.5 times damage at 18 stamina, and the weapon leaves your hands until you pick it up again. It costs 5% movement speed and upgrades to quality 4 at 10 bloodgold and 5 timberwood a level, reaching 400 durability and 200 pierce.

ShieldGoldTower.d: Your foes can't hit you if they can't see you! Nord Greatshield is a tower shield forged at the Black Forge from 20 Bloodgold , 20 Timberwood , one Mould: Nord Greatshield and one Bloodgold Protection Idol . It blocks for 158, the highest block power of any shield, bashes for 10 and costs 10% movement speed, double the penalty of the Nord Shield . Tower shields do not parry, so the block value is the whole of what it offers, and its backstab bonus drops to 1 against the round shield's 4. It upgrades to quality 3 at 10 bloodgold and 10 timberwood a level, reaching 400 durability.

It deals 170 slash, blocks for 66, trains Swords and has 400 durability, gaining 10 slash a level to reach 200 at quality 4. The primary is a three-swing chain with double damage on the last hit at 16 stamina a swing and 2.4m of reach; the secondary is a lunging thrust for triple damage at 28. THSwordGold.d: A striking weapon, both visually and lethally. Nord Greatsword is a two-handed sword cast at the Black Forge from 20 Bloodgold , 2 Frozen Branch , one Mould: Nord Greatsword and one Bloodgold Battle Idol . It deals 210 slash, blocks for 76, trains Swords and has 400 durability, gaining 10 slash a level to reach 240 at quality 4. The primary is a three-swing chain with double damage on the last hit at 20 stamina a swing and 2.6m of reach; the secondary sweeps for triple damage at 40 stamina and 3m. Feeding it a Thunderblood Essence or a Frostfire Essence converts it into the Thunderblood Greats

OatFlour.d: Finely ground oats, with plenty of potential. Oat Flour is a milling product ground from Oats at a windmill rather than made in a cauldron. It weighs 0.2 and stacks to 50. It is an ingredient in oven-baked foods including Meat In Bread and Pancakes .

OatMilk.d: Tastes like innovation. Oat Milk is a Deep North food mixed at the mead ketill from five Oats and five Ice , one per craft. It carries 110 stamina with 37 health and 5 regeneration over 25 minutes. It is also an ingredient in its own right: one goes into a bowl of Oatmeal , and one into a batch of Pancakes , which is three servings from the single bottle. Food Health 37 Stamina 110 Regen 5 hp/tick Duration 25 min

OatSeeds.d: Grind them to oats in the mill, or plant to grow more seeds. Oat Seeds are a Deep North crop seed, picked from wild oat plants and pulled from the barrels of northern villages, where they come up on 41.7% of rolls at 4 to 10 seeds a time. Planting one grows more seed; milling them in a windmill turns them into Oats , which is the only way to get the grain. They stack to 100 rather than the usual 50, so a whole harvest travels in one slot.

OatmealLingonberryJam.d: Served with a generous helping of lingonberry jam. Oatmeal is a Deep North food cooked at a cauldron from two Oats , two Lingonberries and one Oat Milk , one bowl per craft. It gives 115 stamina and 85 eitr together, with 39 health and 5 regeneration, over 30 minutes. Every other eitr dish sits near 18 stamina, so this is the one that fills the eitr slot without surrendering the stamina that would otherwise go with it. Food Health 39 Stamina 115 Eitr 85 Regen 5 hp/tick Duration 30 min

NornThread.d: Don't let the delicate strands fool you. These threads are spun from the power of the world tree itself. Nornathread is a material dropped by Hexen , 1 to 3 per kill, with no other source in the world. Nine recipes need it, which is the entire Deep North magic line: 5 each for the Robes of the Caller , its trousers, the Witch Crown and three of the four staves, 4 for Echo Spike , 3 for the Headdress of the Caller and 2 for the Cape of the Caller . Upgrades add another 2 or 3 per level, so a full mage kit is measured in Hexen kills.

FeastDeepNorth.d: Northern Morning Fare is a Deep North feast, assembled at a food preparation table from cooked northern ingredients including Cooked Moose Meat . It gives 85 health, 85 stamina and 43 eitr at once, with 7 health regen, and runs for 50 minutes. A feast does nothing in the inventory: it has to be set down with a Serving Tray before anyone can eat from it. It does not stack, so each one costs a full inventory slot. Food Health 85 Stamina 85 Eitr 43 Regen 7 hp/tick Duration 50 min

StaffFrostOrbs.d: A caged snowflake, endless patterns emerging from within... Northern Vengeance is a two-handed blood magic staff crafted at the Galdr table from 10 Ice , 5 Nornathread , one Hexen Trophy and one Bloodgold Battle Idol . Each cast throws a frost orb at 100 eitr and 40% of the caster's current health, the same price Dead Raiser charges for a skeleton. The staff carries no damage values of its own, so what the orb does comes from the projectile and the caster's Blood Magic skill. It holds 400 durability, blocks for 48, upgrades to quality 4 and costs 5% movement speed to carry.

Poteitr.d: The possibilities are practically endless. Who wouldn't want a taste? Poteitr is a root vegetable picked from wild poteitr plants and grown from Seed Poteitr . Raw it gives 35 health, 35 stamina and 35 eitr for 15 minutes, with 1 health regeneration. It is also a cooking ingredient, taking 2 per batch of Oven Pancake Batter and 1 per Smoked Fish . Food Health 35 Stamina 35 Eitr 35 Regen 1 hp/tick Duration 15 min

PulledBear.d: Tender meat cooked for hours upon hours, until it practically falls apart. Pulled Bear is a consumable food cooked at a Cauldron from 1 Cooked Bear Meat , 2 Carrot and 1 Blueberries . It gives 37 health and 16 stamina for 30 minutes, with 3 health regeneration. The bear meat has to be cooked on a station beforehand, so the dish needs a cooking station as well as the cauldron. Food Health 37 Stamina 16 Regen 3 hp/tick Duration 30 min

Oat.d: Tasty grains, to be used as they are or to be ground into flour. Oats are a Deep North grain ground from Oat Seeds in a windmill. Eaten raw they give 33 health and 33 stamina at 3 regeneration, and the 30 minute timer is unusual for an unprepared food, where 15 minutes is the norm. Milling them a second time produces Oat Flour , and five oats with five Ice make one Oat Milk at the mead ketill. A bowl of Oatmeal then takes two oats and one of that milk. Food Health 33 Stamina 33 Regen 3 hp/tick Duration 30 min

TrophyBlob_Morkhalla.d: Remains of unfortunate adventurers, digested and jellified over time. Pulp Trophy is a trophy dropped by the Shapeless Pulp of Mörkhalla at a 10% rate. It is the only ingredient in Blob Bomb: Pulp , so each bomb costs one trophy and nothing else. At 1 weight it is lighter than the other Deep North trophies, and it stacks to 20.

OvenPancake.d: Warm and fluffy. Oven Pancake is a Deep North food baked from Oven Pancake Batter in a stone oven. It gives 37 health, 18 stamina and 105 eitr for 30 minutes, with 5 health regeneration. Baking is what produces the eitr, since the same batter eaten raw carries 115 stamina and none at all. Food Health 37 Stamina 18 Eitr 105 Regen 5 hp/tick Duration 30 min

Pancakes.d: Was there ever a more comforting food? Pancakes are a consumable food cooked at a Cauldron from 1 Oat Milk , 2 Oat Flour , 2 Egg and 2 Blueberries , three servings to a craft. Each one gives 39 health and 115 stamina for 30 minutes, with 5 health regeneration. The eggs tie the recipe to keeping chickens rather than to any northern material, and the 30 minute timer runs 5 minutes longer than the otherwise identical Oven Pancake Batter . Food Health 39 Stamina 115 Regen 5 hp/tick Duration 30 min

GoldOre.d: A hard and sturdy material with plenty of potential. Needs to be refined in a Blast Furnace. Petrified Tissue is an ore mined from the petrified Gammeltroll remains found in the Deep North. It weighs 14 a piece, stacks to 30, and like other ores it cannot be carried through a portal. A Blast Furnace burning Coal refines it into Bloodgold ; a Smelter will not accept it, so the metal cannot be worked until Ashlands-tier infrastructure is standing.

SealBlubber.d: The insulating fat of a creature adapted to the northern waters. Seal Blubber is a raw food dropped by Seals and Baby Seals . Straight off the kill it gives 80 health and 27 stamina for 20 minutes with 7 health regeneration, with no cooking step involved. Two pieces, with kale and ice, make Seal Meat Soup at a cauldron. It stacks to 20 at 1 weight, so a hunt fills carrying space faster than the pelts from the same animals do. Food Health 80 Stamina 27 Regen 7 hp/tick Duration 20 min

SealHide.d: The thick fur helps the animal stay both warm and dry. Seal Pelt is a crafting material dropped by Seals in the Deep North. The Moose Saddle takes 5 of them, and they also go into the Cape of the Caller and the Ember Charge . At 0.5 weight and a stack of 50, pelts travel home far more easily than the Seal Blubber off the same carcass, which is twice the weight in stacks of 20.

TrophySeal.d: This animal never did any harm, yet it met an untimely end. Seal Trophy is a trophy dropped at a 10% rate by the Seal , which has no attack of its own and does not fight back. No recipe consumes it. It weighs 2 and stacks to 20.

SpiceDeepNorth.d: Using cinnamon bark and ginger root, with a touch of nutmeg, the herbalist has travelled far to create this fine and warming blend of spices. Seasoning of the Gourd is a cooking material blended from cinnamon bark, ginger root and nutmeg. It has no recipe and no drop source recorded in the game files, and it feeds exactly one dish, Northern Morning Fare . 1 each, so a full stack costs 10 weight.

PoteitrSeeds.d: Plant to grow poteitr. Seed Poteitr is a planting material taken from wild poteitr plants and from barrels in northern villages. Each seed grows one Poteitr , which is eaten raw for 35 health, 35 stamina and 35 eitr or cooked into Oven Pancake Batter and Smoked Fish . Seeds weigh 0.1 and stack to 100, so an entire planting season fits in one inventory slot.

FrozenKingDrop.d: The last essence of an end once foretold. Sacrificial Blood is a material dropped by Kall Fimbulbringer , the boss of the Deep North, alongside its trophy. It weighs 1, stacks to 30 and can be carried through a portal. No recipe takes it as an ingredient.

SealSoup.d: A warm and tasty meal, best enjoyed on a cold day. Seal Meat Soup is a consumable food cooked at a Cauldron from 2 Seal Blubber , 2 Kale and 2 Ice . It gives 110 health and 37 stamina for 30 minutes, with 7 health regeneration. The blubber is already worth 80 health raw, so cooking buys 110 health in a single food slot instead of 80, on a timer 10 minutes longer than the raw ingredient's. Food Health 110 Stamina 37 Regen 7 hp/tick Duration 30 min

Lantern_DN.d: Deep North. It burns with no fuel and no timer, unlike a Torch , and carrying it costs 5% movement speed. Held in the off hand it blocks for 3 and counts as a Clubs weapon, so hitting something with it trains Clubs.

Upgrader3Weapon.d: This mysterious idol is brimming with the potential of the gods. It could grant a powerful boon, or demand a great sacrifice. Silver Battle Idol is the tier 3 upgrade material for weapons, called for by 8 recipes and spent once at craft time plus once more for every quality level above 1. It rolls at 1.17% on the Mountain cave table, so the caves and the abandoned log cabins around them are the only practical source, with Sunken Crypts and Swamp ruins paying out rarely. Weapons above this tier call for the Black Metal Battle Idol instead.

Upgrader3Armor.d: This mysterious idol is brimming with the potential of the gods. It could grant a powerful boon, or demand a great sacrifice. Silver Protection Idol is the tier 3 upgrade material for armour, called for by 9 recipes, the smallest armour count of any tier, and spent once at craft time plus once more for every quality level above 1. It rolls at 2.34% in Mountain cave chests and abandoned log cabins, with leftover odds in Sunken Crypts and Swamp ruins. Armour above this tier calls for the Black Metal Protection Idol instead.

SmokedFish.d: Fish prepared in the most delicious way. Smoked Fish is a Deep North food cooked at a level 7 Cauldron from 1 Raw Fish , 1 Kale and 1 Poteitr . It gives 30 health, 16 stamina and 95 eitr for 25 minutes, with 5 health regeneration. That is 10 eitr and 5 minutes short of the Oven Pancake , for one of each of three ingredients and no oven step. Food Health 30 Stamina 16 Eitr 95 Regen 5 hp/tick Duration 25 min

Shovel.d: Useful for clearing away the deepest of snow. Snow Shovel is a two-handed tool for clearing deep snow, crafted at the Black Forge from 5 Finewood , 4 Flametal , 2 Embers and one Wooden Battle Idol . It deals no damage and trains Farming rather than a combat skill, swinging through a 90 degree arc at 1.5 metres for 5 stamina, in a two-swing chain that doubles on the second hit. It upgrades to quality 3, reaching 200 durability, at 10 flametal a level, which is more flametal than the shovel itself costs.

Snowball.d: Looks like a perfect thing to throw... Snowball is a thrown one-handed weapon crafted 10 at a time from 5 Ice , also dropped by frozen Greydwarves and picked up loose in the snow. Each throw consumes one snowball, costs 8 stamina and deals 5 blunt and 10 frost at a projectile speed of 26. It trains no skill, so throwing them builds nothing, and it stacks to 50.

ShieldRoots.d: Malleable roots have been twisted into a surprisingly sturdy shield. Shield of Roots is a round shield crafted at a Workbench from 10 Finewood , one Writhan Roots and one Iron Protection Idol . It blocks for 48 on 200 durability, trains Blocking and carries no movement penalty. Upgrades run to quality 3 at 5 finewood and 2 writhan roots a level, so the whole shield costs 5 roots to max out. The idol makes it an iron-tier craft despite the workbench and the wood.

AxeGold_BloodLightning.d: As this axe cuts through wood and blood alike, a resounding thunderous crack shall be heard throughout the land. Thunderblood Axe is a one-handed axe made at the Black Forge from a finished Nord Axe , 20 Bloodgold , one Thunderblood Essence and one Bloodgold Battle Idol . It deals 186 slash and 45 lightning while keeping the full 90 chop and tool tier 6, so nothing about its use as a felling axe changes. Both attacks add 0.2% damage for each point of missing health. Block power holds at 66, and each upgrade adds 10 slash, 3 chop and 5 lightning.

BowGold_BloodLightning.d: Lightning dances along the string, waiting to be unleashed. Thunderblood Bow is a bow made at the Black Forge from a finished Nord Bow , 20 Bloodgold , one Thunderblood Essence and one Bloodgold Battle Idol . Each shot carries 110 pierce, 45 lightning and 10 spirit, with 0.2% more damage for every point of missing health. The conversion also cuts the base bow's spirit scaling from 12 a level to 5, so upgrades add 8 pierce, 5 lightning and 5 spirit.

SmokedMooseMeat.d: The smoke only adds to the wild flavour. Smoked Moose Meat is a consumable food cooked at a Cauldron from 1 Moose Meat and 2 Kale . It gives 105 health and 35 stamina for 25 minutes, with 7 health regeneration. Two ingredients and a cauldron is a short recipe for a food at 7 health regeneration; Seal Meat Soup matches that rate and carries 5 more health, but takes three ingredients and the blubber of a seal. Food Health 105 Stamina 35 Regen 7 hp/tick Duration 25 min

KnifeGold_BloodLightning.d: The blade is already bloodied, yet it sparks in want of more. Thunderblood Dagger is a one-handed knife made at the Black Forge by working one Thunderblood Essence into a finished Nord Dagger , with 20 Bloodgold and one Bloodgold Battle Idol . It deals 80 slash, 80 pierce and 45 lightning, so the conversion adds 5 to each physical type and the whole lightning figure on top without taking anything away. Both attacks also scale with your own missing health, 0.2% more damage for every point gone, and it is your health that counts rather than the target's. Damage climbs 5 slash, 5 pierce and 5 lig

AncientGemstoneOrange.d: A vibrant orange stone, like a summer sunset. Solryth is a Deep North gemstone worth 95, third of the four by value, above Grimvarn at 55 and below Veydris at 135. Its sources are the ones the whole set shares: Imprisoned Dvergr , the carved eyes of Morkhalla, Ancient Chests and Deep North shipwreck chests. A full stack of 20 comes to 1,900.

BattleaxeGold_BloodLightning.d: As you cleave your foes in two, their blood shall sing like a thunderstorm. Thunderblood Greataxe is a two-handed axe made at the Black Forge from a finished Nord Greataxe , 20 Bloodgold , one Thunderblood Essence and one Bloodgold Battle Idol . It deals 198 slash, 40 chop and 45 lightning, the highest slash figure of any Nord axe, and both attacks add 0.2% damage for each point of missing health. The 20% movement penalty and the 76 block power carry over from the base weapon unchanged. Upgrades add 10 slash, 2.5 chop and 5 lightning each.

THSwordGold_BloodLightning.d: Anyone wielding this weapon is sure to be very frightening indeed. Thunderblood Greatsword is a two-handed sword made at the Black Forge from one Nord Greatsword , 20 Bloodgold , one Thunderblood Essence and one Bloodgold Battle Idol . It deals 220 slash and 45 lightning, blocks for 76 and has 400 durability, gaining 10 slash and 5 lightning a level to reach 250 and 60 at quality 4. Both attacks add 0.2% damage for every point of health the wielder is missing, counted in points rather than percent, which stacks on top of the highest slash figure in the game. The primary is a three-swing chain

FistGold_BloodLightning.d: A fury comes over you as you fight with these weapons, your blood roaring like thunder in your ears... It seems appropriate. Thunderblood Knucklechains is a two-handed fist weapon made at the Black Forge from a finished Nord Knucklechains , 20 Bloodgold , one Thunderblood Essence and one Bloodgold Battle Idol . It deals 122 blunt and 45 lightning, up from 114 blunt with nothing given away. Both the chain and the kick gain 0.2% damage for every point of health the wielder is missing, and on a 14 stamina swing that bonus lands more often than on a slower weapon. It reaches quality 4 and 400 dura

MaceGold_BloodLightning.d: A weapon to rival perhaps even that of the thunder god himself... Thunderblood Mace is a one-handed mace made at the Black Forge by working one Thunderblood Essence into a finished Nord Mace , with 20 Bloodgold and one Bloodgold Battle Idol . It deals 180 blunt and 45 lightning, 10 blunt over the mace it is built from with the lightning added on top and nothing given up. Both attacks scale with your own missing health, 0.2% more damage for every point gone, so it hits hardest when you are closest to dying. Damage rises 10 blunt and 5 lightning a level to 210 and 60 at quality 4, and each level

StaffSpiritCaller.d: Summon otherworldly aid. It only costs a drop of your blood... Spirit Caller is a two-handed blood magic staff crafted at the Galdr table from 8 Frozen Branch , 5 Nornathread , one Moose Trophy and one Bloodgold Battle Idol . Its single attack summons a spirit beast, a boar, wolf, bear or moose, that fights for you already tamed, at 100 eitr and 40% of the caster's current health. Blood Magic is the skill it trains and the one that decides how strong the summon is. It holds 400 durability, blocks for 48, upgrades to quality 4 and costs 5% movement speed to carry.

SledgeGold_BloodLightning.d: As this weapon strikes true, the blow shall echo throughout the world... Thunderblood Sledge is a two-handed club made at the Black Forge by working a finished Nord Sledge together with 20 Bloodgold , one Thunderblood Essence and one Bloodgold Battle Idol . It deals 235 blunt and 45 lightning against the base sledge's 225 blunt, giving up nothing in the conversion, and 235 is the highest blunt figure on any weapon. The area swing still costs 28 stamina at double stagger, and it gains a further 0.2% damage for every point of health missing. It costs 20% movement speed and upgrades to quality 4,

AtgeirGold_BloodLightning.d: The heavens shall sound their praise as you make your enemies bleed. Thunderblood Atgeir is a two-handed polearm made at the Black Forge from a finished Nord Atgeir , 20 Bloodgold , one Thunderblood Essence and one Bloodgold Battle Idol . It deals 192 pierce and 45 lightning, 10 pierce above the base weapon with the lightning added rather than traded for, and the 360 degree secondary carries that lightning to everything in the arc. Both attacks scale with missing health, adding 0.2% damage for each point missing. Block power stays at 88 and the movement penalty at 5%, while upgrades add 10 pie

CrossbowGold_BloodLightning.d: The bow is pulled taut with unreleased power, like the air before a lightning strike. Thunderblood Crossbow is a crossbow made at the Black Forge from a finished Nord Crossbow , 20 Bloodgold , one Thunderblood Essence and one Bloodgold Battle Idol . It deals 274 pierce, 45 lightning and 180 chop, keeping every point the base crossbow had and adding to it. Shots also gain 0.2% damage for each point of health the wielder is missing, so the bonus grows as you take damage. Reload is 3.5 seconds, movement costs 5%, and quality 4 adds 8 pierce and 5 lightning a level on the way to 300 durability.

SwordGold_BloodLightning.d: As the blood runs along the blade, it awakens the storm within. Thunderblood Sword is a one-handed sword made at the Black Forge from one Nord Sword , 20 Bloodgold , one Thunderblood Essence and one Bloodgold Battle Idol . It deals 180 slash and 45 lightning, blocks for 66 and has 400 durability, gaining 10 slash and 5 lightning a level to reach 210 and 60 at quality 4. Both attacks add 0.2% damage for every point of health the wielder is missing, counted in points rather than percent, so a 100 health deficit is a 20% increase. The primary is a three-swing chain with double damage on the last

Frostwood.d: A sturdy kind of wood, excellent for mighty halls. Timberwood is the wood of the Deep North, picked off snow-covered branches lying in the snow rather than chopped from a standing tree. Old Deep North logs, roots down in the hole and pulp blobs drop it as well, and planting a Timberwood Cone grows a tree for a renewable supply. Ten go into every Nord weapon cast and five into the Moose Saddle . It stacks to 50 at 2 weight each and can be carried through a portal.

FirConeFrost.d: Plant it to grow a timberwood tree. Timberwood Cone is a seed dropped when snow fir logs are chopped in the Deep North. Planting one with a cultivator grows a timberwood tree, which is the only renewable source of Timberwood . 1 each.

OrbThunderBlood.d: Unstable, erratic and...alive? Thunderblood Essence is a crafting material dropped by Fallen Warriors . At the Black Forge, one essence with 20 Bloodgold and a Bloodgold Battle Idol converts a finished Nord weapon into its Thunderblood form, which adds 10 to the weapon's physical damage and 45 lightning on top of it and removes nothing. On the Nord Sledge that turns 225 blunt into 235 blunt plus 45 lightning.

TrophyDeerWhite.d: A fine specimen, but you'll need to kill more than deer to enter Valhalla. Trophy Deer White is the trophy dropped by Deer White , the white deer variant. It weighs 2, stacks to 20 and can be carried through a portal. Its display name is still the raw asset string rather than a translated one, which is why it reads back to front next to the Deer Trophy taken from ordinary Deer .

AncientGemstonePurple.d: A rich purple stone, suitable for royalty. Veydris is a Deep North gemstone worth 135, second only to Draumyx at 175. It drops from Imprisoned Dvergr , is picked from the carved eyes of Morkhalla, and sits in Ancient Chests and Deep North shipwreck chests. The four gemstones step up in even 40-point increments, 55, 95, 135 and 175, so Veydris is worth exactly one step less than the black stone.

SpearGold_BloodLightning.d: May it strike like lightning, quick and fierce. Thunderblood Spear is a one-handed spear made at the Black Forge from one Nord Spear , 20 Bloodgold , one Thunderblood Essence and one Bloodgold Battle Idol . It deals 180 pierce and 45 lightning, blocks for 66, trains Spears and holds 400 durability over four quality levels, gaining 10 pierce and 5 lightning a level to reach 210 and 60. The primary attack is a thrust with 1.9 meters of reach at 16 stamina; the secondary throws the spear itself for 1.5x damage at 18 stamina and leaves it on the ground to be picked up, lightning included. Both att

Upgrader0Armor.d: This mysterious idol is brimming with the potential of the gods. It could grant a powerful boon, or demand a great sacrifice. Wooden Protection Idol is the tier 0 upgrade material for armour, called for by 43 recipes and spent once at craft time plus once more for every quality level above 1. Nothing crafts or drops an idol: this tier is chest loot from the Meadows, in abandoned wood houses and stone ship settings, at 1.62% a roll on the Meadows chest table. Armour above this tier calls for the Bronze Protection Idol instead.

WrithanRoots.d: The gnarled body parts of a strange, offputting creature. Writhan Roots are a crafting material dropped 1 to 2 at a time by Writhan , doubled per star. Writhan only spawns on swamp 5,000 to 8,000 m from the centre of the world, so a swamp near spawn never has one. Three recipes consume the roots, the Shield of Roots , the Lox Fur Hood and the Birds' Nest, and the first kill unlocks the Crown of Roots at the Bog Witch. They stack to 50.

TrophyWrithan.d: Tough dead, it should probably be handled delicately. Writhan Trophy is a trophy dropped at a 10% rate by Writhan , which live in the Swamp. No recipe consumes it, unlike the Writhan Roots the same creature drops, which two items are built from. It weighs 2 and stacks to 20.

TrophyAbomination.d: A tangled mess of roots and bark.

KnifeVoid.d: Who shall answer the call of the Void? Voidcaller is a one-handed knife dropped by The Void and also craftable at the Galdr table from 8 Ectoplasm , 2 Bloodgold , one Bronze Battle Idol and one unit of Ectoplasm , a separate item that shares the name. It deals 12 slash and 12 pierce on 200 durability, gaining 1 of each per level for 15 and 15 at quality 4. Its swings are cheap to match, 6 stamina for the primary chain and 18 for the triple-damage secondary, where the Nord Dagger costs 14 and 42. Upgrading costs far more than the craft does, 60 more ectoplasm and 60 more bloodgold across the th

TrinketBloodGoldStamina.d: Deep North stamina trinket forged at the Black Forge from 5 Bloodgold , 5 Nornathread and one Hexen Trophy . The Hexen Trophy is also what Northern Vengeance needs, so one Hexen kill covers one of the two and no more. It is the stamina half of the Bloodgold pair, with the Neckstabber covering health off the same 5 Bloodgold.

SpearChitin.d: The ocean's wrath. Abyssal Harpoon is a utility spear crafted at a Workbench from 8 Finewood , 30 Chitin and 3 Leather Scraps . Its throw deals only 10 pierce for 15 stamina, but it latches onto any non-boss creature and drags it back whenever it moves away, draining stamina for as long as the line holds. The line breaks if you attack again, run out of stamina, move too far off, or pull the target into terrain or a building. It has 50 durability, no upgrade path past quality 1, and it trains Spears while blocking for 21.

Upgrader0Weapon.d: This mysterious idol is brimming with the potential of the gods. It could grant a powerful boon, or demand a great sacrifice. Wooden Battle Idol is the tier 0 upgrade material for weapons, called for by 13 recipes and spent once at craft time plus once more for every quality level above 1. No recipe or creature produces one; it comes out of Meadows chests in abandoned wood houses and stone ship settings, at 1.80% a roll on the Meadows buried chest table. Weapons above this tier call for the Bronze Battle Idol instead.

KnifeChitin.d: A knife from the deep. Abyssal Razor is a one-handed knife crafted at the Workbench rather than the Forge, from 4 Finewood , 20 Chitin , 2 Leather Scraps and one Silver Battle Idol . It deals 20 slash and 20 pierce, blocks for 2, and trains Knives. The primary attack is a three-hit chain at 8 stamina a swing; the secondary is a forward leap for triple damage at 24. Backstabs deal 6 times damage. It upgrades to quality 4 at 10 more chitin a level, reaching 23 of each damage type and 200 durability.

Acorn.d: Plant them to grow an oak tree. Acorns are tree seeds dropped by oak trees when they are chopped down. Planted with a Cultivator they grow into an oak over several in-game days, which is the bulk source of Finewood in the Black Forest. A seedling needs clear ground immediately around it or it stays a seedling permanently. Acorns stack to 100 and weigh 0.1 each.

ElderBark.d: An ancient and sturdy material. Ancient Bark is the wood from the ancient trees of the Swamp, and it also comes out of swamp ruin chests, burial grave chests and wild tentaroots. It stacks to 50 at 2 weight each and can be carried through a portal. It is the wood in the Ancient Bark Spear and the Draugr Fang , and the Longship needs 40 of it.

SpearElderbark.d: Despite its gnarled look, this spear is strong and perfectly balanced. Ancient Bark Spear is a one-handed spear crafted at the Forge from 4 Troll Hide , 10 Iron , 10 Ancient Bark and one Iron Battle Idol . It deals 55 pierce, blocks for 21, trains Spears and holds 100 durability over four quality levels, gaining 6 pierce per level. The primary attack is a thrust with 1.9 meters of reach at 10 stamina; the secondary throws the spear itself for 1.5x damage at 12 stamina and leaves it on the ground to be picked up. Spears backstab for 3x and cost 5% movement speed to carry.

Flametal.d: A withered metal from ancient times. No one knows what it was once used for.

AncientSeed.d: Held against your ear, you hear tiny whisperings within... Ancient Seed is a boss offering dropped by Greydwarf Brutes and by destroying greydwarf nests and the spawner hearts found in Black Forest and Swamp dungeons. Burning three at the summoning altar calls The Elder . They stack to 50, weigh 1 each and can be carried through a portal.

MeadBugRepellent.d: The perfect drink for a day in the Plains. Anti-Sting Concoction is a Plains-tier consumable fermented from Mead Base: Anti-Sting , which is brewed in a mead ketill. Two in-game days of fermenting yield six bottles, and they stack to 10. Drinking one does not make you immune to Deathsquitos : they still close on you, then break off and flee three to eight metres out instead of landing the sting.

PickaxeAntler.d: This tool is hard enough to crack even the most stubborn rocks. Antler Pickaxe is a two-handed pickaxe crafted at the Workbench from 10 Wood and one Hard Antler , which drops from Eikthyr . It deals 18 pierce and 18 pickaxe damage, has 100 durability and trains Pickaxes. The single vertical swing costs 6 stamina and reaches 1.8 metres, hitting several targets at once for reduced damage per hit, and there is no secondary attack. It mines stone, copper, tin, muddy scrap piles and abyssal barnacles. It cannot be upgraded past quality 1 and costs 5% movement speed to carry.

CrossbowArbalest.d: A slow but powerful weapon. Arbalest is a crossbow crafted at the Black Forge from 10 Wood , 8 Iron , 4 Root and one Black Marble Battle Idol . It deals 200 pierce and 140 chop, blocks for 3, trains Crossbows and has 150 durability, gaining 3 pierce per quality level to quality 4. A bolt has to be loaded before each shot, which takes 3.5 seconds and resets if you jump or sprint; firing the loaded bolt costs no stamina. Bolts travel far faster than arrows and fly flat instead of arcing, and holding the crossbow costs 5% movement speed.

BowAshlands.d: Risen again from the ashes, this bow holds unyielding strength. Ash Fang is a bow crafted at the Black Forge from 10 Ashwood , 16 Charred Bone , 5 Flametal , 5 Bonemaw Tooth and one Flametal Battle Idol . It deals 82 pierce, trains Bows, has 300 durability and costs 5% movement speed to carry. Each quality level adds 4 pierce and 5 spirit, so at quality 4 it fires for 94 pierce and 15 spirit. Fitting a gemstone at the Black Forge converts it into Blood Fang , Root Fang or Storm Fang , and the conversion drops it back to quality 1.

Blackwood.d: Wood hardened by fire and ash. Ashwood is the wood of the Ashlands, chopped from scorched trees and gathered from the branches, bushes and stumps around them, with more in the chests inside putrid holes. A stone axe fells the trees, but the biome only opens once the Queen is dead, so it is a late-game resource whatever tools you bring. Each piece weighs 2, stacks to 50 and can be carried through a portal.

AskBladder.d: An acidic smell still lingers. Prominently.

AsksvinEgg.d: Hard as rock, yet you can sense the presence of something inside. This should be kept warm. Asksvin Egg is an egg laid by tame Asksvin in the Ashlands. Left on the ground on its own, under a roof and near a fire, it hatches after 30 minutes into an Asksvin Hatchling ; eggs stack to 20, and an egg sitting in a stack will not hatch. Egg quality runs to 4 and sets the star level of the hatchling, so a quality 3 egg produces a 2 star Asksvin. Food Health 10 Stamina 30 Regen 2 hp/tick Duration 10 min

AskHide.d: This sturdy leather is thick, and still warm to the touch.

AsksvinCarrionNeck.d: A neck in its final stage of life. Asksvin Neck is a bone material gathered by breaking asksvin carrion, the loose skeletons that sit around putrid hole entrances and Volture nests in the Ashlands. Each carrion gives one of the four skeleton pieces at random, so the neck arrives at the same rate as the skull , ribcage and pelvis . It weighs 2 and stacks to 50.

AsksvinCarrionPelvic.d: The pelvic bone of a four legged creature. Asksvin Pelvis is a bone material gathered by breaking asksvin carrion, the loose skeletons that sit around putrid hole entrances and Volture nests in the Ashlands. Breaking one carrion yields a single random piece out of the four, so bulk gathering means running a loop between nest sites rather than hunting a specific bone. It weighs 2 and stacks to 50.

AsksvinCarrionRibcage.d: These ribs have already been stripped clean of any meat. Asksvin Ribcage is a bone material gathered by breaking asksvin carrion, the loose skeletons that sit around putrid hole entrances and Volture nests in the Ashlands. At 5 weight it is more than twice as heavy as the neck , skull and pelvis , which all weigh 2, so a full bone run is mostly ribcage load.
