The ribs come stripped of meat, so Asksvin Tail still means killing a live Asksvin . It stacks to 50.

SaddleAsksvin.d: The back of an asksvin is rather lumpy, so you'll need a saddle if you want to ride one. Asksvin Saddle is a riding item crafted at the Black Forge from 6 Flametal , 20 Linen Thread and 4 Morgen Sinew . It attaches only to an already tamed Asksvin : put it on the hotbar and use it while aiming at the animal, then mount with the use key and dismount with shift plus use. The flametal and morgen sinew fix it to the Ashlands, so no asksvin is rideable before that biome.

CapeAsh.d: Thin metal threads are woven into this cape to create an intricate pattern, like a destiny woven by the Norns themselves. Ashen Cape is a cape crafted at the Black Forge from 6 Asksvin Hide , 2 Morgen Sinew , 5 Flametal and one Flametal Protection Idol . It gives 12 armour, rising by 2 a quality level to 18 at quality 4, and has 1200 durability. It resists frost and cuts attack stamina by 10% and block stamina by 20%, which makes it the fighting cape of its tier against the mobility of the Asksvin Cloak .

FeastAshlands.d: Food Health 75 Stamina 75 Eitr 38 Regen 6 hp/tick Duration 50 min

AsksvinCarrionSkull.d: A thick skull, with room for a surprisingly large brain. Asksvin Skull is a bone material gathered by breaking asksvin carrion, the loose skeletons that sit around putrid hole entrances and Volture nests in the Ashlands. It is scavenged from a dead pile rather than taken off a kill; the head of an asksvin you kill yourself drops as the separate Asksvin Trophy . Each carrion drops one of the four skeleton pieces at random. It weighs 2 and stacks to 50.

AsksvinMeat.d: Smells a bit smokey, even when raw. Asksvin Tail is a raw meat dropped by Asksvin and their hatchlings in the Ashlands. It gives 70 health but only 24 stamina over 20 minutes at 6 health regeneration, which places it with the healing foods rather than the stamina ones. An iron cooking station over a lit campfire turns it into Cooked Asksvin Tail , or Coal if it is left on too long. Recipes that call for the raw tail will not take the cooked one, so a stack meant for the cauldron has to be held back. Food Health 70 Stamina 24 Regen 6 hp/tick Duration 20 min

TrophyAsksvin.d: Don't let yourself be fooled by the friendly smile, for it could easily bite your arm off.

CapeAsksvin.d: This thick cape catches the wind, not unlike the sail of a ship. Asksvin Cloak is a cape crafted at the Galdr Table from 6 Asksvin Hide , 2 Morgen Sinew and one Flametal Protection Idol . It gives 1 armour, rising by 1 a quality level to 4 at quality 4, and has 1500 durability, the highest of any cape. It cuts dodge stamina by 15% and grants Wind run, which scales with wind direction and strength up to 25% more running speed and up to 100% less running stamina.

ShieldBanded.d: Banded with hoops of iron, a true warrior's companion. Banded Shield is a round shield forged at the Forge from 10 Finewood , 8 Iron and one Iron Protection Idol . It blocks for 42, carries 10 blunt damage, has 200 durability, upgrades to quality 3 and trains Blocking. As a round shield it can parry, which the Iron Tower Shield of the same tier cannot, although the tower shield blocks more. It weighs 5 and costs 5% movement speed.

BarberKit.d: A kit fit for the finest of barbers.

Barley.d: A bundle of barley. Barley is a Plains crop picked from wild barley around fuling settlements, and it also turns up in heath ruin chests and village barrels. Replanting it needs a Cultivator and only works in the Plains, where a crop takes 4000 to 5000 seconds to mature, roughly 2.2 to 2.8 in-game days. It is milled into Barley Flour and fermented into Barley Wine Base: Fire Resistance . 2 each.

BarleyWineBase.d: Plains tier Material Barley Wine Base: Fire Resistance Needs to be fermented.

BombLava.d: With enough heat, it solidifies upon explosion. Basalt Bomb is a thrown weapon crafted at the workbench from one Asksvin Hide , one Asksvin Bladder and 3 Proustite Powder , which yields five at a time. Thrown into lava it sets into a basalt platform that floats for 30 seconds before it starts to sink, which is the standard way to reach Flametal Ore veins out in the flow. Throwing costs 8 stamina, and the bombs weigh 0.3 each and stack to 50.

FireworksRocket_White.d: This rocket's blasting off again! Basic Fireworks are bought from Hildir, and only enter her stock after you return her bronze chest. Setting one on an open fire launches it and bursts white. Every other colour of firework is crafted from these, so they are the base component rather than the plain option. They stack to 10 at 0.5 weight each.

Battleaxe.d: Skull-splitter, a warrior's joy. Battleaxe is the first two-handed axe, forged at the Forge from 30 Ancient Bark , 35 Iron , 4 Leather Scraps and one Iron Battle Idol . It deals 70 slash and 40 chop, blocks for 28, trains Axes and has 200 durability, gaining 6 slash and 2.5 chop a level to reach 88 slash at quality 4. The primary is a three-swing chain with double damage on the last hit, 1.5x stagger and no damage penalty for hitting several targets, at 16 stamina and 2.5m reach; the faster secondary deals half damage with 4x stagger for 8 stamina. Wielding it costs 15% movement speed, the hea

BjornHide.d: A thick and furry hide, coarse yet incredibly soft.

BjornMeat.d: This fatty meat was once meant to sustain a body through hibernation. Bear Meat is raw food dropped by Bears , awake or sleeping, and by Viles , and it also turns up in barrels underground. Eaten raw it gives 35 health and 12 stamina over 1200 seconds with 2 health regen. Cooked on a cooking station it becomes Cooked Bear Meat , or Coal if it is left on too long, and no cauldron recipe uses it. It stacks to 20 and weighs 1 each. Food Health 35 Stamina 12 Regen 2 hp/tick Duration 20 min

BjornPaw.d: Sharp claws suitable for picking berries – or for dismembering.

BeechSeeds.d: Plant them to grow a beech tree. Beech Seeds drop from beech trees, the only tree a Stone Axe can fell in the Meadows. Planted with a Cultivator they take a few in-game days to grow, and a seedling with anything built or planted too close to it never matures. Beech yields Wood rather than Finewood , so a beech farm is an early-game convenience that stops mattering once birch and oak open up. They stack to 100 and weigh 0.1 each.

Bell.d: For whom does the bell toll? Bell is a summoning item crafted at the Black Forge from 3 Bell Fragment . Three bells are consumed to summon Fader , so a full summon runs to 9 fragments. Bells stack to 9, which puts the whole ritual in a single inventory slot, and they have no use once Fader is down.

BarrelRings.d: These metal rings are perfectly round, suitable for holding a barrel together. Just add wood!

BellFragment.d: This ancient fragment appears to be a piece of a broken bell... Bell Fragment is a material taken from the bell altar in the inner tower of a Charred Fortress, directly under the green cone of light visible over the Ashlands. Destroying an altar drops 2 to 4 fragments. Three of them make one Bell at the Black Forge, and since summoning Fader takes three bells, the boss costs 9 fragments in total. Fragments stack to 9.

AxeBerzerkr.d: Let your rage take over and face the slaughter. Berserkir Axes are a dual-wielded two-handed pair forged at the Black Forge from 15 Charred Bone , 24 Flametal , 3 Asksvin Hide and one Flametal Battle Idol . They deal 140 slash and 80 chop, block for 57, train Axes and have 300 durability, gaining 5 slash and 3 chop a level to reach 155 slash and 89 chop at quality 4. The primary is a four-step chain that lands six hits, the final pair at double damage, for 16 stamina; the secondary leaps forward and cuts with both axes at 1.5x damage for 32 stamina. Fitting a Bloodstone , Iolite or Jade conver

MeadBzerker.d: Something poisonous stirs within, brewed to the point where its potential can finally be harnessed. But be careful to let the beast out... Berserkir Mead is a Plains-tier consumable fermented from Mead base: Berserkir , which is brewed in a mead ketill. Two in-game days of fermenting yield three bottles, and they stack to 10. For 20 seconds it cuts the stamina cost of attacking, blocking and dodging by 80%, and for those same 20 seconds it leaves you weak to slash, blunt and pierce, taking 1.5x damage from all three.

BombBile.d: Handle with care. Bile Bomb is a thrown weapon crafted at the workbench from one Sap , one Bilebag and 3 Resin , which yields three at a time. It deals 5 blunt on impact for 8 stamina a throw, then leaves a 4 metre cloud lasting 10 seconds that burns and poisons everything inside it except the thrower, 15 fire over 5 seconds and 30 poison over 6 seconds. Both effects refresh while a target stays in the cloud, so a full 10 seconds inside it comes to 150 fire and 80 poison, unaffected by any skill. Each bomb weighs 0.3 and they stack to 50.

Bilebag.d: Caustic bile drawn from the corpse of a gjall.

BirchSeeds.d: Plant them to grow a birch tree. Birch Seeds drop from birch trees, including the autumn variants, and are planted with a Cultivator to grow more. Birch is one of the two Finewood trees, so a planted stand removes the walk through the Black Forest looking for wild ones. The drop rate depends on whether the tree was itself planted and which biome it grew in, which makes the first handful the slow part. Seedlings need clear ground around them or they never become trees. They stack to 100 and weigh 0.1 each.

BlackCore.d: Filled to the brim with ancient power. Black Core is a material found in Infested Mines, pulled from the core stands in their rooms and from the ancient chests kept there. It weighs 1, stacks to 20 and can be carried through a portal. Building one of each Mistlands crafting station takes 15 cores in total, and how many a mine holds depends on which rooms it generated: a mine runs anywhere from 16 to 96 rooms, and some hold none at all.

FeastBlackforest.d: Consumable Black Forest Buffet Platter Food Health 35 Stamina 35 Regen 3 hp/tick Duration 50 min

BlackMarble.d: A block of solid stone, seamed with shifting colors. Black Marble is a stone mined from the giant remains that lie across the Mistlands, and breaking it needs a Black Metal Pickaxe . Smaller amounts come from mining or deconstructing Dvergr buildings, which turns any Dvergr in sight hostile, and it drops now and then from Dvergr rogues and Dvergr mages . It weighs 2, stacks to 50, and like ordinary stone it goes through a portal.

BlackMetal.d: A heavy bar of dark metal. Black Metal is a bar smelted from Black Metal Scrap in a blast furnace with Coal for fuel. It is the fourth tier of metal equipment, following Silver , and covers the Plains weapons, armour and tools. Each bar weighs 12 and stacks to 30, and like every other metal it cannot go through a portal.

AtgeirBlackmetal.d: A vicious hewing-axe of almost unbreakable black metal. Black Metal Atgeir is a two-handed polearm forged at the Forge from 10 Finewood , 30 Black Metal , 5 Linen Thread and one Black Metal Battle Idol . It deals 105 pierce, blocks for 52, trains Polearms and has 175 durability, gaining 6 pierce per upgrade level to reach 123 at quality 4. The primary is a three-swing chain with double damage on the last hit at 18 stamina a swing and 3.2m of reach; the secondary sweeps a full circle for 36 stamina and staggers everything it touches six times as hard as a normal hit. Wielding it costs 5% moveme

AxeBlackMetal.d: A perfectly-balanced axe forged from dark metal with an emerald sheen. Black Metal Axe is a one-handed axe forged at the Forge from 6 Finewood , 20 Black Metal , 5 Linen Thread and one Black Metal Battle Idol . It deals 100 slash and 60 chop, blocks for 39, trains Axes and has 175 durability, gaining 5 slash and 3 chop a level to reach 115 slash at quality 4. Its 60 chop fells every tree in the game, ancient, yggdrasil and scorched trees included. The primary is a three-swing chain with double damage on the last hit at 14 stamina; the secondary is a slow overhead at 1.5x damage for 28 stamina,

BattleaxeBlackmetal.d: Green shall be the last thing your foes see before you cleave them in half. Black Metal Battleaxe is a two-handed axe forged at the Forge from 10 Finewood , 30 Black Metal , 5 Linen Thread and one Black Metal Battle Idol . It deals 110 slash and 60 chop, blocks for 52 and has 200 durability, gaining 6 slash and 2.5 chop a level to reach 128 slash at quality 4. The primary is a three-swing chain with double damage on the last hit, 1.5x stagger and no damage penalty across multiple targets, at 20 stamina; the faster secondary deals half damage with 4x stagger for 10 stamina. Wielding it costs 15

BoltBlackmetal.d: A sleek bolt of dark metal.

KnifeBlackMetal.d: A darkling blade. Strong and sharp. Black Metal Knife is a one-handed knife forged at the Forge from 4 Finewood , 10 Black Metal , 5 Linen Thread and one Black Metal Battle Idol . It deals 34 slash and 34 pierce, blocks for 2, and trains Knives. The primary attack is a three-hit chain at 12 stamina a swing; the secondary is a forward leap for triple damage at 36. Backstabs deal 6 times damage. It upgrades to quality 4 at 4 more black metal and 5 more linen thread a level, reaching 37 of each damage type and 200 durability.

TurretBolt.d: These thick missiles can punch through the hide of even the toughest foes.

PickaxeBlackMetal.d: A good strong pick of glistening dark metal. Black Metal Pickaxe is a two-handed pickaxe forged at the Forge from 3 Yggdrasil Wood , 25 Black Metal and one Black Metal Battle Idol . It deals 49 pierce and 49 pickaxe damage, has 210 durability and upgrades to quality 4, gaining 5 of each damage type per level. It adds black marble, soft tissue, buried ancient swords and armour, and flametal veins to what the earlier pickaxes can mine. The vertical swing costs 14 stamina and hits several targets for reduced damage per hit, and carrying it costs 5% movement speed.

BlackMetalScrap.d: A twisted hunk of dark metal. Black Metal Scrap is the Plains metal material, and unlike copper, tin or iron it comes from no deposit at all. Every kind of Fuling drops it, chests in Plains ruins and stone houses hold it, and grouper give it up when caught. It smelts into Black Metal , the equipment tier above Silver . Scrap cannot go through a portal, and at 10 weight a piece with 30 to a stack, a full stack is 300 weight to walk or sail home.

ShieldBlackmetal.d: Fashioned from the strongest metal, able to turn even the deadliest blades. Black Metal Shield is a round shield forged at the Forge from 10 Finewood , 8 Black Metal , 5 Chain and one Black Metal Protection Idol . It blocks for 78, carries 10 blunt damage, has 200 durability, upgrades to quality 3 and trains Blocking. It blocks 26 less than the Black Metal Tower Shield but can parry, which no tower shield can. It weighs 5 and costs 5% movement speed.

SwordBlackmetal.d: A thing of death and beauty. It catches the light with a greenish glow.

ShieldBlackmetalTower.d: A tower shield of gleaming dark metal. Black Metal Tower Shield is a tower shield forged at the Forge from 15 Finewood , 10 Black Metal , 7 Chain and one Black Metal Protection Idol . It blocks for 104, carries 10 damage, has 200 durability, upgrades to quality 3 and trains Blocking. Like every tower shield it cannot parry, and it costs 10% movement speed and 10% more stamina per dodge roll.

BlackSoup.d: A perfect balance of sweetness and acidity. Black Soup is a Swamp-tier food cooked in a level 2 cauldron from one Bloodbag , one Honey and one Turnip . It gives 50 health and 17 stamina for 20 minutes, with a health regeneration value of 3. Each bowl weighs 1 and they stack to 10. Food Health 50 Stamina 17 Regen 3 hp/tick Duration 20 min

AxeBerzerkrBlood.d: The closer you are to death, the harder you are sure to hit. Bleeding Berserkir Axes are the Bloodstone version of the Berserkir Axes , made at the Black Forge from the base pair, 5 Flametal , 1 bloodstone and one Flametal Battle Idol . The base profile is unchanged at 140 slash, 80 chop, 57 block and 300 durability, with 5 slash and 3 chop per upgrade level. Both attacks gain 0.2% damage for every point of health the wielder is missing, counted in points rather than percent, so a 100 health deficit is a 20% increase. Converting the axes resets them to quality 1, so upgrade after the gemstone,

BombBlob_PoisonElite.d: Meadows tier One Handed Weapon Blob Bomb: Elite Poison Breathing in the fumes is not recommended. Blob Bomb: Elite Poison is a thrown weapon crafted at the workbench from one Corked Vial , 3 Blob Trophy and 3 Resin . It deals 5 blunt where it lands and releases a friendly Oozer , which splits into smaller blobs when it dies and keeps fighting. Throwing costs 8 stamina, and the bombs weigh 0.3 each and stack to 50.

BombBlob_Frost.d: Meadows tier One Handed Weapon Blob Bomb: Frost If you hold it for too long your hand might just freeze in place. Blob Bomb: Frost is a thrown weapon crafted at the workbench from one Corked Vial , one Drake Trophy and 3 Resin . It deals 5 blunt where it lands and releases a friendly Frost Blob that attacks whatever is nearby. Throwing costs 8 stamina, and the bombs weigh 0.3 each and stack to 50.

BombBlob_Lava.d: Ashlands tier One Handed Weapon Blob Bomb: Lava The vial is hot in your hand, promising fiery destruction. Blob Bomb: Lava is a thrown weapon crafted at the workbench from one Corked Vial , 10 Sulfur and 10 Proustite Powder . It deals 5 blunt where it lands and releases a friendly Lava Blob that attacks whatever is nearby, fire included, so it is best thrown well away from anything wooden you own. Throwing costs 8 stamina, and the bombs weigh 0.3 each and stack to 50.

BombBlob_Poison.d: Meadows tier One Handed Weapon Blob Bomb: Poison Should this vial break, caution is strongly advised. Blob Bomb: Poison is a thrown weapon crafted at the workbench from one Corked Vial , one Blob Trophy and 3 Resin . It deals 5 blunt where it lands and releases a friendly Blob that attacks whatever is nearby. Throwing costs 8 stamina, and the bombs weigh 0.3 each and stack to 50.

BombBlob_Tar.d: Plains tier One Handed Weapon Blob Bomb: Tar The sticky substance within pulses, as if threatening you. Blob Bomb: Tar is a thrown weapon crafted at the workbench from one Corked Vial , one Growth Trophy and 3 Tar . It deals 5 blunt where it lands and releases a friendly Growth , whose attacks leave tar that slows anything standing in it. Throwing costs 8 stamina, and the bombs weigh 0.3 each and stack to 50.

TrophyBlob.d: A smelly lump of sticky matter.

GiantBloodSack.d: Be careful not to puncture this while you carry it...

BowAshlandsBlood.d: Arrows loosed from this bow will tear into flesh with unmatched ferocity. Blood Fang is a bow made at the Black Forge by fitting one Ash Fang with one Bloodstone , 5 Flametal and one Flametal Battle Idol . It deals 82 pierce, trains Bows, has 300 durability and costs 5% movement speed to carry, gaining 4 pierce and 5 spirit a quality level to reach 94 pierce and 15 spirit at quality 4. Its arrows hit 0.2% harder for every point of health the archer is missing, counted in points rather than percent, so the bonus grows as the fight goes badly. The conversion resets the bow to quality 1, so upgra

BloodPudding.d: It's bloody tasty. Blood Pudding is a Plains-tier food cooked in a level 4 cauldron from 2 Thistle , 2 Bloodbag and 4 Barley Flour . It gives 25 health and 75 stamina for 30 minutes, with a health regeneration value of 2. Each portion weighs 1 and they stack to 10. Food Health 25 Stamina 75 Regen 2 hp/tick Duration 30 min

Bloodbag.d: The contents of a leech. Ick!

MaceEldnerBlood.d: The blood all but soaks into this mace, and it always yearns for more. Bloodgeon is a one-handed club made at the Black Forge by fitting a Bloodstone to a Flametal Mace , alongside 8 Flametal and one Flametal Battle Idol . It keeps the base weapon's 135 blunt, 57 block and 300 durability, and adds 0.2% damage for every point of health you are missing, counted in points rather than as a percentage. The primary attack is a three-swing chain with double damage on the last hit at 16 stamina a swing; the slower secondary comes down for 2.5 times damage and double stagger at 28. Wielding it costs 5%

GemstoneRed.d: You wonder how many deals have been made to appease this gem. How many palms have bled onto it in exchange for its power? Bloodstone is a gemstone that converts an Ashlands weapon into its Blood version, raising damage by 0.2% for every point of health the wielder is missing. That is the wielder's missing health, not the target's. It shares the charred chests of the Charred Fortresses with Iolite , and one of the Morkhalla gemstone eyes holds it. Stacks run to 50.

ArmorDress6.d: A fancy blue dress, with beads and bronze fibula brooches. Excellent for a feast!

ArmorDress5.d: A blue dress, with a green shawl around the shoulders. Warm and stylish!

JuteBlue.d: Made from natural fibers and dvergr hair.

MushroomBlue.d: Glows with a soft blue hue. Blue Mushroom is an unimplemented consumable. Its pickable never appears in a generated world, so the only way to hold one is a console command. Eaten raw it restores 20 health and 20 stamina over 10 minutes at 1 regeneration, and as of 0.147.3 no recipe, station or trader accepts it, which leaves those numbers the only working part of the item. Food Health 20 Stamina 20 Regen 1 hp/tick Duration 10 min

ArmorTunic3.d: A blue tunic worn with beads and silver jewelry. Sure to attract attention from other vikings.

ArmorTunic2.d: A blue tunic, worn with a fashionable cape made from fine brown wool.

Blueberries.d: Tiny but tasty. Food Health 8 Stamina 25 Regen 1 hp/tick Duration 10 min

BoarJerky.d: Lean and salty. Food Health 23 Stamina 23 Regen 2 hp/tick Duration 30 min

RawMeat.d: Boar Meat is a raw food dropped by Boar . Uncooked it gives 20 health and 20 stamina for 10 minutes with 1 health regeneration, and a cooking station turns it into Cooked Boar Meat , or into Coal if it is left on too long. Recipes that call for the raw meat will not accept the cooked version, and recipes that call for the cooked will not accept the raw. Food Health 20 Stamina 20 Regen 1 hp/tick Duration 10 min

TrophyBoar.d: This boar head would make for a nice decoration in any house.

BoltBone.d: A crude bolt of yellowed bone.

ShieldBoneTower.d: The bones of dead warriors make for a good protection. Bone Tower Shield is a tower shield crafted at the Workbench from 10 Wood , 10 Bone Fragments , 3 Skeleton Trophies and one Bronze Protection Idol . It blocks for 32, carries 10 damage, has 200 durability and upgrades to quality 3, which takes 25 wood and 25 bone fragments in total. Like every tower shield it cannot parry, and it costs 10% movement speed and 10% more stamina per dodge roll.

TrophyBonemass.d: Bones and viscous goo, held together by some unseen force. Offer it to the Sacrificial Stones.

BoneMawSerpentMeat.d: A tasty, white fish meat. Very good for your bones! Bonemaw Meat is a raw fish meat and a guaranteed drop from Bonemaw in the boiling waters of the Ashlands. The meat floats for a long time after the kill, so a fight that ends far from shore can still be collected. An iron cooking station over a lit campfire turns it into Cooked Bonemaw Meat , or Coal if it is left too long. Raw it has no food value at all, and at 10 weight with 50 to a stack it is heavy cargo for the trip back.

BonemawSerpentScale.d: It looks just like bone. Best not to question the anatomy of this creature too much...

BonemawSerpentTooth.d: This has caused the death of many a brave sailor.

TrophyBonemawSerpent.d: A skull made up of dense bone, as dangerous as it is protective.

TrinketBlackDamageHealth.d: Your mind hardens, as do your blows. Bracelets of the Brave is a Plains-tier trinket forged at the Forge from 5 Black Metal , 5 Lox Pelt and one Lox Trophy . It fires on its own once 85 adrenaline has built up, returning 100 health immediately and adding 20 Clubs skill and 10% blunt damage for the next 60 seconds. The skill half only pays out on a mace or a sledge, so the trinket commits a build to blunt weapons rather than helping any of them.

Bread.d: A tasty loaf of bread. Bread is a Plains-tier food baked from Bread Dough in a stone oven, which takes 50 seconds; leave it in for 100 and it burns into Coal . The dough itself is made at a food preparation table from Barley Flour , and one batch makes two portions of dough. Bread gives 23 health and 70 stamina for 25 minutes, with a health regeneration value of 2. Each loaf weighs 0.5 and they stack to 20. Food Health 23 Stamina 70 Regen 2 hp/tick Duration 25 min

ArmorAshlandsMediumChest.d: The first man in Midgard knew how to guard his most vital organs, perhaps with a breastplate just like this one. Breastplate of Ask is a chest armour piece forged at the Black Forge from 15 Linen Thread , 4 Lox Pelt , 10 Asksvin Hide and one Flametal Protection Idol . It gives 28 armour, 2 more per quality level to 34 at quality 4, on 1000 durability, and takes nothing off movement speed. Worn with Trousers of Ask and the Hood of Ask it completes the Ask set, whose bonus cuts the stamina cost of running.

MeadTamer.d: It smells like a pigsty. Likely the taste won't be much better. Brew of Animal Whispers is a Mountain-tier consumable fermented from Mead Base: Animal Whispers , six bottles from one base after two in-game days. It doubles taming speed, 15 minutes instead of 30, for every animal within 60 metres of the drinker rather than for one target at a time. The multiplier applies once per player in range, so two drinkers standing in the same pen tame at x4 and three at x8.

TrinketFlametalStaminaHealth.d: It's warm, as if filled with a lifesblood of its own.

Bronze.d: A strong alloy of copper and tin. Bronze is an alloy made at the forge, where 10 Copper and 5 Tin smelt down into five bars. It can also be recovered by smelting Scrap Bronze , by breaking the standing braziers in mountain frost caves, and from the ancient pots in Ashlands charred ruins. Each bar weighs 12 and stacks to 30, and bronze cannot be carried through a portal.

AtgeirBronze.d: A true warrior's tool. Bronze Atgeir is the first two-handed polearm, forged at the Forge from 10 Wood , 8 Bronze , 2 Leather Scraps and one Bronze Battle Idol . It deals 45 pierce, blocks for 16, trains Polearms and has 125 durability, gaining 6 pierce per upgrade level to reach 63 at quality 4. The primary is a three-swing chain with double damage on the last hit at 12 stamina a swing and 3.2m of reach; the secondary sweeps a full circle for 24 stamina and staggers everything it touches six times as hard as a normal hit. Wielding it costs 5% movement speed.

ShieldBronzeBuckler.d: A shield of burnished bronze, good to turn a blade or two. Bronze Buckler is a buckler forged at the Forge from 10 Bronze and 4 Wood with one Bronze Protection Idol . It blocks for 16, the lowest of its tier, but its 2.5x parry bonus is higher than any round or tower shield available at the same point, so it trades blocking for staggering. It has 200 durability and upgrades to quality 3, which takes 25 bronze and 7 wood in total. It weighs 3 and costs 5% movement speed.

HelmetBronze.d: This will help to keep your brains inside your skull.

MaceBronze.d: A headache on a stick. Bronze Mace is a one-handed club forged at the Forge from 4 Wood , 8 Bronze , 3 Leather Scraps and one Bronze Battle Idol . It deals 35 blunt, blocks for 12 and trains Clubs. The primary attack is a three-swing chain with double damage on the last hit at 8 stamina a swing; the slower secondary comes down for 2.5 times damage and double stagger at 16. Wielding it costs 5% movement speed. It upgrades to quality 4 at 4 more bronze a level, reaching 53 blunt at 200 durability.

BronzeNails.d: Used in construction of ships and furniture. Bronze Nails are a construction material forged 20 at a time from a single Bronze bar at the Forge. They pass through portals, which the bar itself, Copper and Tin all refuse to do, so the usual routine is to smelt and forge at the mining camp and carry only the nails home. Ships and furniture are what consume them, and they stack to 100 at 0.5 weight.

TrinketBronzeStamina.d: A beautiful pendant, harbouring the endurance of a bear. Bronze Pendant is a Black Forest-tier trinket forged at the Forge from 5 Bronze , 3 Ruby and one Bear Trophy . It fires at 50 adrenaline and gives 25% stamina regeneration for 60 seconds. It is the stamina counterpart to Heart of the Forest , sharing the threshold and the duration and differing only in which bar refills.

PickaxeBronze.d: A good bronze pick. Can break very hard rocks. Bronze Pickaxe is a two-handed pickaxe forged at the Forge from 3 Corewood , 10 Bronze and one Bronze Battle Idol . It deals 25 pierce and 25 pickaxe damage, has 120 durability and upgrades to quality 4, gaining 5 pierce and 4 pickaxe damage per level. It opens no deposits the Antler Pickaxe cannot already break, and only hits harder and lasts longer. The vertical swing costs 8 stamina, and carrying it costs 5% movement speed.

ArmorBronzeLegs.d: Bronze greaves to shield your legs.

AxeBronze.d: A bright and burnished blade, curved like a smile. Bronze Axe is a one-handed axe forged at the Forge from 4 Wood , 8 Bronze , 2 Leather Scraps and one Iron Battle Idol . It deals 40 slash and 40 chop, blocks for 12, trains Axes and has 125 durability, gaining 5 slash and 3 chop a level. Its chop is the first that can fell birch, oak and ancient trees, which is what opens up Finewood and the whole Black Forest tier. The primary is a three-swing chain with double damage on the last hit at 8 stamina; the secondary is an overhead at 1.5x damage for 16 stamina. It costs 5% movement speed.

SpearBronze.d: A sturdy spear with a head of burnished bronze. Bronze Spear is a one-handed spear crafted at the Forge from 5 Wood , 6 Bronze , 2 Deer Hide and one Bronze Battle Idol . It deals 35 pierce, blocks for 12, trains Spears and holds 100 durability over four quality levels, gaining 6 pierce per level. The primary attack is a thrust with 1.9 meters of reach at 8 stamina; the secondary throws the spear itself for 1.5x damage at 10 stamina and leaves it on the ground to be picked up. Spears backstab for 3x and cost 5% movement speed to carry.

SwordBronze.d: Blood-drinker. A thirsty friend. Bronze Sword is the first one-handed sword, forged at the Forge from 2 Wood , 8 Bronze , 2 Leather Scraps and one Bronze Battle Idol . It deals 35 slash, blocks for 12, trains Swords and has 200 durability, gaining 6 slash a level to reach 53 at quality 4. The primary is a three-swing chain with double damage on the last hit at 8 stamina a swing and 2.4m of reach; the secondary is a lunging thrust for triple damage at 16 stamina. Backstabs deal 3 times damage, and carrying it costs 5% movement speed.

ArrowBronze.d: Sharper than flint. A sleek messenger of death.

ArmorDress3.d: A fancy brown dress, with beads and silver fibula brooches. Excellent for a feast!

ArmorDress2.d: A brown dress, with a matching shawl around the shoulders. Warm and stylish!

HelmetHat3.d: A warm fur cap, made from the finest leather.

THSwordSlayerBlood.d: If it bleeds, you can kill it. Brutal Slayer is a two-handed sword made at the Black Forge by fitting a Bloodstone to a Slayer , alongside 15 Flametal and one Flametal Battle Idol . It keeps the base 170 slash, 64 block power and 300 durability, gains 6 slash a level to 188 at quality 4, and adds 0.2% damage for every point of health the wielder is missing, counted in points rather than percent. Both the 20 stamina chain and the 40 stamina triple-damage sweep carry that bonus. The conversion hands back a quality 1 sword whatever the Slayer was upgraded to, so fit the bloodstone first.

Pukeberries.d: Allows the consumer to quickly evacuate any misplaced meal and start anew. Bukeperries are a consumable dropped by Greydwarf Shamans and Fuling Shamans . Eating one applies Feeling sick for 15 seconds: no health or stamina regeneration, movement speed cut in half, and a tick every 2 seconds that costs 1 health and clears one active food. A full three-food slate therefore empties in 6 seconds for 3 damage, and the removed buffs are lost rather than banked. Rotten Meat triggers the same effect and is easier to come by later on.

KnifeButcher.d: A butcher's knife designed specifically for slaughtering tamed animals. Butcher Knife is a one-handed knife forged at the Forge from 2 Wood and 4 Tin . It deals 1000 damage but only to tamed creatures, which makes it the one way to slaughter your own animals without switching friendly fire on. The primary attack is a three-hit chain at 5 stamina a swing with double damage on the last hit, and there is no secondary attack. It has 200 durability and no upgrade levels.

CandleWick.d: Steep these in something flammable for a long lasting and cosy light source.

CapeOdin.d: Oden's finest warriors deserve the finest cloth. Cape of Oden is a promotional shoulder item that cannot be obtained in a normal game. It went out as a Steam code to players who signed up for the Valheim beta before launch, and for owners the recipe unlocks once Leather Scraps and Coal have been discovered. Crafting it takes 10 leather scraps, 4 coal and one Bronze Protection Idol at the Workbench. At 1 armour, rising by 1 per upgrade on 1500 durability, it is a cosmetic piece.

Carapace.d: A plate of chitinous armour. Carapace is a material dropped by Seekers and Seeker Soldiers in the Mistlands. It weighs 2 and stacks to 50, and unlike every other heavy armour material it can be carried through a portal. It is the base of the carapace armour set, Carapace Shield , Carapace Arrow and Carapace Bolt .

ArrowCarapace.d: Heavy and pointy, this one's gonna hurt.

ArmorCarapaceChest.d: A breastplate crafted from the burnished carapace of a giant insect.

ShieldCarapaceBuckler.d: The skull of a seeker is solid but not heavy, which makes it perfect for a small and agile shield. Carapace Buckler is a buckler crafted at the Black Forge from 16 Carapace , 3 Scale Hide , 10 Refined Eitr and one Black Marble Protection Idol . It blocks for 78, carries 10 blunt damage, has 250 durability, upgrades to quality 3 and trains Blocking. Its 2.5x parry bonus gives it the highest parry armour of any shield in the game, at the cost of 18 block power against the Carapace Shield . It weighs 5 and costs 5% movement speed.

ArmorCarapaceLegs.d: Leg guards of a rigid carapace.

HelmetCarapace.d: People might say you look like a giant ant. But they will only say it once.

ShieldCarapace.d: The almost unbreakable carapace of your enemies makes an excellent shield. Carapace Shield is a round shield crafted at the Black Forge from 20 Carapace , 3 Scale Hide , 10 Refined Eitr and one Black Marble Protection Idol . It blocks for 96, carries 10 blunt damage, has 250 durability, upgrades to quality 3 and trains Blocking. It blocks 18 more than the Carapace Buckler and parries for less. It weighs 5 and costs 5% movement speed.

SpearCarapace.d: Sharpened to jagged perfection, this spear is sure to be deadly. Carapace Spear is a one-handed spear crafted at the Black Forge from 10 Yggdrasil Wood , 4 Carapace , 2 Mandible and one Black Marble Battle Idol . It deals 115 pierce, blocks for 48, trains Spears and holds 250 durability over four quality levels, gaining 6 pierce per level. The primary attack is a thrust with 1.9 meters of reach at 16 stamina; the secondary throws the spear itself for 1.5x damage at 18 stamina and leaves it on the ground to be picked up. Spears backstab for 3x and cost 5% movement speed to carry.

Carrot.d: An orange treat. Food Health 10 Stamina 32 Regen 1 hp/tick Duration 15 min

CarrotSeeds.d: Plant these if you like carrots...

CarrotSoup.d: A warm tasty soup made of mostly carrots. Carrot Soup is a Black Forest-tier food cooked in a level 1 cauldron from one Mushroom and 3 Carrot . It gives 15 health and 45 stamina for 25 minutes, with a health regeneration value of 2, and 45 is the highest stamina of any food available at that point. Each bowl weighs 1 and they stack to 10. Food Health 15 Stamina 45 Regen 2 hp/tick Duration 25 min

HelmetCelebration.d: You simply can't help but feel happy when donning this cap!

CelestialFeather.d: The only remnant of the fallen valkyrie's former self.

CeramicPlate.d: No matter how hot this gets, the other side of it remains strangely cool.

Chain.d: A link of iron chain. Chain is a material dropped by Wraiths and found in the chests of swamp ruins, burial chambers and Black Forest towers, with more from the furniture inside Morkhalla. It weighs 2 and stacks to 50. There is no recipe for it, so every link has to be looted.

CharcoalResin.d: The resin from a tree that was set ablaze a long time ago. It's still ready to burn some more.

ArrowCharred.d: This arrow has been whittled into shape from a charred femur, and it's as hard as any metal.

BoltCharred.d: A sturdy bone from a forearm, shaped into a deadly bolt.

CharredBone.d: Followed by the distinct smell of burnt meat.

CharredCogwheel.d: This could be used for some clever machinery... Charred Cogwheel is a machinery material found in the Charred Fortresses of the Ashlands, dropped by Skugg and by the charred ballistae mounted there when those are destroyed. Building a catapult is what consumes it. A regular portal refuses the cogwheel and only a Portal Stone will move it, so at 5 weight with 10 to a stack every one of them is carried home by hand or by ship.

Charredskull.d: The blackened skull of a long-dead warrior. It's unlikely that a proper burial would grant them any peace.

ChickenMeat.d: All chickens bear the ancestral curse of being delicious. Chicken Meat is a raw food dropped by Chickens and Hens , both of which are tame and drop nothing until they are killed. Raw it gives 35 health, 12 stamina and 2 health regen over 20 minutes. Either cooking station turns it into Cooked Chicken Meat , or Coal if it is left on too long. Recipes that call for the raw meat will not accept the cooked version. Food Health 35 Stamina 12 Regen 2 hp/tick Duration 20 min

Chitin.d: A shard of crustacean shell. Chitin is a crafting material mined from the abyssal barnacles growing on Leviathan backs out in the Ocean, and it also drops from Coral Cod caught on heavy fishing bait. It stacks to 50 at 2 weight each and can be carried through a portal. It is the material for the Abyssal Harpoon , the Abyssal Razor and Fins of Destiny .

Cloudberry.d: The gold of the forest. Food Health 13 Stamina 40 Regen 1 hp/tick Duration 15 min

Club.d: A crude but useful weapon. Club is a one-handed blunt weapon built from 6 Wood and one Wooden Battle Idol , with 5 Bone Fragments per upgrade level. It deals 12 blunt, blocks for 3, trains Clubs and has 100 durability. The primary attack is a three-swing chain at 6 stamina a swing with double damage on the last hit, and unlike later clubs it has no secondary attack. Each quality level adds 6 blunt, reaching 30 at quality 4, and carrying it costs 5% movement speed.

FishingBaitCave.d: This bait doesn't look like much, but it's a treat to fish that live where it's cold and dark.

CookedAsksvinMeat.d: This meat has a potent and mature flavour, but is very tasty when grilled right. Food Health 70 Stamina 24 Regen 6 hp/tick Duration 20 min

CookedBjornMeat.d: Tastes like victory. Food Health 40 Stamina 13 Regen 2 hp/tick Duration 20 min

CookedMeat.d: An earthly taste. Cooked Boar Meat is Boar Meat grilled on a cooking station, and it also turns up in Black Forest loot spawns. It gives 30 health and 10 stamina for 20 minutes with 2 health regen. Boar can be penned and bred, which makes this the first food you can produce at home instead of hunting for. It stacks to 20 at 1 weight each. Food Health 30 Stamina 10 Regen 2 hp/tick Duration 20 min

CookedBoneMawSerpentMeat.d: The boiling sea did nothing to this meat, but grilling it over the fire has given it a delightful crisp. Cooked Bonemaw Meat is Bonemaw Meat grilled on a cooking station, the meat cut from Bonemaw serpents in the Ashlands ocean. It gives 90 health and 30 stamina for 25 minutes with 6 health regen. It stacks to 50 but weighs 10 a piece, ten times what the grilled meats of the early biomes weigh. Food Health 90 Stamina 30 Regen 6 hp/tick Duration 25 min

CookedChickenMeat.d: It tastes like chicken. Food Health 60 Stamina 20 Regen 5 hp/tick Duration 20 min

CookedDeerMeat.d: All that running paid off. Cooked Deer Meat is Deer Meat grilled on a cooking station, so it is available as soon as you can kill a Deer and light a fire. It gives 35 health and 12 stamina for 20 minutes with 2 health regen. It stacks to 20 at 1 weight each. Food Health 35 Stamina 12 Regen 2 hp/tick Duration 20 min

CookedEgg.d: Sunny side up! Food Health 35 Stamina 12 Regen 2 hp/tick Duration 20 min

FishCooked.d: A tasty side of smoked fish. Food Health 45 Stamina 15 Regen 2 hp/tick Duration 20 min

CookedHareMeat.d: Stringy but flavorful. Food Health 60 Stamina 20 Regen 5 hp/tick Duration 20 min

CookedLoxMeat.d: A great hunk of tender meat, food fit for Valhalla! Food Health 50 Stamina 16 Regen 4 hp/tick Duration 20 min

CookedBugMeat.d: Succulent white meat. A true delicacy. Food Health 60 Stamina 20 Regen 5 hp/tick Duration 20 min

SerpentMeatCooked.d: A cooked slice of sea serpent. Smells good. Food Health 70 Stamina 23 Regen 3 hp/tick Duration 25 min

CookedVoltureMeat.d: A chewy and somewhat dry meat. Some seasoning would probably make it taste better, but it'll fill your stomach regardless. Food Health 70 Stamina 24 Regen 6 hp/tick Duration 20 min

CookedWolfMeat.d: A wild taste. Food Health 45 Stamina 15 Regen 3 hp/tick Duration 20 min

Copper.d: A bar of pure copper ready to be worked. Copper is a metal bar smelted from Copper Ore or Copper Scrap in a smelter. Two copper and one Tin at a forge make Bronze . It stacks to 30 and weighs 12 a bar, and like every metal it cannot be carried through a portal. Ancient chests hold it as loot.

KnifeCopper.d: A glittering copper knife. Copper Knife is a one-handed knife forged at the Forge from 2 Wood , 8 Copper and one Bronze Battle Idol . It deals 12 slash and 12 pierce, blocks for 2, and trains Knives. The primary attack is a three-hit chain at 6 stamina a swing; the secondary is a forward leap for triple damage at 18. Backstabs deal 6 times damage. Upgrading costs 4 copper and 8 Greydwarf Eye a level, the eyes being something the base recipe never asks for, and quality 4 brings it to 15 of each damage type at 200 durability.

CopperOre.d: Unrefined copper. Needs to be refined in a smelter. Copper Ore is the unrefined form of Copper , mined out of copper deposits in the Black Forest with any pickaxe. The deposits look like ordinary boulders apart from faint bronze streaks that catch the light, and most of the rock sits below ground level, so finishing one means digging a pit rather than flattening it to the surface. Smelting gives copper, and two of those with one Tin at a forge make Bronze . It stacks to 30, weighs 10 a piece and cannot go through a portal.

CopperScrap.d: One person's scrap is another person's treasure.

RoundLog.d: Perfect for building log cabins. Corewood is a building and crafting material cut from pine trees. Its support value is higher than that of Wood , so corewood beams and poles hold up taller and wider structures. It is also the handle material for the Bronze Pickaxe and Iron Pickaxe , 3 per craft.

BlobVial.d: Thick enough to contain something volatile, yet fragile enough to be shattered.

Bow.d: A crude but functional bow. Crude Bow is a bow crafted at the workbench from 10 Wood , 8 Leather Scraps and one Wooden Battle Idol . It deals 22 pierce, trains Bows, has 50 durability and costs 5% movement speed to carry. It upgrades to quality 4, adding 3 pierce a level to reach 31, with Deer Hide needed from the first upgrade on. Charging a shot raises its damage, accuracy and arrow speed, though even a full draw scatters badly.

Crystal.d: A shard of crystal from deep within the earth. Crystal is a material dropped by Stone Golem and Frost Blob , and picked from crystal growths inside Mountain caves. It stacks to 50 at 1 weight each and can be carried through a portal. It is the material for the Crystal Battleaxe and for crystal walls, the transparent building piece.

BattleaxeCrystal.d: It's see-through and tears through. Crystal Battleaxe is a two-handed axe forged at the Forge from 40 Ancient Bark , 30 Silver , 10 Crystal and one Silver Battle Idol , with the crystal taken from stone golems in the Mountains. It deals 90 slash, 50 chop and 30 spirit, blocks for 40 and has 200 durability, gaining 6 slash and 2.5 chop a level while the spirit damage stays at 30. That spirit component only pays off against undead, so against anything living it sits between the Battleaxe and the Black Metal Battleaxe . The primary is a three-swing chain with double damage on the last hit and no

TrinketSilverResist.d: A shard of frozen sorrow. Touching it makes you feel almost numb. Crystal Heart is a Mountain-tier trinket forged at the Forge from 5 Silver , 5 Crystal and one Stone Golem Trophy , two of which a stone golem drops itself. It fires at 80 adrenaline and cuts incoming blunt, slash and pierce damage by 25% for 50 seconds, flat mitigation rather than a skill buff. The reduction does not stack with Bonemass ' forsaken power, so triggering both at once throws one of them away.

TrophyCultist.d: My, what big teeth it has...

Cultivator.d: A farming tool for tilling soil. Cultivator is a farming tool made at the Forge from 5 Corewood , 5 Bronze and one Wooden Battle Idol . It tills soil for crops, plants tree seeds, and in grass mode restores grass, sand, lily pads and cattails on damaged ground. Each use costs 5 stamina and 1 durability out of 200, and the tool upgrades to quality 3. Crops planted with it need cultivated soil, open sky and a clear square around them, which includes rocks buried under the surface.

CuredSquirrelHamstring.d: Elastic and strong. This tendon must have come from a quick and agile animal.

AxeHead1.d: The metal glints oddly in the sunlight. Somehow, you know that it can never be complete on its own...

Dandelion.d: Some call it a weed, but it's pretty nonetheless.

StaffSkeleton.d: Sacrifice a bit of blood to raise the dead. Upgrade the skull to spawn multiple skeletons, and increase your blood magic to make them stronger. Dead Raiser is a two-handed blood magic staff crafted at the Galdr table from 10 Bone Fragments , 16 Refined Eitr , 4 Skeleton Trophy and one Black Marble Battle Idol . Each cast raises a Skelett to fight for you at 100 eitr and 40% of your current health. It blocks for 48, weighs 0.3, has 200 durability and upgrades to quality 4, with the higher levels summoning more skeletons at once. Blood Magic is the skill it trains and the one that decides how st

TrophyDeathsquito.d: You don't like touching this thing even when it's dead.

DeerHide.d: A cleaned hide from a deer. Deer Hide drops from Deer and is found in Troll cave chests in the Black Forest. It can also be knocked out of Fuling village roofs and banners in the Plains, which is the fastest source once you are that far. It stacks to 50 at 1 weight each. It is the hide for the first armour set and for the Finewood Bow .

DeerMeat.d: Deer Meat is a raw food dropped by Deer and white deer . Raw it gives 20 health and 20 stamina with 1 health regen for 10 minutes, and either cooking station turns it into Cooked Deer Meat . Unlike most meats it cannot go into a recipe raw, so any recipe that uses deer meat wants the cooked form. Food Health 20 Stamina 20 Regen 1 hp/tick Duration 10 min

DeerStew.d: Fall-apart tender. Deer Stew is cooked in a Cauldron from 1 Cooked Deer Meat , 1 Blueberries and 1 Carrot . It gives 45 health and 15 stamina for 25 minutes with 3 health regen, five minutes longer than the grilled meat that goes into it. It stacks to 10 at 1 weight each. Food Health 45 Stamina 15 Regen 3 hp/tick Duration 25 min

TrophyDeer.d: A fine specimen, but you'll need to kill more than deer to enter Valhalla.

SledgeDemolisher.d: This mighty sledge yearns to wreak havoc. Demolisher is a two-handed club crafted at the Black Forge from 10 Yggdrasil Wood , 20 Iron , 10 Refined Eitr and one Black Marble Battle Idol . It deals 145 blunt, blocks for 52, trains Clubs and holds 250 durability over four quality levels, gaining 6 blunt per level. Its only attack is a ground slam costing 28 stamina that hits everything within four meters, staggering at double rate and knocking targets back; there is no secondary attack. Wielding it costs 15% movement speed and it backstabs for 2x.

DragonEgg.d: Far heavier than it looks, with a faint humming sound from within. Dragon Egg is a summoning item picked from Drake nests on the Mountain peaks. Three of them are needed at the altar to summon Moder , and nothing else in the game consumes them. Each egg weighs 200, does not stack and cannot pass through a portal, so all three have to cross the map by foot, cart or boat.

DragonTear.d: The last frozen tear of a dragon, pulsating with mysterious energy.

HelmetDrake.d: An elaborate and finely-crafted helm. Drake Helmet is a helmet forged at the Forge from 20 Silver , 2 Wolf Pelt , 2 Drake Trophy and one Silver Protection Idol . It gives 20 armour and 1000 durability, and upgrades to quality 4 at 5 more silver a level for 26 armour. It carries no movement penalty, unlike the Wolf Hide Chestpiece and Wolf Hide Trousers it is usually worn beside.

MeadSwimmer.d: You feel invigorated just by holding this, as the ocean beckons you to come for a swim. Draught of Vananidir is a Swamp-tier consumable fermented from Mead Base: Vananidir , six bottles from one base after two in-game days. It cuts the stamina cost of swimming by 50% for five minutes and leaves swimming speed untouched. Speed in water comes from Tonic of Ratatosk instead, at 7.5%.

TrophyDraugrElite.d: The dead stare of the glowing red eyes sends a shiver through your bones.

BowDraugrFang.d: Dark wood strung with glistening sinew. A vicious thing. Draugr Fang is a bow crafted at the forge from 10 Ancient Bark , 20 Silver , 2 Deer Hide , 10 Guck and one Iron Battle Idol . It deals 47 pierce and 5 poison, trains Bows, has 100 durability and costs 5% movement speed to carry. Each quality level adds 3 pierce and 5 poison, so at quality 4 it fires for 56 pierce and 20 poison, the poison rider applying to whatever arrow is nocked.

TrophyDraugr.d: Bind up the mouth if it starts to whisper in the night...

TrophyDraugrFem.d: Trophy Trophy Draugr Trophy Bind up the mouth if it starts to whisper in the night...

DvergrNeedle.d: Looks like a perfect piece for piercing something... Dvergr Extractor is a material found in Dvergr component crates in inhabited Mistlands settlements, including excavation sites and guard towers. It is the key component of the Sap extractor. Breaking a crate directly turns every nearby Dvergr Rogue hostile, while destroying it indirectly, by ramming it with a cart or luring a hostile creature into it, leaves them neutral. Extractors weigh 5, stack to 10 and will not go through an ordinary portal, only a stone one.

Lantern.d: A simple torch would just be so old fashioned.

Tankard_dvergr.d: It can hold a lot of mead! Dvergr Tankard is a one-handed drinking horn with no recipe of its own, picked up off the tables in Dvergr guard towers and lighthouses in the Mistlands and looted from Dvergr treasure chests in Infested Mines. It blocks for 4, weighs 1, caps at quality 1 and drinks a mead from your inventory instead of attacking, the same as the crafted Tankard . Seven of its spawn points sit on the lower floor of the Infested Citadel exterior, and five of those roll better odds than an ordinary Dvergr structure. In worlds generated before patch 0.213.4 the pickable version sinks th

TrophyDvergr.d: It's frankly a little troubling that you would consider hanging these on your wall...

SwordDyrnwyn.d: The sword that was broken is whole once more. Its flames burn hot, fuelled by the memories of ancient warriors. Dyrnwyn is a one-handed sword forged at the Black Forge from one Dyrnwyn Hilt Fragment , one Dyrnwyn Blade Fragment , one Dyrnwyn Tip Fragment , 20 Flametal , one Bloodstone and one Flametal Battle Idol . One fragment sits in each of the three Mysterious Locations and none of them respawn, so at default loot settings a world holds the makings of exactly one Dyrnwyn. It deals 145 slash and 10 fire, blocks for 57, trains Swords and has 300 durability, gaining 6 slash a level to reach 1

SwordIronFire.d: Swamp tier One Handed Weapon Dyrnwyn Unsheathed, it sizzles and spits with deathless fire, an impossible blade.

DyrnwynBladeFragment.d: Parts of an old blade. If all the pieces were reassembled it could likely be made whole.

DyrnwynHiltFragment.d: The hilt of a long forgotten sword. Perhaps it could be reforged if one had all the pieces...

StaffLightning.d: What happens next may shock you. Dundr is a two-handed elemental staff crafted at the Galdr table from 10 Ashwood , 4 Flametal , 3 Celestial Feather , one Bloodstone and one Flametal Battle Idol . Each shot is a short-range grapeshot of 12 bolts dealing 20 lightning each, rising 3 per quality level, followed by a 1.9 second reload. Eitr drains gradually through that reload; walking and jumping are fine but sprinting cancels it. It holds 300 durability, blocks for 48, trains Elemental Magic and has no secondary attack.

DyrnwynTipFragment.d: This shard of metal looks like the tip of a sword. One might be able to reforge the blade if more pieces are found...

AxeEarly.d: Mighty weapons from long ago, from a time when the world was still young and incomplete... Early Axes are a dual-wielded two-handed pair assembled at the Workbench from 4 Wood , one Curious Axe Head , one Mysterious Axe Head and one Iron Battle Idol , with Leather Scraps needed only for the upgrades at 2 per level. They deal 30 slash and 35 chop, block for just 4 and have 175 durability, gaining 5 slash and 3 chop a level to reach 45 slash at quality 4. The primary is a four-step chain at 6 stamina a swing and the secondary hits for 1.5x damage at 12, both cheap enough to run on an early stami

Ectoplasm.d: Material Ectoplasm A restless essence of a once living thing...

ChickenEgg.d: Keep it warm to see what comes out.. but what came first, really? Egg is a food item sold by Haldor and found in tower chests. Eaten raw it gives 10 health and 30 stamina for 10 minutes with 2 health regen, and boiling one in a Cauldron makes Cooked Egg . To hatch it instead, drop a single egg on its own, not a stack, near a fire and under a roof; after about 30 minutes it becomes a Chicken that grows into a Hen . It stacks to 20 and weighs 1 each. Food Health 10 Stamina 30 Regen 2 hp/tick Duration 10 min

TrophyEikthyr.d: This severed head oozes power. Offer it to the Sacrificial Stones.

HelmetMage.d: Sorcery shows itself in the eyes, so most mages wear cowls to disguise their occult pursuits.

ArmorMageChest.d: These artfully layered robes have spells and charms sewn into every seam and fold.

ArmorMageLegs.d: The trousers worn by mages are always especially tight. Discomfort fuels the focus that is needed for magic...

Entrails.d: A slimy length of something's insides. Entrails is a material dropped by Draugr and Draugr Elite , sleeping ones included, so a crypt cleared before anything wakes still pays out. A destroyed training dummy drops them as well. Meat piles hand them over with no fight at all, in Mountain frost caves and in the Ashlands putrid holes. They weigh 0.5, stack to 50 and teleport.

TrinketBlackStamina.d: Dance with death as you dodge your enemies' strikes. Evasion Mantle is a Plains-tier trinket forged at the Forge from 5 Black Metal , 10 Linen Thread and one Fuling Berserker Trophy . It fires at 60 adrenaline and runs for 120 seconds, halving block stamina cost, raising the parry bonus by 50% and adding 20 Dodge skill. The parry half multiplies the shield's own parry bonus instead of adding to it, so it returns more on a shield that already parries well. That 120 second window is twice what most trinkets give.

BombSiege.d: Best used with a catapult. Handle with care. Explosive Payload is catapult ammunition crafted 5 at a time at the Workbench from 2 Asksvin Hide , 2 Sulfur and 3 Proustite Powder . It explodes on impact for pure, chop and pickaxe damage inside a 3 metre radius, which flattens any structure that can take damage and reshapes the terrain under it. Loading it into a catapult is its only use. Payloads stack to 50 and pass through portals, so a siege can be packed at home.

HelmetHat4.d: A warm cap for special occasions.

HelmetHat9.d: A warm cap for special occasions.

Eyescream.d: Crispy cool and creamy. Eyescream is a Mountain-tier food cooked in a level 3 Cauldron from 3 Greydwarf Eye and 1 Freeze Gland . It gives 65 stamina against only 21 health for 25 minutes, with 1 health regen, so it fills a stamina slot rather than a health one. Freeze glands come from the drakes circling the Mountains, which is what ties the dish to that biome. It stacks to 10 at 0.5 weight each. Food Health 21 Stamina 65 Regen 1 hp/tick Duration 25 min

FaderDrop.d: The mystical power will be revealed another day.

TrophyFader.d: The green dragon, corrupted beyond redemption. Offer him to the sacrificial stones.

TrophyFallenValkyrie.d: Though she is dead, she yearns for the blood to flow.

SpearWolfFang.d: Even in death, the wolf's tooth aches for flesh. Fang Spear is a one-handed spear crafted at the Forge from 10 Ancient Bark , 4 Wolf Fang , 2 Leather Scraps , 2 Silver and one Silver Battle Idol . It deals 75 pierce, blocks for 30, trains Spears and holds 100 durability over four quality levels, gaining 6 pierce per level. The primary attack is a thrust with 1.9 meters of reach at 12 stamina; the secondary throws the spear itself for 1.5x damage at 14 stamina and leaves it on the ground to be picked up. Spears backstab for 3x and cost 5% movement speed to carry.

CapeFeather.d: Donning this cape makes you feel lighter, almost as if you could fly! Feather Cape is a cape crafted at the Galdr Table from 10 Feathers , 5 Scale Hide , 20 Refined Eitr and one Black Marble Protection Idol . It gives 1 armour, rising by 1 a quality level to 4 at quality 4, and has 1200 durability. It grants Feather fall, which removes all fall damage and caps falling speed at 5 m/s, so you can glide off the tall rocks of the Mistlands instead of climbing back down. It resists frost but takes extra fire damage, which is worth remembering around a Gjall or a fire Dvergr Mage .

Feathers.d: A small pile of feathers. Feathers are the fletching material for arrows, dropped by birds: Crow , Seagull , Chicken , Hen , Volture and Ash Crow . Chests in meadows ruins, ship settings, half-buried crypts and Deep North huts hold them as well. They stack to 50 and weigh 0.1 each.

TrophyFenring.d: A strange, elongated paw, its claws razor sharp.

WolfClaw.d: It is hard and sharp like iron.

ArmorFenringChest.d: The beast could draw deep breaths, so that its howl could be heard far across the land. Fenris Coat is a chest armour piece crafted at the Workbench from 20 Fenris Hair , 5 Wolf Pelt , 10 Leather Scraps and one Silver Protection Idol . It gives 10 armour, 2 more per quality level to 16 at quality 4, on 1000 durability. It adds 3% movement speed rather than taking any away, and with Fenris Leggings and the Fenris Hood it completes the Fenris set. It is resistant to frost, which is what makes the set wearable in the Mountains despite its low armour.

WolfHairBundle.d: A bundle of thick, rough hair. It has a strong smell.

HelmetFenring.d: The eyes of the beast were wise and knowing, so that it could measure the strength of a warrior in one glance. Fenris Hood is a helmet crafted at the Workbench from 20 Fenris Hair , 2 Wolf Pelt , one Cultist Trophy and one Silver Protection Idol . It gives 10 armour on 1000 durability, 2 more per level for 16 at quality 4, and it adds 3% movement speed rather than costing any. The cultist trophy is a one-off for the initial craft, while the three upgrades want 30 more Fenris Hair and 24 more wolf pelts. It completes the set with Fenris Coat and Fenris Leggings .

ArmorFenringLegs.d: The legs of the beast were lean and strong, so that it could leap great strides. Fenris Leggings is a leg armour piece crafted at the Workbench from 20 Fenris Hair , 5 Wolf Pelt , 10 Leather Scraps and one Silver Protection Idol , matching the coat's recipe exactly. It gives 10 armour and 2 per quality level, reaching 16 at quality 4. Its 3% movement bonus stacks with the Fenris Coat for 6% from the two pieces, where the silver-tier Wolf Hide Trousers take 5% off instead.

Fiddleheadfern.d: Veggies with a twist! Fiddlehead is a raw Ashlands food picked from fern bushes in charred ruins, three to a pick, respawning every 5 hours. Raw it gives 30 health and 30 stamina with 1 health regen for 15 minutes, and it is the vegetable in several Ashlands recipes. The fiddlehead itself cannot be destroyed and keeps coming back whether or not its bush is still standing. That bush has 30 health, drops 1 to 2 Wood , and is weak to chop, resistant to pierce and immune to fire, poison and spirit. Food Health 30 Stamina 30 Regen 1 hp/tick Duration 15 min

SpiceAshlands.d: Whatever spices have been used in this blend, they must come from someplace hot. And as if that wasn't enough, they have also been dried and smoked before being ground into a fine powder.

FierySvinstew.d: This musty stew is a necessity on every adventurer's menu. Fiery Svinstew is an Ashlands food cooked at a level 5 Cauldron from one Asksvin Tail , 2 Vineberry Clusters and one Smoke Puff . It gives 95 health against only 32 stamina, with 6 health regen over 25 minutes. Only Mashed Meat and Piquant Pie restore more health than that. Food Health 95 Stamina 32 Regen 6 hp/tick Duration 25 min

FineWood.d: High quality wood for fine carpentry. Finewood is the lumber from birch and oak trees, which need at least a Bronze Axe to fell. Shipwrecks, ruined tower furniture and dvergr crates give it up to a stone axe, so it can be stockpiled before the bronze tier if you go looking. It stacks to 50 at 2 weight each and can be carried through a portal. Bows, boats and most furniture are built from it.

BowFineWood.d: A simple bow of strong and supple wood. Finewood Bow is a bow crafted at the workbench from 10 Finewood , 10 Corewood , 2 Deer Hide and one Bronze Battle Idol . It deals 32 pierce, trains Bows, has 100 durability and costs 5% movement speed to carry. It upgrades to quality 4, adding 3 pierce a level to reach 41. Like every bow it has no secondary attack, and charging a shot raises damage, accuracy and arrow speed.

FirCone.d: Plant it to grow a fir tree.

ArrowFire.d: This arrow burns whatever it pierces.

BarleyWine.d: Fortifies you against fire. Fire Resistance Barley Wine is a consumable made by fermenting Barley Wine Base: Fire Resistance , which takes two in-game days and yields six bottles per base. Drinking one reduces incoming fire damage for 600 seconds. It stacks to 10 and weighs 1 each, so one stack covers 100 minutes of protection.

FishAndBread.d: Consumable Fish 'n' Bread Bounty from both land and sea. Fish 'n' Bread is a Mistlands food baked from Uncooked Fish 'n' Bread , which comes off the food preparation table and then needs 50 seconds in a stone oven. It is a stamina food, at 90 stamina against 30 health, with 3 health regen over 30 minutes. Left in the oven for 100 seconds it burns down to Coal . Food Health 30 Stamina 90 Regen 3 hp/tick Duration 30 min

FishWraps.d: Bread and fish, what more to wish? Fish Wraps are cooked in a level 4 Cauldron from 2 Cooked Fish and 4 Barley Flour . They give 70 health and 23 stamina for 25 minutes with 4 health regen, putting them among the strongest Plains health foods. Barley only grows in the Plains and the fish have to be caught with a rod, so the cost is time rather than danger. They stack to 10 at 1 weight each. Food Health 70 Stamina 23 Regen 4 hp/tick Duration 25 min

FishingBait.d: Common dvergr fishing bait. Fishing rod sold separately.

FishingRod.d: Standard issue dvergr fishing rod. Fishing Rod is a two-handed tool bought from Haldor, and one can also be found lying at Dvergr sites. Casting throws the line up to 30 meters depending on how long the button is held and consumes one Fishing Bait , while blocking reels the bobber in with whatever is hooked; bait is returned if the line comes back empty. Each biome has its own bait, and the bait decides which fish bite. Swung as a weapon it does 5 blunt and blocks for 5, and it weighs 1.5.

FlametalNew.d: According to legend, this metal was used by the gods themselves to craft powerful weapons. Flametal is the metal bar smelted from Flametal Ore in a blast furnace with Coal as fuel. It stacks to 30 and weighs 12 a bar, and like every metal it cannot be carried through a portal, so the smelting has to happen near where you mine. It is the metal behind the Ashlands weapon tier, including the Ripper and its gemstone forms.

ArmorFlametalChest.d: This fusion of mysterious flametal and charred bones serves as a protective layer more resilient than anything you could ever find in Midgard.

ArmorFlametalLegs.d: Heavy trousers insulate against the heat, while solid greaves keep your shins safe from low blows.

HelmetFlametal.d: While you're wearing this helmet, your enemies will think twice before trying to bite your head off.

MaceEldner.d: Dense yet spiked flametal, perfect for bashing enemy faces in. Flametal Mace is a one-handed club forged at the Black Forge from 10 Charred Bone , 15 Flametal , 5 Sulfur , 3 Asksvin Hide and one Flametal Battle Idol . It deals 135 blunt, blocks for 57 and trains Clubs. The primary attack is a three-swing chain with double damage on the last hit at 16 stamina a swing; the slower secondary comes down for 2.5 times damage and double stagger at 28. Wielding it costs 5% movement speed, and it upgrades to quality 4 at 8 more flametal a level for 153 blunt at 300 durability. Fitting a gemstone at the

TurretBoltFlametal.d: Forged from one of the hardest metals in all of Valheim, this missile is sure to hold off your enemies.

FlametalOreNew.d: Warm to the touch with glowing veins of strange metal. Needs to be refined in a blast furnace. Flametal Ore is mined in the Ashlands from flametal veins, including the ones riding on lava leviathans, which sink once you start working them. Charred chests in fortresses, dvergr crates in the charred ruins and Magmafish also yield it. It smelts into Flametal in a blast furnace. It stacks to 30, weighs 10 a piece and cannot be carried through a portal.

ShieldFlametal.d: The shield is and always will be a viking's most important weapon. Flametal Shield is a round shield crafted at the Black Forge from 10 Ashwood , 8 Flametal , 2 Asksvin Hide and one Flametal Protection Idol . It blocks for 114, carries 10 blunt damage, has 300 durability, upgrades to quality 3 and trains Blocking. That is the highest block power of any shield that can still parry. It weighs 5 and costs 5% movement speed.

ShieldFlametalTower.d: The best defence is a great defence. Flametal Tower Shield is a tower shield crafted at the Black Forge from 15 Ashwood , 10 Flametal , 5 Asksvin Hide and one Flametal Protection Idol . It blocks for 140, the highest in the game, carries 10 damage, has 300 durability and upgrades to quality 3. Like every tower shield it cannot parry, and it costs 10% movement speed and 10% more stamina per dodge roll.

Flax.d: Unspun fibers from a flax plant. Flax is a Plains crop found growing inside Fuling villages, where it is picked by hand rather than cut. Replanting it on cultivated soil is the only way to farm it, and it will not grow outside the Plains. Spun at a spinning wheel it becomes Linen Thread , the thread behind padded armour and black metal gear. 2 each.

FistFenrirClaw.d: If claws work for wolves, why not for a viking? Flesh Rippers are fist weapons forged from 10 Fenris Hair , 6 Fenris Claw , 10 Silver and one Silver Battle Idol . They deal 60 slash, block for 5, train Unarmed and have 300 durability, gaining 4 slash per quality level to quality 4. The primary attack is a two-hit chain at 10 stamina a swing with double damage on the second hit, and the kick costs 20 stamina, adds knockback and staggers for 6x. They are meant to be worn with the Fenris set, whose bonus raises unarmed damage, and backstabs do 6x.

Flint.d: Can be shaped into sharp blades. Flint is a material picked off the shorelines of the Meadows, the only terrain that grows it, and a picked node returns to the same spot after 4 hours. It also sits in chests inside abandoned wood houses and in barrels in Meadows ruins, and Fuling village tanning racks drop it when broken. Stacks cap at 30 instead of the usual 50 and each piece weighs 2, so kitting out with the Flint Axe and Flint Spear eats more chest space than the amounts suggest.

AxeFlint.d: Sharper than stone. Flint Axe is a one-handed axe crafted at the Workbench from 4 Wood and 6 Flint , with a Bronze Battle Idol for the recipe and 2 Leather Scraps per upgrade level. It deals 20 slash and 30 chop, blocks for 4, trains Axes and has 100 durability, gaining 5 slash and 3 chop a level. Its 30 chop still only reaches beech, fir and pine, so it is a faster woodcutter rather than access to new trees. The primary is a three-swing chain with double damage on the last hit at 6 stamina; the secondary is an overhead at 1.5x damage for 12.

KnifeFlint.d: Sharpened flint. A reliable tool. Flint Knife is a one-handed knife crafted at the Workbench from 2 Wood , 4 Flint , 2 Leather Scraps and one Wooden Battle Idol , and it is the first knife available. It deals 5 slash and 5 pierce, gaining 1 of each per upgrade level for 8 and 8 at quality 4 on 200 durability. The primary attack is a three-hit chain at 4 stamina a swing, and the secondary stabs for triple damage at 12 stamina with four times the knockback force. Like every knife it multiplies damage by 6 against a target that has not noticed you, and it blocks for only 2.

SpearFlint.d: If your eye marks a thing for death, let your arm send the messenger. Flint Spear is a one-handed spear crafted at a Workbench from 5 Wood , 10 Flint , 2 Leather Scraps and one Wooden Battle Idol , and it is the first spear available. It deals 20 pierce, blocks for 4, trains Spears and holds 100 durability over four quality levels, gaining 6 pierce per level. The primary attack is a thrust with 1.9 meters of reach at 6 stamina; the secondary throws the spear itself for 1.5x damage at 8 stamina and leaves it on the ground to be picked up. Spears backstab for 3x and cost 5% movement speed to car

ArrowFlint.d: A hide-breaker with a head of flint.

FragrantBundle.d: These plants carry a strong but pleasant scent. However, it's possible that not all creatures agree...

FreezeGland.d: This mysterious organ keeps a perfect temperature.

FreshSeaweed.d: The saltwater scent of this plant makes you think of the wide open ocean.

ArrowFrost.d: A shard of piercing ice. Frost Arrow is an arrow crafted at a level 4 Workbench 20 at a time from 8 Wood , 4 Obsidian , 2 Feathers and one Freeze Gland . It deals 26 pierce and 52 frost, so two thirds of its 78 damage sits in an element, the reverse of the split every other arrow uses. Against a frost-resistant target that leaves 26 pierce doing the work. Stacks also turn up in the chests of abandoned log cabins in the Mountains.

MeadFrostResist.d: Protects against the cold. Frost Resistance Mead is a Swamp-tier consumable fermented from Mead Base: Frost Resistance , which is brewed in a mead ketill. Two in-game days of fermenting yield six bottles, and they stack to 10. It grants frost resistance for 600 seconds, which prevents the Cold and Freezing effects outright and reduces incoming frost damage for as long as it runs.

VikingCupcake.d: A sweet and tasty treat, to celebrate a feat! Frosted Sweetbread is a Plains-tier balanced food, baked from Unbaked Sweetbread in a stone oven over 50 seconds and burning to Coal at 100 seconds if it is left in. It restores 43 health and 43 stamina, an even split, over 30 minutes at 4 health regen. It stacks to 10, so spare meals cost more inventory slots on a long trip than most cooked food does. Food Health 43 Stamina 43 Regen 4 hp/tick Duration 30 min

MaceSilver.d: The dead fear silver. Remind them why. Frostner is a one-handed club forged at the Forge from 10 Ancient Bark , 30 Silver , 5 Ymir Flesh , 5 Freeze Gland and one Silver Battle Idol . It deals 35 blunt, 40 frost and 20 spirit, blocks for 30, trains Clubs and triples backstab damage. The primary attack is a three-swing chain with double damage on the last hit at 12 stamina a swing; the secondary deals 2.5x damage and double stagger for 24. Both attacks hit every enemy in range, and the frost damage slows whatever survives. It costs 5% movement speed to carry and upgrades to quality 4, adding 6 f

FishingBaitDeepNorth.d: It's not very nutritious, so the only fish that'll take this bait are the ones that are used to just eating ice.

TrophyGoblinBrute.d: The huge grizzled head is as heavy as a boulder.

TrophyGoblinShaman.d: It shall cast no more spells against you.

GoblinTotem.d: Channels the ancient power of Yagluth.

TrophyGoblin.d: Loose folds of greenish skin gathered in around a pair of dark and hateful eyes.

TrophyCultist_Hildir.d: He's giving you an icy stare.

TrophyGhost.d: Does it still whisper about unfinished business?

FlametalOre.d: A withered metal from ancient times. No one knows what it was once used for.

SpicePlains.d: This blend utilises all aspects of the lovage plant, a rarity in the tenth world. Roots, leaves and seeds have all been gathered, and then mixed together in the perfect quantity.

Catapult_ammo.d: Best used with a catapult. Make sure nothing fragile is in the way.

HelmetHat8.d: A warm fur cap, made from the finest wool.

TrophyGreydwarfBrute.d: It took seven blows to hack this gnarled head from its body.

GreydwarfEye.d: The milky eyeball of a Greydwarf. Greydwarf Eye is a material dropped by Greydwarves , Greydwarf Brutes and Greydwarf Shamans , including their frozen variants, and found in barrels in Black Forest ruins. 2, stacks to 50 and can be carried through a portal. It is spent on building pieces, the portal among them, and on upgrades such as the Copper Knife , which takes 8 eyes per quality level.

TrophyGreydwarfShaman.d: It may try to come back so be sure to prune any new shoots...

TrophyGreydwarf.d: The mossy, severed head of a Greydwarf.

NeckTailGrilled.d: This savoury, charcoal-grilled meat has a slight aroma of seaweed and grass. Grilled Neck Tail is a Meadows-tier food made by cooking Neck Tail on a cooking station. It grants 25 health and 8 stamina for 20 minutes, with a health regeneration value of 2. 5 and stacks to 20, and it cannot stand in for raw neck tail in crafting recipes. Food Health 25 Stamina 8 Regen 2 hp/tick Duration 20 min

Guck.d: It smells like fermented fish. Guck is a material harvested from Gucksacks on the infested trees of the Swamp and dropped by Abominations . 5, stacks to 50 and can be carried through a portal. It fuels the green-burning standing torches and goes into the Draugr Fang .

Hammer.d: With this to your hand, you can raise high halls and mighty fortifications. Hammer is a tool used to place every building piece, crafting station and piece of furniture. It is made from 3 Wood , 2 Stone and one Wooden Battle Idol , needs no crafting station, and is unlocked from the start of the game. It has 100 durability and upgrades to quality 3, each level adding 1 wood and 1 stone. Right-click opens the build menu; swung as a weapon it costs 5 stamina and blocks for 10.

HardAntler.d: A piece of very hard antlers. Hard Antler is a material dropped by Eikthyr , three per kill and from no other source. It weighs 2, stacks to 50 and can be carried through a portal. One is enough for the Antler Pickaxe , the tool that unlocks Copper Ore , which makes the first boss a mining gate rather than a combat one.

HareMeat.d: The meat of a hare is scant but toothsome. Hare Meat is a raw food dropped by Hares in the Mistlands. Eaten raw it gives 35 health and 12 stamina over 20 minutes, with 2 health regen, and it weighs 1 and stacks to 20. It cooks on either a cooking station or an iron cooking station into Cooked Hare Meat , and turns to Coal if left on too long. The cooked meat counts as a separate ingredient, so recipes that call for the raw version will not accept it. Food Health 35 Stamina 12 Regen 2 hp/tick Duration 20 min

TrophyHare.d: These are said to bring luck. But not for their original owner.

ArmorHarvester2.d: When working the fields, it's important to dress accordingly. This long dress keeps your knees covered while you work. Harvest Dress is a chest piece sold by the trader Hildir once her brass chest has been recovered. It gives 1 armour and 1000 durability, gaining 1 armour per upgrade level to reach 4 at quality 4, and each level costs 6 Deer Hide plus a Wooden Protection Idol . Worn together with the Straw Hat it raises the Farming skill by 25, and the Harvest Tunic can stand in for it in that set. It weighs 10, so it is worn for the farming bonus rather than for protection.

ArmorHarvester1.d: When working the fields, it's important to dress accordingly. A shorter tunic lets in a cool breeze. Harvest Tunic is a chest garment sold by Hildir once Hildir's Brass Chest has been recovered for her, rather than crafted from a recipe. It gives 1 armour and 1 more per quality level, reaching 4 at quality 4, and each upgrade takes Deer Hide and a Wooden Protection Idol . Worn with the Straw Hat it raises the Farming skill by 25, and the Harvest Dress substitutes for it in that pair.

HelmetBerserkerHood.d: Trophy and one Black Marble Protection Idol . It gives 7 armour, holds 1000 durability and carries no movement penalty. It upgrades to quality 4 at 2 more bear hide a level, adding 2 armour each time to reach 13. The set bonus needs it worn with Patterns of the Bear and Loincloth of the Bear , so the head slot cannot be swapped for something sturdier without giving the bonus up.

TrinketBronzeHealth.d: It pulsates with fragments of ancient life. Heart of the Forest is a Black Forest-tier trinket forged at the Forge from 5 Bronze , 5 Ancient Seed and one Greydwarf Shaman Trophy . It fires at 50 adrenaline and gives 25% health regeneration for 60 seconds, one of the first two trinkets a character can build. Regeneration is not a heal, so a health bar already emptied by one hit gets very little out of the 60 seconds. The seeds and the trophy both come off greydwarf nests and shamans, which is the same trip.

FeastMountains.d: Mountain Logger's Stew Consumable Hearty Mountain Logger's Stew Food Health 45 Stamina 45 Regen 3 hp/tick Duration 50 min

FishingBaitOcean.d: This bait sinks deep, deep enough to lure the fish swimming along the very bottom of the sea.

SpiceMistlands.d: A good herbalist knows exactly where to go to find ramsons, but she won't tell you the secrets of her trade! Still, if you have the coin for it you may treat yourself to this blend of finely harvested ramson bulbs and leaves.

chest_hildir1.d: Property of Hildir, please return if found.
