HildirKey_forestcrypt.d: It seems to be missing its owner...

chest_hildir3.d: Property of Hildir, please return if found.

HildirKey_plainsfortress.d: It seems to be missing its owner...

chest_hildir2.d: Property of Hildir, please return if found.

HildirKey_mountaincave.d: It seems to be missing its owner...

Hoe.d: A farmer's tool for working the earth. Hoe is a tool crafted at the Workbench from 5 Wood , 2 Stone and one Wooden Battle Idol . It has 200 durability and upgrades to quality 3, each level adding 1 wood and 1 stone. Right-click opens its menu of ground operations: levelling, raising, and the path and paved road surfaces. Raising ground costs 2 stone per operation and needs a workbench in range, and holding shift takes the target height from the ground under the cursor instead of the ground under the player.

Honey.d: Sweet and tasty. Food Health 8 Stamina 35 Regen 1 hp/tick Duration 15 min

HelmetAshlandsMediumHood.d: As the first man of Midgard, Ask knew it was important to not draw too much attention to himself. Hood of Ask is a helmet forged at the Black Forge from 15 Linen Thread , 4 Lox Pelt , 10 Asksvin Hide and one Flametal Protection Idol . It gives 28 armour, plus 2 per quality level to 34 at quality 4, on 1000 durability. The Breastplate of Ask and Trousers of Ask take the same four materials in the same amounts and give the same 28, so the set is 84 armour before upgrades and 102 at quality 4.

HelmetOdin.d: Oden's finest warriors deserve the finest cloth. Hood of Oden is a helmet unlocked by a Steam code that Iron Gate mailed to players who signed up for the Valheim beta, and there is no in-game way to earn one. Where the recipe is unlocked it is crafted at the Workbench from 10 Leather Scraps , 4 Coal and one Bronze Protection Idol . It gives 1 armour on 300 durability and reaches only 4 armour at quality 4, so it is worn for the look rather than the protection. It matches Cape of Oden , which came from the same code.

TankardAnniversary.d: One year since we arrived... Skål! Horn of Celebration is a one-handed drinking horn crafted at the Workbench from 2 Bronze , 2 Troll Hide and 2 Iron . It matches the Tankard exactly: 4 block power, 1 weight, a quality 1 cap and a drink emote in place of an attack. The iron in the recipe puts it two biomes further out than the plain tankard for no change in what it does. It was added to mark the first anniversary of Valheim's release.

FishingBaitAshlands.d: Some fish already like it where the waters are warm, and this bait brings the temperature close to boiling.

AtgeirHimminAfl.d: It might not be a hammer, but Thor himself would still approve of this weapon. Himminafl is a two-handed polearm forged at the Black Forge from 10 Yggdrasil Wood , 15 Refined Eitr , 5 Silver , 2 Mandible and one Black Marble Battle Idol . It deals 85 pierce and 40 lightning, blocks for 64 and has 250 durability; upgrades add 6 lightning a level, taking it to 58 lightning at quality 4 while the pierce stays at 85. The primary is a three-swing chain with double damage on the last hit at 20 stamina a swing and 3.2m of reach; the secondary sweeps a full circle for 40 stamina and staggers everythin

BowHuntsman.d: Finely worked and strung. A huntsman's joy. Huntsman Bow is a bow crafted at the forge from 10 Finewood , 20 Iron , 10 Feathers , 2 Deer Hide and one Iron Battle Idol . It deals 42 pierce, trains Bows, has 100 durability and costs 5% movement speed to carry. It upgrades to quality 4, adding 3 pierce a level to reach 51. Drawing and hitting with it makes only 4 metres of noise, less than any other bow, which matters when you are picking off one animal out of a group.

GemstoneBlue.d: Light is reflected sharply off of this gem, or does it come from within the stone itself? Iolite is a gemstone found in charred chests inside the Charred Fortresses of the Ashlands, and in one of the gemstone eyes in Morkhalla. Fitted to an Ashlands weapon it makes the Thunder version, adding 10 lightning damage and a 25% chance of chain lightning on the primary attack and 20% on the secondary. Bows are the exception, at 20% on the normal shot. A creature that never spawns in a normal world, Riktig Fuling , drops it along with Jade and Bloodstone .

Iron.d: A bar of pure iron ready to be worked. Iron is a bar smelted from Scrap Iron or Iron Ore in a Smelter, 30 seconds a bar. It weighs 12, stacks to 30 and cannot be carried through a portal. Finished bars also turn up in the pots of Ashlands charred ruins and behind the wooden gates of mountain caves. It is the backbone of mid-game gear: the Iron Mace takes 20 bars plus 10 per upgrade level, and the Porcupine another 20.

HoneyGlazedChicken.d: Grilled to perfection. Makes both eyes and mouths water. Honey Glazed Chicken is a cooked food baked in a stone oven from Uncooked Honey Glazed Chicken , which is assembled at a food preparation table. It gives 80 health, 26 stamina and 5 health regen over 30 minutes, weighs 1 and stacks to 10. Baking takes 50 seconds, and at 100 seconds in the oven it burns to Coal . Food Health 80 Stamina 26 Regen 5 hp/tick Duration 30 min

AtgeirIron.d: Blood-drinker, skull-cracker, death-bringer. Iron Atgeir is a two-handed polearm forged at the Forge from 10 Wood , 30 Iron , 2 Leather Scraps and one Iron Battle Idol . It deals 65 pierce, blocks for 28, trains Polearms and has 175 durability, gaining 6 pierce per upgrade level to reach 83 at quality 4. The primary is a three-swing chain with double damage on the last hit at 14 stamina a swing and 3.2m of reach; the secondary sweeps a full circle for 28 stamina and staggers everything it touches six times as hard as a normal hit. Wielding it costs 5% movement speed.

AxeIron.d: Sharp and strong, a woodcutter's friend. Iron Axe is a one-handed axe forged at the Forge from 4 Wood , 20 Iron , 2 Leather Scraps and one Silver Battle Idol . It deals 60 slash and 50 chop, blocks for 21, trains Axes and has 175 durability, gaining 5 slash and 3 chop a level to reach 75 slash at quality 4. It fells beech, fir, pine, birch, oak and ancient trees, the same list as the Bronze Axe but far quicker. The primary is a three-swing chain with double damage on the last hit at 10 stamina; the secondary is an overhead at 1.5x damage for 20 stamina.

HelmetMage_Ashlands.d: Even the first sorceress valued the mystique of covering one's face. It is rumoured that honouring her this way will make your spells even more powerful.

TrinketIronHealth.d: A delicate yet defensive accessory. Iron Brooch is the Swamp-tier health trinket, forged at the Forge from 5 Iron, 5 Ancient Bark and one Leech Trophy. Worn in the trinket slot it raises max adrenaline to 65; when the adrenaline bar fills, it fires and boosts health regeneration for a while (the stronger successor of Heart of the Forest). Weight 2, cannot be upgraded.

ShieldIronBuckler.d: Its lightness and curved center makes it excellent for deflecting attacks. Iron Buckler is a buckler crafted at the Forge from 10 Iron , 4 Ancient Bark and one Iron Protection Idol . It blocks for 28, weighs 4, holds 200 durability and upgrades to quality 3. Carrying it drawn costs 5% movement speed, the smallest penalty of any iron shield. Bucklers apply a larger bonus on a timed block than round or tower shields, so it staggers harder than its block power suggests while absorbing less on an untimed block.

ArmorIronLegs.d: Iron greaves to protect your legs.

HelmetIron.d: A helm of polished iron, fit for a hero.

MaceIron.d: A fist-sized lump of iron on a wooden shaft. Iron Mace is a one-handed club forged at the Forge from 4 Wood , 20 Iron , 3 Leather Scraps and one Iron Battle Idol . It deals 55 blunt, blocks for 21 and trains Clubs, and it is the last pure blunt club before the Ashlands. The primary attack is a three-swing chain with double damage on the last hit at 10 stamina a swing; the slower secondary comes down for 2.5 times damage and double stagger at 20. Wielding it costs 5% movement speed. It upgrades to quality 4 at 10 more iron a level, reaching 73 blunt at 200 durability.

IronOre.d: Unrefined iron. Needs to be refined in a smelter. Iron Ore is a material smelted into Iron at a Smelter with Coal for fuel. Its recorded sources are iron veins, meteorite and bog iron deposits, and a bonus catch while fishing for Giant Herring , but iron veins do not generate during normal world generation, which leaves fishing as the only supply most worlds ever see. The iron a base is actually built out of comes from Scrap Iron in the sunken crypts instead. It stacks to 30 at 10 weight each and cannot go through a portal, so one full stack is 300 weight to move by boat.

PickaxeIron.d: A sturdy tool of hardened iron. Iron Pickaxe is a two-handed pickaxe forged at the Forge from 3 Corewood , 20 Iron and one Iron Battle Idol . It deals 33 pierce and 33 pickaxe damage, has 150 durability and upgrades to quality 4, gaining 5 of each damage type per level. It adds Obsidian and Silver deposits to what the earlier pickaxes can mine. The vertical swing costs 10 stamina, and carrying it costs 5% movement speed.

Ironpit.d: An empty vessel waiting to be filled with firewood and kindling.

ArmorIronChest.d: An iron scale mail, this will turn all but the strongest of blows.

ShieldIronSquare.d: An iron sword-breaker, tile of the battle-wall. Iron Shield is a shield crafted at the Forge from 10 Finewood , 6 Iron and one Iron Protection Idol . It blocks for 35, weighs 4, holds 200 durability and upgrades to quality 3. Wielding it costs 20% movement speed, twice the penalty of the Iron Tower Shield for 17 less block power.

SledgeIron.d: A mighty hammer, worthy of a champion. Iron Sledge is a two-handed club crafted at the Forge from 10 Ancient Bark , 30 Iron , 4 Ymir Flesh , one Draugr Elite Trophy and one Iron Battle Idol . It deals 55 blunt, blocks for 28, trains Clubs and holds 100 durability over four quality levels, gaining 6 blunt per level. Its only attack is a ground slam costing 20 stamina that hits everything within four meters, staggering at double rate and knocking targets back. It hits for the same damage as the cheaper one-handed Iron Mace but spreads it over the whole area, and it costs 15% movement speed.

SwordIron.d: The straight line between life and death runs along the edge of this blade. Iron Sword is a one-handed sword forged at the Forge from 2 Wood , 20 Iron , 3 Leather Scraps and one Iron Battle Idol . It deals 55 slash, blocks for 21, trains Swords and has 200 durability, gaining 6 slash a level to reach 73 at quality 4. The primary is a three-swing chain with double damage on the last hit at 10 stamina a swing; the secondary is a lunging thrust for triple damage at 20. Every upgrade level costs another 10 iron, so a fully levelled blade runs to 50 iron, and it costs 5% movement speed to carry.

ShieldIronTower.d: A tall shield of strong iron. Iron Tower Shield is a tower shield crafted at the Forge from 15 Finewood , 10 Iron and one Iron Protection Idol . It blocks for 52, bashes for 10 damage, weighs 4, holds 200 durability and upgrades to quality 3. It costs 10% movement speed and 10% more stamina per dodge roll. Like every tower shield it cannot parry, so a timed block earns no bonus and its 52 block power is all it ever gets.

ArrowIron.d: Capped with iron and flighted with dark feathers.

VineGreenSeeds.d: These unassuming seeds can grow into vines that might overtake entire buildings.

GemstoneGreen.d: This gem pulses with energy, almost as if it were a living thing. Jade is a gemstone that converts an Ashlands weapon into its Nature version, adding 10 poison damage and a 20% chance on hit to immobilise the target for 10 seconds. It comes out of charred chests in the Charred Fortresses, and one Morkhalla gemstone eye holds it. Root Ripper is the result of fitting it to the Ripper . Fitting any gemstone drops the weapon back to quality 1, so upgrade it after the conversion, not before.

TrinketFlametalEitr.d: Ashlands tier Trinket Jörmundling Tormented screams resonate from within. Jörmundling is an Ashlands-tier trinket forged at the Black Forge from 5 Flametal , 5 Refined Eitr , one Bloodstone and one Fallen Valkyrie Trophy . It fires at 70 adrenaline, returning 100 eitr immediately and adding 20 Elemental Magic and 20 Blood Magic skill for 60 seconds. A cheap rapid staff such as the Staff of Frost builds adrenaline back faster than a high-skill caster can spend the 100 eitr, which is where the reputation for endless eitr comes from.

AxeJotunBane.d: Not even the giants of old could weather the poisonous bite of this weapon. Jotun Bane is a one-handed axe forged at the Black Forge from 5 Yggdrasil Wood , 15 Iron , 3 Bilebag , 10 Refined Eitr and one Black Metal Battle Idol . It deals 80 slash, 70 chop and 40 poison, blocks for 48 and has 250 durability, gaining 5 slash and 3 chop a level while the poison stays at 40. The 70 chop covers every tree including yggdrasil and scorched, so it doubles as the Mistlands woodcutting axe. The primary is a three-swing chain with double damage on the last hit at 16 stamina; the secondary is an overhead

MaceEldnerNature.d: If the force of your blow isn't enough to knock your enemies to the ground, perhaps the primal roots will hold them down for you. Klossen is a one-handed mace made at the Black Forge by setting one Jade into a Flametal Mace , with 8 Flametal and one Flametal Battle Idol . It deals 135 blunt and 10 poison, blocks for 57 and costs 5% movement speed, and the jade gives its hits a 20% chance to immobilize. Blunt rises 6 a level to 153 at quality 4 while the poison stays flat at 10, on 300 durability. The conversion resets quality, so a Flametal Mace that has already been upgraded loses those level

THSwordKrom.d: As deadly as it is shiny, and it's very shiny. Krom is a two-handed sword forged at the Black Forge from 30 Iron , 20 Bronze , 5 Scale Hide and one Black Marble Battle Idol , the earliest two-handed sword in the game. It deals 150 slash, blocks for 52, trains Swords and has 250 durability, gaining 6 slash a level to reach 168 at quality 4. The primary is a wide three-swing chain with double damage on the last hit at 20 stamina a swing and 2.6m of reach; the secondary is a slower thrust for triple damage at 40 stamina and 3m. Every upgrade level costs another 15 iron, 10 bronze and 5 scale hide

Larva.d: Food Health 35 Stamina 12 Regen 2 hp/tick Duration 20 min

LeatherScraps.d: A small pile of leather scraps. Leather Scraps are a material dropped by Boar , Bats and Frost Wisps , and found in Meadows and troll cave chests, in barrels, and in muddy scrap piles. They weigh 0.5, stack to 50 and can be carried through a portal. Early armour and a long list of weapons want them, among them 3 for the Iron Mace , 3 for the Bronze Mace and 4 for the Root Mask .

ArmorLeatherLegs.d: Black Forest tier Legs Leather Trousers They squeak a little when you walk.

ArmorLeatherChest.d: A tunic made from animal hide.

TrophyLeech.d: Although slimy, the skin is beautifully patterned in red and black.

MeadLightfoot.d: This bottle is full, yet it feels like it weighs almost nothing at all. Lightfoot Mead is a Mistlands-tier consumable fermented from Mead Base: Lightfoot , which is mixed at a mead ketill and yields six bottles after two in-game days in the fermenter. It cuts jump stamina cost by 30% and raises jump height by 20% for ten minutes, twice the run of Lingering Eitr Mead and long enough to cover a whole climb. The reduction applies to jumping only, not to running or climbing, which makes it a traversal item rather than a stamina mead.

LinenThread.d: A fine linen thread made out of a strong flax filament. Linen Thread is a material spun from Flax at a spinning wheel. It weighs 2, stacks to 50 and can be carried through a portal. Plains-tier gear and everything after it runs on the thread: the Porcupine takes 10, and the Black Metal Knife takes 5 plus another 5 per upgrade level.

MeadEitrLingering.d: Increases eitr regeneration. Lingering Eitr Mead is an Ashlands-tier consumable fermented from Mead Base: Lingering Eitr , which is mixed at a mead ketill and yields six bottles after two in-game days in the fermenter. Drinking one raises eitr regeneration by 25% for five minutes. While it runs, no eitr mead of any kind can be drunk, Minor Eitr Mead included, so the two cannot be stacked or chained back to back.

MeadHealthLingering.d: Increases health regeneration. Lingering Healing Mead is an Ashlands-tier consumable fermented from Mead Base: Lingering Health , which is brewed in a mead ketill. Two in-game days of fermenting yield six bottles, and they stack to 10. It raises health regeneration by 25% for five minutes, and while it is active no healing mead of any kind can be drunk.

MeadStaminaLingering.d: Increases stamina regeneration. Lingering Stamina Mead is a Mistlands-tier consumable fermented from Mead Base: Lingering Stamina , which is brewed in a mead ketill. Two in-game days of fermenting yield six bottles, and they stack to 10. It raises stamina regeneration by 25% for five minutes, and while it is active no stamina mead of any kind can be drunk. Spending stamina does not interrupt the effect; only death ends it early.

ArmorBerserkerLegs.d: It covers all the important bits, but not much else. Loincloth of the Bear is a leg armour piece crafted at the Workbench from 5 Bear Hide , 4 Blueberries and one Bronze Protection Idol , with none of the Bear Paw the chest piece calls for. It gives 7 armour and 2 per quality level, topping out at 13 with 1000 durability. It is one of the three pieces the Berserk bonus requires, alongside Patterns of the Bear and the Headdress of the Bear .

MeadTrollPheromones.d: An intense musk permeates the air around this bottle. Love Potion is a consumable sold by the Bog Witch in lots of five, with no recipe and no other source. Drinking one raises the Troll spawn rate from 5% to 25%, lifts the number that can be out at once from one to two, and increases the chance of starred trolls. Every troll spawned under the effect is on alert from the start, so none of them can be caught asleep.

CapeLox.d: A pelt from one of the great beasts, thick and warm. Lox Cape is a cape crafted at the workbench from 6 Lox Pelt , 2 Silver and one Black Metal Protection Idol . It gives 1 armour, rising by 1 a quality level to 4 at quality 4, and has 1200 durability. It halves frost damage, so it covers the mountains without spending a mead slot on frost resistance.

LoxMeat.d: A raw slab of marbled meat. Lox Meat is a raw food dropped by Lox and Lox Calves in the Plains. Raw it gives 20 health and 20 stamina over 10 minutes with 1 health regen, weighs 2 and stacks to 20. It cooks only on an iron cooking station, since a wooden one will not take it, and burns to Coal if left on. Cooked Lox Meat counts as a separate ingredient, so recipes calling for the raw slab will not accept it. Food Health 20 Stamina 20 Regen 1 hp/tick Duration 10 min

LoxPie.d: Break the crust to release a cloud of fragrant steam. Delicious! Lox Meat Pie is a baked food made in a stone oven from Unbaked Lox Pie , which is assembled at a food preparation table. It gives 75 health, 24 stamina and 4 health regen over 30 minutes, weighs 1 and stacks to 10. Baking takes 50 seconds, and at 100 seconds in the oven it burns to Coal . Food Health 75 Stamina 24 Regen 4 hp/tick Duration 30 min

LoxPelt.d: A heavy pelt of thick, musty fur. Lox Pelt is a material dropped by Lox in the Plains and pulled from the bedrolls in Morkhalla ruins. It weighs 1, stacks to 50 and can be carried through a portal. It goes into the Lox Cape , the Lox Saddle and furniture.

TrophyLox.d: A giant beast's head, thatched with thick fur.

MushroomMagecap.d: A mushroom commonly used in a sorcerer's diet. Food Health 25 Stamina 25 Eitr 25 Regen 1 hp/tick Duration 15 min

QueenDrop.d: Her majesty's will was hard and unrelenting, but this piece of carapace is perhaps even more so.

MeadHealthMajor.d: Restores health. Major Healing Mead is a Mistlands-tier consumable fermented from Mead Base: Major Healing , which is mixed at a mead ketill and yields six bottles after two in-game days in the fermenter. It restores 125 health over 10 seconds rather than all at once, so drinking it mid-fight rarely outruns incoming damage. Each drink starts a two-minute cooldown that blocks every healing mead, Minor and Medium Healing Mead included, so carrying the smaller sizes as a backup buys nothing.

MarinatedGreens.d: It's spicy, it's chewy, it's sweet… This mad dish tickles your tongue as well as your mind. Marinated Greens is an Ashlands-tier eitr food cooked in a level 6 Cauldron from 3 Sap , 2 Magecap , 2 Fiddlehead and 2 Smoke Puff . It gives 32 health, 16 stamina and 95 eitr for 30 minutes, with a health regeneration value of 4. It stacks to 10. Food Health 32 Stamina 16 Eitr 95 Regen 4 hp/tick Duration 30 min

TrophyCharredArcher.d: These legs could hold infinite power.

MashedMeat.d: Leftover meat can actually be pretty tasty if you just mash it right! Mashed Meat is an Ashlands-tier food cooked in a level 6 Cauldron from 1 Asksvin Tail , 1 Volture Meat and 1 Fiddlehead . It gives 100 health and 34 stamina for 25 minutes, with a health regeneration value of 6, and no eitr. It stacks to 10. Food Health 100 Stamina 34 Regen 6 hp/tick Duration 25 min

TankardOdin.d: Oden's finest warriors deserve the finest drinks. Mead Horn of Oden is a one-handed drinking horn crafted at the Workbench from 4 Finewood , one Deer Trophy and 2 Resin . Like the other horns it blocks for 4, weighs 1, caps at quality 1 and answers the attack button with a drink emote that empties a mead from your inventory. The recipe only unlocks for accounts that redeemed the Steam code Iron Gate mailed to people who signed up for the Valheim beta. Without that entitlement it can still be spawned in and set on an item stand, but not drunk from.

MeadStrength.d: What creature can carry more than a troll? Why, a viking with this drink of course! Mead of Troll Endurance is a Swamp-tier consumable fermented from Mead Base: Troll Endurance , six bottles from one base after two in-game days. Drinking one raises carry weight by 250 for five minutes. The base is mixed at the mead ketill from Trollfish , and the station only combines fish of identical quality, so a mixed-quality stack cannot go into one batch.

MeatPlatter.d: Battle fuel. Meat Platter is a cooked food that grants 80 health and 26 stamina for 30 minutes, with a health regeneration value of 5 and no eitr. Food Health 80 Stamina 26 Regen 5 hp/tick Duration 30 min

MechanicalSpring.d: A mysterious contraption built by the Dvergr. Used to build traps.

MeadHealthMedium.d: Restores health. Medium Healing Mead is a Swamp-tier consumable fermented from Mead Base: Medium Healing , which is brewed in a mead ketill. Two in-game days of fermenting yield six bottles, and they stack to 10. Drinking one restores 75 health over 10 seconds and puts all healing meads on a two-minute cooldown. Bottles are also found in Jotun's Chests in the Deep North.

MeadStaminaMedium.d: Restores stamina. Medium Stamina Mead is a Plains-tier consumable fermented from Mead Base: Medium Stamina , a base mixed at the mead ketill that yields six bottles after two in-game days. Drinking one restores 160 stamina over two seconds and starts a two minute cooldown that blocks every stamina mead, including Minor Stamina Mead . Jotun's Chests in Mörkhalla also hold it.

BeltStrength.d: Gives the wearer superhuman strength. Megingjord is a utility belt sold by the trader Haldor. Worn, it raises carry weight by 150 for as long as it stays equipped, and because it sits in the utility slot rather than an armour slot it can be worn with a full set. That slot is the catch: Wishbone and Wisplight use it too, so hauling, prospecting and seeing anything in the Mistlands are mutually exclusive. The belt weighs 2 and cannot be upgraded.

HelmetMidsummerCrown.d: Celebrate summer with a crown woven from flowers. Midsummer Crown is a helmet woven at the Workbench from 10 Dandelion and nothing else, and it cannot be upgraded past quality 1. It gives 1 armour and carries no resistance, no skill bonus and no set effect. The recipe only appears in the crafting list while the Midsummer event runs, so for most of the year it cannot be made at all.

MinceMeatSauce.d: Chunks of goodness in a thick gravy. Minced Meat Sauce is a Black Forest-tier food cooked in a level 1 Cauldron from 1 Boar Meat , 1 Neck Tail and 1 Carrot . It gives 40 health and 13 stamina for 25 minutes, with a health regeneration value of 3, and no eitr. It stacks to 10. Food Health 40 Stamina 13 Regen 3 hp/tick Duration 25 min

MeadEitrMinor.d: Restores eitr. Minor Eitr Mead is a Mistlands-tier consumable fermented from Mead Base: Minor Eitr , which is brewed in a mead ketill. Two in-game days of fermenting yield six bottles, and they stack to 10. Drinking one restores 125 eitr over 10 seconds and blocks any other eitr mead for two minutes. Bottles are also found in Jotun's Chests in the Deep North.

MeadHealthMinor.d: Restores health. Minor Healing Mead is a Black Forest-tier consumable brewed from one Mushroom , one Blueberries and one Dandelion . Two in-game days of fermenting turn Mead Base: Minor Healing into six bottles, and they stack to 10. Drinking one restores 50 health over 10 seconds and puts all healing meads on a two-minute cooldown. Bottles also turn up in Dvergr treasure chests in the Mistlands and in the pots of Ashlands charred ruins.

MeadStaminaMinor.d: Restores stamina. Minor Stamina Mead is a Black Forest-tier consumable brewed from one Yellow Mushroom , one Raspberries and one Honey . Two in-game days of fermenting turn Mead Base: Minor Stamina into six bottles, and they stack to 10. Drinking one restores 80 stamina over 2 seconds and puts all stamina meads on a two-minute cooldown. Bottles also turn up in Dvergr treasure chests in the Mistlands and in the pots of Ashlands charred ruins.

MisthareSupreme.d: One of life's Great Pleasures. Misthare Supreme is a cooked food that grants 85 health and 28 stamina for 25 minutes, with a health regeneration value of 5 and no eitr. Food Health 85 Stamina 28 Regen 5 hp/tick Duration 25 min

SwordMistwalker.d: The faint glow seems to slice through the mist. Mistwalker is a one-handed sword forged at the Black Forge from 3 Finewood , 15 Iron , 10 Refined Eitr , 3 Wisp and one Black Marble Battle Idol . It deals 75 slash and 40 frost, blocks for 48 and has 250 durability, and upgrades add 6 frost and 5 spirit a level while the slash stays at 75. The primary is a three-swing chain with double damage on the last hit at 16 stamina a swing; the secondary is a lunging thrust for triple damage at 32. TrophyDragonQueen.d: The head of a dragon, majestic even in the rigor of death. Offer it to the Sacrificial Stones.

MoltenCore.d: Potent energy swirls within, ready to be unleashed.

MorgenHeart.d: It's hard to believe it has ever beaten.

TrophyMorgen.d: The waking nightmare has met its end.

FishingBaitForest.d: Dead trolls in the forest often attract a fish or two, speed up the process with this bait!

SpiceMountains.d: Only the most seasoned herbalist can find the pepperwood tree and harvest its leaves and bark. After careful preparation it's ready to be added to food, and is sure to give it some warming heat.

ShocklateSmoothie.d: Wakes you up! Muckshake is a drink cooked at a level 2 Cauldron from one Ooze , 2 Raspberries and 2 Blueberries . It gives 16 health and 50 stamina for 20 minutes at a health regeneration rating of 1. Drinks take one of the three food slots like any solid meal, so this one buys stamina at the cost of a slot that could carry health. It stacks to 10 and weighs 1 each. Food Health 16 Stamina 50 Regen 1 hp/tick Duration 20 min

Mushroom.d: Bounty of the forest. Mushroom is a foraged consumable picked off the ground in the Meadows, Black Forest and Swamp, never in large numbers in one place. Raw it gives 15 health and 15 stamina over 15 minutes at 1 regeneration, so it is kept for recipes and for feeding tame Boar rather than eaten as a meal. No Cultivator will plant it, but a picked mushroom returns to the same spot after 240 minutes, and unlike raspberries or blueberries it comes back even if the ground it sat on has been levelled or dug out. Food Health 15 Stamina 15 Regen 1 hp/tick Duration 15 min

MushroomOmelette.d: A delicious omelette with an earthy aftertaste. Mushroom Omelette is a Mistlands-tier food cooked in a level 5 Cauldron from 3 Egg and 3 Jotun Puffs . It gives 85 stamina and 28 health for 25 minutes, with a health regeneration value of 3, and no eitr. It stacks to 10. Food Health 28 Stamina 85 Regen 3 hp/tick Duration 25 min

AxeHead2.d: What battles has this weapon borne witness to? You cannot see its past, only shape its future...

NeckTail.d: Inedible when raw, but proves to be quite a tasty snack if cooked. Neck Tail is a material dropped by Necks , the small lizards found on almost any shoreline. Raw it is inedible and carries no health, stamina or food timer, but cooking it on a cooking station produces Grilled Neck Tail , or Coal if it is left on the fire too long. Cauldron and mead ketill recipes that call for neck tail accept only the raw item, never the grilled one. It weighs 0.5 and stacks to 50.

TrophyNeck.d: The beady eyes and razor sharp teeth belie the ostensibly calm nature of this small lizard.

Needle.d: The pointy end of a Deathsquito. Needle is a material dropped by Deathsquitoes in the Plains, and found in chests in Fuling villages and Plains stone ruins. It weighs 0.5 and stacks to 50. It is the crafting material for Needle Arrows and the Porcupine .

Nidhögg is a one-handed sword forged at the Black Forge from 3 Charred Bone , 12 Flametal , 2 Asksvin Hide and one Flametal Battle Idol . It deals 135 slash, blocks for 57, trains Swords and has 300 durability, gaining 6 slash a level to reach 153 at quality 4. Obsidian.d: Dark volcanic glass. Obsidian is a material mined from black glass deposits on the higher slopes of the Mountain, and the deposits need an Iron Pickaxe or better to break. They shatter when struck and the shards roll downhill, so mining from below the deposit loses fewer of them. Chests in frost caves and abandoned log cabins also hold some. It weighs 2, stacks to 50 and, unlike ore and metal bars, passes through portals. Finding any at all unlocks the workbench tool shelf, Obsidian Arrows and Frost Arrows .

Onion.d: A crunchy and spicy taste. Onion is a crop grown from Onion Seeds , which are looted from chests in Mountain ruins such as shacks and towers. Unlike Carrot or Turnip it never grows wild, so every onion in a world descends from a planted seed. Raw it grants 13 health and 40 stamina for 15 minutes, with a health regeneration value of 1. 3 and stacks to 50, and it is the base of Onion Soup and an ingredient in Salad . Food Health 13 Stamina 40 Regen 1 hp/tick Duration 15 min
