ArmorPaddedCuirass.d: Finely wrought and strong enough to turn even the sharpest blades.

ArmorBerserkerChest.d: If these intricate designs can protect warriors from distant lands, they can surely protect you too. Patterns of the Bear is a chest armour piece crafted at the Workbench from 5 Bear Hide , 2 Bear Paw , 4 Blueberries and one Bronze Protection Idol . It gives 7 armour, 2 more per quality level to 13 at quality 4, on 1000 durability. With Loincloth of the Bear and the Headdress of the Bear it grants Berserk, which raises health regeneration by 30% and stamina regeneration by 15%.

FistBjornClaw.d: Made for tearing and rending. Paws of the Bear is the first craftable fist weapon, made at the Workbench from 2 Bear Hide , 2 Bear Paw , 4 Leather Scraps and one Bronze Battle Idol . It deals 25 slash, blocks for 5, trains Unarmed and has 300 durability, gaining 4 slash per quality level to quality 4. The primary attack is a two-hit chain at 6 stamina a swing with double damage on the second hit, and the secondary is a kick costing 20 stamina that adds knockback and staggers for 6x. Backstabs do 6x damage and the weapon carries no movement penalty.

PineCone.d: Plant it to grow a pine tree. Pine Cone is a seed dropped by felled pine trees. Planted with a Cultivator it grows into a pine over a few in-game days, and pines are the only source of Corewood . Saplings need clear space around them, and a cone planted too close to trees or buildings stays a sapling indefinitely with no warning that anything is wrong. It weighs 0.1 and stacks to 100.

ArmorDress4.d: A plain blue dress, worn over a red underdress.

ArmorTunic1.d: A plain blue tunic, brightly dyed.

ArmorDress1.d: A plain brown dress, worn over a blue underdress.

ArmorTunic4.d: A plain red tunic, brightly dyed.

ArmorDress7.d: A plain yellow dress, worn over a green underdress.

ArmorTunic7.d: A plain yellow tunic, brightly dyed.

FeastPlains.d: Food Health 55 Stamina 55 Regen 4 hp/tick Duration 50 min

HelmetPointyHat.d: This hat is sure to add a bit of magical flair to any outfit.

ArrowPoison.d: A bitter sting from afar. Poison Arrow is bow ammunition crafted 20 at a time at the Workbench from 8 Wood , 4 Obsidian , 2 Feathers and 2 Ooze . Each arrow lands 26 pierce on impact and applies 52 poison as damage over time, so most of the damage arrives after the hit and is wasted on anything that dies before the effect runs out. Chests in Swamp ruins hold them ready made, and they stack to 100.

MeadPoisonResist.d: Fortifies you against poison. Poison Resistance Mead is a Black Forest-tier consumable fermented from Mead Base: Poison Resistance , which is brewed in a mead ketill. Two in-game days of fermenting yield six bottles, and they stack to 10. It makes you very resistant to poison for 10 minutes, cutting both the tick damage and the duration of poison by 75%. Only poison applied while it is active is reduced, so drinking it after being poisoned does nothing for the poison already on you. Bottles are also found in Dvergr treasure chests in the Mistlands.

MaceNeedle.d: A deadly weapon, bristling with fiendish spikes. Porcupine is a one-handed club forged at the Forge from 5 Finewood , 20 Iron , 5 Needle , 10 Linen Thread and one Black Metal Battle Idol . It deals 50 blunt and 45 pierce, blocks for 39 and trains Clubs, and its 150 durability is the lowest of the clubs. The primary attack is a three-swing chain with double damage on the last hit at 14 stamina a swing; the slower secondary comes down for 2.5 times damage and double stagger at 28. Wielding it costs 5% movement speed. Only the pierce scales on upgrade, at 6 a level to 63 at quality 4, and the spl

PowderedDragonEgg.d: Dragon egg is a hard and difficult material to work with, yet here it has been ground to a fine, glittering dust...

AxeBerzerkrNature.d: Your most primal instincts take over, and the nature around you reaches out to aid you. Primal Berserkir Axes are the Jade version of the Berserkir Axes , made at the Black Forge from the base pair, 5 Flametal , 1 jade and one Flametal Battle Idol . They add 10 poison on top of the unchanged 140 slash and 80 chop, keep 57 block and 300 durability, and every hit has a 20% chance to immobilise the target. Upgrades add 5 slash and 3 chop a level but nothing to the poison. Converting the axes resets them to quality 1.

PiquantPie.d: It takes some time and effort to make this pie, but the taste is well worth it. Piquant Pie is an Ashlands-tier food baked in an oven from its uncooked form. It grants 105 health and 35 stamina for 30 minutes, with a health regeneration value of 6. Food Health 105 Stamina 35 Regen 6 hp/tick Duration 30 min

THSwordSlayerNature.d: The blade works in tandem with the primal forces of the world, seeking death and slaughter. Primal Slayer is a two-handed sword made at the Black Forge by fitting a Jade to a Slayer , alongside 15 Flametal and one Flametal Battle Idol . It deals 170 slash plus 10 poison, blocks for 64 and has 300 durability, and every hit carries a 20% chance of immobilising what it strikes. The primary is a three-swing chain with double damage on the last hit at 20 stamina a swing and 2.6m of reach; the secondary sweeps for triple damage at 40 stamina and 3m. The conversion resets the sword to quality 1, so f

ProustitePowder.d: This unstable powder packs great potential.

TrinketCarapaceEitr.d: If you listen carefully, you can hear the faint echoes of lost souls...

PungentPebbles.d: An earthy odour clings to these dried lumps. It's best to not think too hard about what they are.

QueenBee.d: The queen of the bees! Queen Bee is a material dropped by wild beehives, which generate in bear caves, ruined stone towers and abandoned houses. A world places those hives when it is created and never adds more, so the supply is finite at roughly a hundred queens per save. Each queen builds one beehive, which then produces Honey indefinitely. Queens stack to 20, so a world's entire supply amounts to about five stacks.

QueensJam.d: That classic tasty blend of raspberries and blueberries. Queen's Jam is a Black Forest-tier food cooked in a cauldron from 8 Raspberries and 6 Blueberries , four jars at a time. It grants 14 health and 40 stamina for 20 minutes, with a health regeneration value of 2. Food Health 14 Stamina 40 Regen 2 hp/tick Duration 20 min

TrophySkeletonPoison.d: A rank and rotten skull. You're not sure why you kept it...

Raspberry.d: Sweet and delicious. Raspberries are a Meadows food picked from bushes, which grow along the edges of open meadows rather than out in the middle. One grants 7 health and 20 stamina for 10 minutes, with a health regeneration value of 1. They weigh 0.1 and stack to 50. Their longer use is as an ingredient: 8 go into a batch of Queen's Jam , and they are also part of Medium Healing Mead . Food Health 7 Stamina 20 Regen 1 hp/tick Duration 10 min

FishRaw.d: A good catch. Raw Fish is a material made one for one at the food preparation table from any of the twelve catchable fish, Perch through Pufferfish , so the species stops mattering once it is filleted. Raw it gives 20 health and 20 stamina with 1 health regen for 10 minutes, and it feeds recipes such as Fish Soup , which takes 3 at a time. Like Deer Meat , it has to be cooked on a cooking station before another recipe will take it. Fish stranded out of the water can be picked up by hand, which costs no bait. Food Health 20 Stamina 20 Regen 1 hp/tick Duration 10 min

FishAnglerRaw.d: Material Raw Fish A good catch. Food Health 20 Stamina 20 Regen 1 hp/tick Duration 10 min

ArmorTunic6.d: A red tunic worn with beads and bronze jewelry. Sure to attract attention from other vikings.

ArmorTunic5.d: A red tunic, worn with a fashionable cape made from fine green wool.

Resin.d: Sticky tree resin which insulates well. If put to the flame it burns slow and steady. Resin is a material dropped by Greylings , Greydwarfs , Greydwarf Shamans and Kvastur , and it also has a chance to drop from most felled trees and to appear in Meadows chests. It weighs 0.3 and stacks to 50. It burns slow and steady, which makes it the fuel for Torches , sconces and standing braziers, and it is spent in quantity on workbench-tier building and crafting recipes.

TrinketScaleStaminaDamage.d: A razor-sharp ankle chain. Can it truly be comfortable? Resounding Shackle is a Mistlands-tier trinket forged at the Black Forge from 5 Refined Eitr , 5 Scale Hide , one Mandible and one Seeker Trophy . It fires at 75 adrenaline, returning 100 stamina immediately and adding 10% slash damage for 60 seconds. Slash covers swords, axes and knives, so a blunt or pierce build collects the stamina and none of the damage.

CrossbowRipper.d: Rips your foes apart, simple as that. Ripper is the second Black Forge crossbow, made from 10 Ashwood , 8 Flametal , 2 Morgen Sinew , 4 Bonemaw Tooth and one Flametal Battle Idol . It deals 220 pierce and 160 chop with 200 durability and 3 pierce per quality level to quality 4, and reloads in 3.5 seconds like the Arbalest . Gemstones convert it into the Wound Ripper , Storm Ripper or Root Ripper , and the conversion drops the weapon back to quality 1, so fit the gemstone before spending materials on upgrades. Wielding it costs 5% movement speed.

RoastedCrustPie.d: This dessert keeps you going all day long. Roasted Crust Pie is an Ashlands-tier food. The dough is prepared at a food preparation table as Uncooked Roasted Crust Pie , which a stone oven then bakes for 50 seconds; at 100 seconds it burns into Coal . The finished pie gives 34 health and 100 stamina for 30 minutes, with 4 health regeneration. Food Health 34 Stamina 100 Regen 4 hp/tick Duration 30 min

Root.d: An old root from an ancient tree stump. It feels both flexible and durable at the same time. Root is a material dropped by Abominations in the Swamp. It weighs 0.3 and stacks to 50. It is used to craft the root armour set: the Root Mask , Root Harnesk and Root Leggings .

BowAshlandsRoot.d: Like the twisting branch was made to seek the sun, this bow was made to seek the slaughter. Root Fang is a bow made at the Black Forge by fitting one Ash Fang with one Jade , 5 Flametal and one Flametal Battle Idol . It deals 82 pierce and 10 poison, trains Bows, has 300 durability and costs 5% movement speed to carry, gaining 4 pierce and 5 spirit a quality level to reach 94 pierce and 15 spirit at quality 4. Its arrows carry a 20% chance to immobilise what they hit. The conversion resets the bow to quality 1, so upgrade it after fitting the gemstone.

ArmorRootChest.d: Finely wrought and strong enough to turn even the sharpest blades. Root Harnesk is a chest armour piece crafted at the Workbench from 10 Root , 10 Ancient Bark , 2 Deer Hide and one Iron Protection Idol . It gives 8 armour, 2 more per quality level to 14 at quality 4, on 800 durability, and costs 2% movement speed. It also grants pierce resistance, which is what Draugr archers, Deathsquitos and Fuling archers deal, and it is worn with Root Leggings and the Root Mask .

ArmorRootLegs.d: A light armour oddly woven together by ancient roots and bark. Root Leggings are leg armour crafted at the Workbench from 10 Root , 10 Ancient Bark , 2 Deer Hide and one Iron Protection Idol . They give 8 armour and 800 durability, gaining 2 armour per upgrade level to reach 14 at quality 4. Each level costs another 2 root and 5 ancient bark. Wearing them costs 2% movement speed.

Eitr.d: This is the stuff of life, the poison that consumes itself. The Dvergr refine it to use in their esoteric designs. Refined Eitr is the magic material produced by the Eitr refinery, which processes Sap and Soft Tissue from the Mistlands. It stacks to 30 and weighs 5 a piece, and unlike the metals of the same tier it can be carried through a portal. Every staff and every piece of Eitr-weave armour, including the Eitr-weave Robe and Eitr-weave Hood , is built from it.

HelmetRoot.d: Your head fits perfectly inside this knot of roots and bark. Root Mask is a helmet crafted at the Workbench from 10 Root , 10 Ancient Bark , 4 Leather Scraps and one Iron Protection Idol . It gives 8 armour and 800 durability, upgrading to quality 4 for 14 armour at 2 more root and 5 more ancient bark a level. Worn with the Root Harnesk and Root Leggings it completes the set that resists pierce damage, and unlike those two pieces the mask costs no movement speed.

CrossbowRipperNature.d: If the bolt doesn't pin your foe in place, the roots surging up from the ground surely will. Root Ripper is a crossbow made at the Black Forge from a Ripper , 8 Flametal , one Jade and one Flametal Battle Idol . The Jade adds 10 poison on top of 220 pierce and 160 chop, and gives each hit a 20% chance to immobilise the target. It reloads in 3.5 seconds, costs 5% movement speed, gains 3 pierce a level and tops out at 200 durability, a third less than the Nord Crossbow holds. Fitting a gemstone resets the weapon to quality 1, so any upgrade levels on the base Ripper are lost.

RottenMeat.d: There are maggots crawling in the meat. It smells awful.

RoyalJelly.d: Jelly fit for kings and queens. Food Health 15 Stamina 15 Regen 1 hp/tick Duration 15 min

ArmorMageChest_Ashlands.d: Imbued with the power of the first sorceress, these robes will grant a boon to any who seeks to wield the ancient art of magic.

FeastOceans.d: Consumable Sailor's Bounty Food Health 45 Stamina 45 Regen 3 hp/tick Duration 50 min

Salad.d: Fresh, crisp leaves. Salad is a Mistlands-tier food cooked in a level 5 cauldron from 3 Jotun Puffs , 3 Onions and 3 Cloudberries , three servings at a time. It grants 26 health and 80 stamina for 25 minutes, with a health regeneration value of 3. Food Health 26 Stamina 80 Regen 3 hp/tick Duration 25 min

Sap.d: Sacred blood from the Great Tree. Sap is a Mistlands material drawn from the roots of Yggdrasil by a sap extractor, which is built from dvergr parts and left to fill over time. It weighs 0.2 and stacks to 50. An eitr refinery turns it into Refined Eitr , and it is an ingredient in several Mistlands consumables.

Sausages.d: Links of savory, smoked meat. Sausages are a Swamp-tier food cooked in a level 2 cauldron from 4 Entrails , 1 Boar Meat and 1 Thistle , four at a time. They grant 55 health and 18 stamina for 25 minutes, with a health regeneration value of 3. They also appear in dvergr treasure chests in the Mistlands. Each weighs 0.5 and they stack to 20. Food Health 55 Stamina 18 Regen 3 hp/tick Duration 25 min

ScorchingMedley.d: A varied diet is important, so why not try this vegetarian option? Scorching Medley is an Ashlands-tier food cooked in a level 6 cauldron from 3 Jotun Puffs , 3 Onions and 3 Fiddleheads , three servings at a time. It grants 32 health and 95 stamina for 25 minutes, with a health regeneration value of 4. Food Health 32 Stamina 95 Regen 4 hp/tick Duration 25 min

THSwordSlayerLightning.d: The lightning bound into this blade is erratic, ever searching for something to strike. Scourging Slayer is a two-handed sword made at the Black Forge by fitting an Iolite to a Slayer , alongside 15 Flametal and one Flametal Battle Idol . It deals 170 slash plus 10 lightning, blocks for 64, trains Swords and has 300 durability, and every hit carries a 25% chance of triggering chain lightning. The primary is a three-swing chain with double damage on the last hit at 20 stamina a swing and 2.6m of reach; the secondary sweeps for triple damage at 40 stamina and 3m. Only the slash scales on upgrade

BronzeScrap.d: It's old and oxidized but can be smelted and used again.

IronScrap.d: It's old and rusty but can be smelted and used again. Scrap Iron is a raw metal mined from muddy scrap piles and looted from chests in Sunken Crypts, which the Swamp Key from the Elder unlocks. It weighs 10, stacks to 30 and cannot be carried through a portal. A Smelter burning Coal turns each piece into one Iron . Oozers drop it at roughly 30%, and ancient swords and armour in the Mistlands can be mined for it later on.

ScytheHandle.d: A sturdy base for a tool.

SpiceOceans.d: The sour tang of sorrel, mixed with something the herbalist would rather not disclose, is well suitable for fish. Any fisherfolk worth their salt would do well to keep this blend near, in case of a good catch!

DvergrKey.d: An object used to break a Dverger seal.

DvergrKeyFragment.d: A fragment of a Dvergr sealbreaker.

SeekerAspic.d: A quivering jelly with a taste like gentle electricity. Seeker Aspic is a Mistlands-tier food cooked in a level 5 cauldron from 2 Seeker Meat , 2 Magecap and 2 Royal Jelly , two servings at a time. It grants 28 health, 14 stamina and 85 eitr for 30 minutes, with a health regeneration value of 3. Food Health 28 Stamina 14 Eitr 85 Regen 3 hp/tick Duration 30 min

BugMeat.d: When you crack open their shells, the meat within is tender and succulent. Seeker Meat is a raw meat dropped by Seekers and Seeker Soldiers in the Mistlands. Eaten raw it gives 35 health and 12 stamina over 20 minutes at 2 regeneration, which makes it usable as emergency food and not only as an ingredient. It cooks on an iron cooking station but not on the wooden one. Recipes at the food preparation table ask for the raw meat specifically, and Cooked Seeker Meat will not stand in for it. Food Health 35 Stamina 12 Regen 2 hp/tick Duration 20 min

TrophySeekerBrute.d: The head of a fallen champion.

TrophySeeker.d: Less delicate than they look. The leather of the wings catches the firelight as if remembering flight.

Scythe.d: The right tool makes the task at hand so much easier. Scythe is a two-handed farming tool forged at the Forge from one Scythe Handle , 6 Silver and one Wooden Battle Idol . Its horizontal sweep costs 5 stamina and harvests every ripe crop within 1.5 metres in one swing instead of one plant at a time. It carries no damage values and cannot be used as a weapon. It has 200 durability and upgrades to quality 3, at 5 more silver per level.

SerpentMeat.d: A slice of sea serpent. Smells fishy. Serpent Meat is a raw material dropped by Serpents , 6 to 7 per kill and on every kill. It cooks only on an iron cooking station, which produces Cooked Serpent Meat . Recipes such as Serpent Stew call for the cooked meat rather than the raw slice, which is the reverse of how most meat is used, so the iron station is a requirement rather than a convenience. Each slice weighs 10, making a single serpent's worth of meat one of the heavier hauls to carry off a fight.

SerpentScale.d: The shiny metal-like scale from a sea serpent. Serpent Scale is a material dropped by Serpents in the Ocean. Scales sink, so a serpent killed over deep water drops them to the seabed out of reach; the reliable method is to hook it with an Abyssal Harpoon and drag it into the shallows before finishing the fight. Each scale weighs 2 and they stack to 50. They craft the Serpent Scale Shield .

ShieldSerpentscale.d: A sturdy shield of overlapping scales. Serpent Scale Shield is a tower shield crafted at the Forge from 10 Finewood , 4 Iron , 8 Serpent Scale and one Silver Protection Idol . It blocks for 60, bashes for 10 blunt, weighs 5, holds 250 durability and upgrades to quality 3. Blocking with it also resists pierce damage, which no other shield does. It costs 10% movement speed and 10% more stamina per dodge roll, and like every tower shield it cannot parry.

SerpentStew.d: Smells of honey and serpent... Serpent Stew is a Swamp-tier food cooked in a level 2 cauldron from 1 Mushroom , 1 Cooked Serpent Meat and 2 Honey . It grants 80 health and 26 stamina for 30 minutes, with a health regeneration value of 4. Food Health 80 Stamina 26 Regen 4 hp/tick Duration 30 min

TrophySerpent.d: The scales have dulled but the eyes are still bright.

Feaster.d: Set the table with whatever food and drink you fancy, and impress your guests with a delicious feast. <color=yellow>Once a feast has been eaten of, it won't return any resources if dismantled.</color> Serving Tray is a tool crafted with no station at all, from 6 Deer Hide and one Wooden Battle Idol , and Kvastur sells one as well. Using it places food, mead or a feast on the ground or on top of a structure, where any player can eat straight off it, and feasts can be eaten no other way. The remove option picks a placed item back up, but a feast that has already been eaten from is de

SharpeningStone.d: A whetstone wheel ready to spin.

ShieldCore.d: A protective force within is ready to be unleashed.

Silver.d: A bar of pure silver ready to be worked. Silver is a metal bar smelted from Silver Ore in a smelter burning Coal , and it also drops straight from the ancient pots inside Ashlands charred ruins. It stacks to 30 and weighs 14 a bar, and it cannot be carried through a portal, so every bar travels by cart or boat. It is the base metal for silver weapons, silver armor and the spirit damage they carry.

ArrowSilver.d: A needle to calm restless spirits. Silver Arrow is bow ammunition crafted 20 at a time at the Forge from 8 Wood , 1 Silver and 2 Feathers . Each arrow deals 52 pierce and 20 spirit. Spirit only registers on undead, so against a troll or a fuling the pierce is the whole of it, and that pierce is the same 52 an Obsidian Arrow carries.

KnifeSilver.d: A savage piece of pain. Silver Knife is a one-handed knife forged at the Forge from 2 Wood , 10 Silver , 3 Leather Scraps , 2 Iron and one Silver Battle Idol . It deals 25 slash, 25 pierce and 12 spirit, blocks for 2, and trains Knives; the spirit damage is unique among the knives and is what the undead take badly. The primary attack is a three-hit chain at 10 stamina a swing; the secondary is a forward leap for triple damage at 30. Backstabs deal 6 times damage. It upgrades to quality 4 at 5 more silver a level, adding 1 slash and 1 pierce each time while the spirit damage stays at 12, with 2

SilverOre.d: Unrefined silver. Needs to be refined in a smelter. Silver Ore is a mining material cut from silver veins and silver deposits, which only generate in the Mountains above 120 metres and need an Iron Pickaxe or better to break. A smelter refines it into Silver . Most veins are buried: the Wishbone points to them directly, and hitting the ground with a Stagbreaker or Iron Sledge returns a "too hard" message when a vein sits inside the swing, which also makes trenching a reliable way to turn them up. Frozen ground digs no slower than any other, so the search is a matter of covering the ridge. The

ShieldSilver.d: A shield of radiant silver. Silver Shield is a round shield crafted at the Forge from 10 Finewood , 8 Silver and one Silver Protection Idol . It blocks for 60, bashes for 10 blunt, weighs 5, holds 200 durability and upgrades to quality 3. It costs 5% movement speed. It matches the Serpent Scale Shield on block power at half the movement penalty and can parry, which the scale shield cannot, but it gives up that shield's pierce resistance and 50 durability.

SwordSilver.d: Purest of metals, nothing unclean can abide its touch. Silver Sword is a one-handed sword forged at the Forge from 2 Wood , 40 Silver , 5 Iron , 3 Leather Scraps and one Silver Battle Idol . It deals 75 slash and 30 spirit, blocks for 30, weighs 1 and has 200 durability, gaining 6 slash and 5 spirit a level to reach 93 slash and 45 spirit at quality 4. Spirit damage only bites the undead, so against draugr, skeletons and wraiths it beats the Iron Sword outright while a living target feels only the slash. The primary is a three-swing chain with double damage on the last hit at 12 stamina a swin

HelmetHat10.d: A simple yet fashionable purple cap.

HelmetHat5.d: A simple yet fashionable red cap.

ArmorDress10.d: A simple dress for everyday wear.

ArmorTunic10.d: A simple tunic for everyday wear.

TrophySkeleton.d: The expressionless grin of this skull reminds you of the inevitability of death.

KnifeSkollAndHati.d: Stab once for those who've betrayed you, and twice for those you hate. Skoll and Hati is a two-handed knife forged at the Black Forge from 4 Finewood , 10 Iron , 10 Black Metal and one Black Metal Battle Idol . It deals 45 slash and 45 pierce and blocks for 24, far above the 2 a one-handed knife manages, though using both hands rules out a shield. The primary is a three-hit chain at 14 stamina a swing with no bonus on the final hit, the secondary is a leap for triple damage at 42 stamina, and backstabs multiply by 6. Damage rises only 1 per type per level, to 48 and 48 at quality 4 on 250 dura

BattleaxeSkullSplittur.d: Will find skulls to split even in the thickest of mists. Skull Splittur is a two-handed axe forged at the Black Forge from 30 Iron , 15 Yggdrasil Wood , 10 Refined Eitr and one Black Marble Battle Idol . It deals 130 slash and 70 chop, blocks for 64 and has 200 durability, gaining 6 slash and 2.5 chop a level to reach 148 slash at quality 4. The primary is a three-swing chain with double damage on the last hit, 1.5x stagger and no damage penalty across multiple targets, at 22 stamina; the faster secondary deals half damage with 4x stagger for 11 stamina. Wielding it costs 15% movement speed.

THSwordSlayer.d: This mighty blade thirsts for the blood of foes. Slayer is a two-handed sword forged at the Black Forge from 30 Flametal , 5 Asksvin Hide , 3 Morgen Sinew and one Flametal Battle Idol . It deals 170 slash, blocks for 64, trains Swords and has 300 durability, gaining 6 slash a level to reach 188 at quality 4. The primary is a three-swing chain with double damage on the last hit at 20 stamina a swing and 2.6m of reach; the secondary sweeps for triple damage at 40 stamina and 3m. Fitting a gemstone at the Black Forge turns it into Brutal Slayer , Scourging Slayer or Primal Slayer , and the conver

BombSmoke.d: Everyone knows you can't breathe in the smoke. Smoke Bomb is a thrown weapon crafted at the workbench from one Smoke Puff and one Asksvin Bladder , which yields ten at a time. It deals 5 blunt on impact for 8 stamina a throw and leaves a cloud that applies Smoked to any creature not immune to it, the thrower included, which breaks line of sight and drives enemies out of the area. It also puts out fires within 3 metres of the impact. Each bomb weighs 0.3 and they stack to 50.

MushroomSmokePuff.d: Hopefully it tastes better after cooking. Smoke Puff is a foraged Ashlands consumable, scattered over open ground and around rocks and ruins across the biome, and respawning four hours after it is picked. Raw it gives 15 health and 15 stamina over 15 minutes at 1 regeneration, the same as a Meadows Mushroom and nowhere near enough to eat in the biome it grows in. Its use is in the cauldron, where one goes into every Fiery Svinstew at 95 health and 25 minutes. Food Health 15 Stamina 15 Regen 1 hp/tick Duration 15 min

Softtissue.d: It still fizzes softly with ancient memories. Soft Tissue is a material mined from the petrified skull nodes standing throughout the Mistlands, which need a black metal pickaxe or better to break. Each node is 118 segments of 5 health, returning around 59 Soft Tissue if mined out, though skulls sitting in water or on steep ground often cannot be finished. It also drops from Dvergr Rogue and Dvergr Mage , from dvergr crates in Mistlands excavations, from the piles inside Ashlands morgen holes, and from Anglerfish . It stacks to 40, weighs 1 each and is refined into Refined Eitr .

SparklingShroomshake.d: Perhaps it's not the best flavour to start the day with, but it will give you the boost you need. Sparkling Shroomshake is a drink cooked at a level 6 Cauldron from 4 Sap , 2 Vineberry Cluster , 2 Smoke Puff and 2 Magecap . It gives 30 health, 15 stamina and 90 eitr for 25 minutes at a health regeneration rating of 4. The 90 eitr is the point; at 15 stamina it leaves running and melee to the other two food slots. It stacks to 10 and weighs 1 each. Food Health 30 Stamina 15 Eitr 90 Regen 4 hp/tick Duration 25 min

SpicyMarmalade.d: Sugary honey perfectly balanced with tangy fronds and tart berries. Spicy Marmalade is a food cooked at a level 5 Cauldron from 3 Vineberry Cluster , one Honey and one Fiddlehead . It gives 30 health, 90 stamina and no eitr for 25 minutes at a health regeneration rating of 4. It fills the stamina slot of an Ashlands loadout, leaving health and eitr to the other two dishes. It stacks to 10 and weighs 1 each. Food Health 30 Stamina 90 Regen 4 hp/tick Duration 25 min

SizzlingBerryBroth.d: This soup settles in your stomach with an almost tingly sensation. Sizzling Berry Broth is a food cooked at a level 5 Cauldron from 3 Sap , 2 Fiddlehead and 2 Vineberry Cluster . It gives 28 health, 14 stamina and 85 eitr for 25 minutes at a health regeneration rating of 4. The eitr is what it is for: it fills a caster's spell pool while leaving stamina to the other two food slots. It stacks to 10 and weighs 1 each. Food Health 28 Stamina 14 Eitr 85 Regen 4 hp/tick Duration 25 min

BowSpineSnap.d: Using this bow is backbreaking work but so worth it. Spinesnap is a bow crafted at the Black Forge from 10 Finewood , 40 Bone Fragments , 10 Refined Eitr and one Black Marble Battle Idol . It deals 72 pierce and 5 spirit, trains Bows, has 250 durability and costs 5% movement speed to carry. Each quality level adds 4 pierce and 5 spirit, so at quality 4 it fires for 84 pierce and 20 spirit, the spirit damage telling against the undead.

SpearSplitner.d: Split your enemies' hearts in two. Splitnir is a one-handed spear crafted at the Black Forge from 10 Ashwood , 6 Flametal , 2 Asksvin Hide , 3 Bonemaw Tooth and one Black Marble Battle Idol . It deals 135 pierce, blocks for 57, trains Spears and holds 300 durability over four quality levels, gaining 6 pierce per level. The primary attack is a thrust with 1.9 meters of reach at 16 stamina; the secondary throws the spear itself for 1.5x damage at 18 stamina and leaves it on the ground to be picked up. Feeding it a gemstone at the Black Forge converts it into Splitnir the Bleeding , Splitnir the

SpearSplitner_Blood.d: A small sacrifice must be made for every battle... Splitnir the Bleeding is a one-handed spear made at the Black Forge from one Splitnir , 6 Flametal , one Bloodstone and one Black Marble Battle Idol . It keeps the base 135 pierce, 57 block power, 300 durability and four quality levels, and adds 0.2% damage for every point of health the wielder is missing, counted in points rather than percent. Both the 16 stamina thrust and the 18 stamina 1.5x throw carry that bonus. The conversion always returns a quality 1 weapon no matter what the spear was upgraded to.

SpearSplitner_Nature.d: Nature's forces burst through the ground wherever this spear strikes. Splitnir the Primal is a one-handed spear made at the Black Forge from one Splitnir , 6 Flametal , one Jade and one Black Marble Battle Idol . It keeps the base 135 pierce, 57 block power, 300 durability and four quality levels, and adds 10 poison damage with a 20% chance to immobilize the target. Both the 16 stamina thrust and the 18 stamina 1.5x throw carry the poison. The conversion always returns a quality 1 weapon no matter what the spear was upgraded to.

StaffFireball.d: The sweltering heat of Muspelheim seems almost pathetic when compared to what this staff can do... Staff of Embers is a two-handed elemental staff crafted at the Galdr table from 20 Yggdrasil Wood , 4 Surtling Core , 16 Refined Eitr and one Black Marble Battle Idol . A cast costs 35 eitr and lobs a slow arcing fireball dealing 120 blunt on a direct hit and 120 fire in the explosion, which ignites and splashes non-player targets; the fire component rises 6 per quality level. It holds 200 durability, blocks for 48 and trains Elemental Magic, with damage and eitr cost both scaling on that skill.

StaffIceShards.d: A staff as cold as the three-year winter that will herald the end of times. Staff of Frost is a two-handed elemental staff crafted at the Galdr table from 20 Yggdrasil Wood , 4 Freeze Gland , 16 Refined Eitr and one Black Marble Battle Idol . It fires ice shards in a rapid stream for 30 frost each at 5 eitr a shard, gaining 2 frost per quality level. The shards are inaccurate, which cuts its effective range, but every hit slows the target, and wet enemies take extra frost damage. It holds 200 durability, blocks for 48, trains Elemental Magic and has no secondary attack.

StaffShield.d: For a slight blood offering it will protect the caster in a magical shell. Staff of Protection is a two-handed blood magic staff crafted at the Galdr table from 20 Yggdrasil Wood , 4 Blood Clot , 16 Refined Eitr and one Black Marble Battle Idol . A cast costs 60 eitr and up to 40% of the caster's current health, and wraps the caster plus nearby players and tamed creatures in a barrier. The barrier absorbs 200 damage at Blood Magic 0 and 5 more per skill level, reaching 700 at level 100, where the eitr and health costs both fall by a third. It holds 200 durability, blocks for 48 and upgrades to

StaffGreenRoots.d: Ancient natural forces lie curled and dormant within this staff, ready to be unleashed. Staff of the Wild is a two-handed elemental staff crafted at the Galdr table from 15 Ashwood , 10 Fiddlehead , 3 Celestial Feather , one Jade and one Flametal Battle Idol . A cast costs 55 eitr and raises thrashing roots that hold a spot and strike what comes near, dealing 20 blunt and 20 poison. Both damage types gain 20 per quality level, so a quality 4 staff hits for 80 blunt and 80 poison. It holds 200 durability, blocks for 48 and trains Elemental Magic, with damage and eitr cost both scaling on that s

SledgeStagbreaker.d: A weapon worthy of the Gods! If you get hit with this, you'll know it... Stagbreaker is a two-handed club crafted at a Workbench from 20 Corewood , 5 Deer Trophy , 2 Leather Scraps and one Wooden Battle Idol , with 10 Bone Fragments needed per upgrade level on top. It deals 20 blunt and 5 pierce, blocks for 4, trains Clubs and holds 100 durability over four quality levels, gaining 6 blunt per level. Its only attack is a ground slam costing 12 stamina that hits everything within four meters, and the shockwave ignores walls and floors, which is why it clears burial chambers from the wrong side o

FishingBaitSwamp.d: It might smell foul, but the fish drawn to this bait are used to so much worse.

FishingBaitPlains.d: You're not immune to deathsquito bites, and the fish here aren't immune to this snack!

AxeStone.d: A crude axe for tree-felling. Stone Axe is a one-handed axe built by hand from 5 Wood and 4 Stone with a Wooden Battle Idol , and it is the only axe that needs no crafting station. It deals 15 slash and 20 chop, blocks for 3, trains Axes and has 100 durability; each upgrade level costs 2 more stone and adds 5 slash and 3 chop. Its 20 chop reaches beech, fir and pine, which covers every tree in the Meadows. The primary is a three-swing chain with double damage on the last hit at 6 stamina; the secondary is an overhead at 1.5x damage for 12.

TrophySGolem.d: This crystalline rock formation would make for an impressive floor decoration.

PickaxeStone.d: A rock-breaker made of stone. Stone Pickaxe is a two-handed pickaxe crafted at the Workbench from 3 Wood and 10 Stone . It deals 15 pierce and 15 pickaxe damage, has 100 durability and trains Pickaxes. Its vertical swing costs 4 stamina, the cheapest of any pickaxe, and hits several targets for reduced damage per hit. It shares the tool tier of the Antler Pickaxe , so it breaks nothing the antler cannot, and it is likewise capped at quality 1. Carrying it costs 5% movement speed.

SpearSplitner_Lightning.d: Let the crack of thunder split the air. Splitnir the Storming is a one-handed spear made at the Black Forge from one Splitnir , 6 Flametal , one Iolite and one Black Marble Battle Idol . It keeps the base 135 pierce, 57 block power, 300 durability and four quality levels, and adds 10 lightning damage with a 25% chance to set off Chain Lightning on hit. Both the 16 stamina thrust and the 18 stamina 1.5x throw carry the lightning. The conversion always returns a quality 1 weapon no matter what the spear was upgraded to.

StaffClusterbomb.d: Only those with patience and focus will be able to harness the true power of this staff. Staff of Fracturing is a two-handed elemental staff crafted at the Galdr table from 15 Charred Bone , 5 Ashwood , 8 Proustite Powder and one Flametal Battle Idol . A cast costs 30 eitr and throws a shell that breaks into 12 bomblets, each dealing 12 blunt with a small knockback and 12 fire that can set the target alight; the fire component rises 6 per quality level. Those numbers are per bomblet, so landing the whole cluster on one body out-damages a single fireball, and each burn stacks its own damage ove

BowAshlandsStorm.d: Let your arrows fly as swift as the lightning strikes. Storm Fang is a bow made at the Black Forge by fitting one Ash Fang with one Iolite , 5 Flametal and one Flametal Battle Idol . It deals 82 pierce and 10 lightning, trains Bows, has 300 durability and costs 5% movement speed to carry, gaining 4 pierce and 5 spirit a quality level to reach 94 pierce and 15 spirit at quality 4. Its arrows carry a 20% chance of chain lightning, an effect no other iolite weapon has. The conversion resets the bow to quality 1, so upgrade it after fitting the gemstone.

CrossbowRipperLightning.d: The bolts will tear through your enemies like a particularly nasty gale. Storm Ripper is the Iolite form of the Ripper , made at the Black Forge from the base crossbow, 8 Flametal , one Iolite and one Flametal Battle Idol . It carries 220 pierce, 160 chop and 10 lightning, with 200 durability, 3 pierce per quality level and the same 3.5 second reload. Its hits have a 25% chance to set off chain lightning that arcs on to nearby enemies. Converting a Ripper resets it to quality 1.

MaceEldnerLightning.d: Particularly effective on cloudy mornings. Storm Star is a one-handed club made at the Black Forge by fitting an Iolite to a Flametal Mace , alongside 8 Flametal and one Flametal Battle Idol . It deals 135 blunt plus 10 lightning, blocks for 57 and holds 300 durability, and each hit has a 25% chance of triggering chain lightning. The primary attack is a three-swing chain with double damage on the last hit at 16 stamina a swing; the slower secondary comes down for 2.5 times damage and double stagger at 28. Wielding it costs 5% movement speed, and only the blunt scales on upgrade, at 6 a level t

HelmetStrawHat.d: The perfect way to avoid sunstroke. Straw Hat is a helmet sold by Hildir, and only after her brass chest has been recovered and returned to her. Worn with either the Harvest Tunic or the Harvest Dress it raises Farming by 25, and the tunic and dress are interchangeable for that bonus. It gives 1 armour on 800 durability and 2 more per upgrade level, reaching 7 at quality 4. The three upgrades cost 6, 12 and 18 Deer Hide and a Wooden Protection Idol .

MagicallyStuffedShroom.d: Bursting with magical flavour. Stuffed Mushroom is a Mistlands-tier eitr food. It is assembled at a food preparation table as Uncooked Stuffed Mushroom , then baked in a stone oven for 50 seconds; left in for 100 seconds it burns to Coal . It gives 25 health, 12 stamina and 75 eitr for 25 minutes, with a health regeneration value of 3. It stacks to 10. Food Health 25 Stamina 12 Eitr 75 Regen 3 hp/tick Duration 25 min

SurtlingCore.d: It throbs with inner heat. Surtling Core is a material dropped by Surtlings and taken from the stone stands inside Burial Chambers. Dvergr lanterns in Mistlands guard towers drop cores when broken, and Magmafish carry them as well. Each core weighs 5 and stacks to only 10, so a full stack is 50 weight. Smelters, charcoal kilns and portals all list cores in their build costs, which makes the Burial Chamber stands the gate on the whole bronze tier.

TrophySurtling.d: Wreathed in pale flame, it still smoulders like an ember.

FeastSwamps.d: Consumable Swamp Dweller's Delight Food Health 35 Stamina 35 Regen 3 hp/tick Duration 50 min

CryptKey.d: Partly covered in caked mud, it smells foetid. Swamp Key is a key item dropped by The Elder . It unlocks the sealed gates of Sunken Crypts in the Swamp and must be in your inventory the first time you open each crypt. The check happens once: an opened gate stays open to you afterwards, so the key can sit in a chest at home once the crypts you are farming are unlocked. 1, does not stack and has unlimited uses.

Tankard.d: Skål! Tankard is a one-handed drinking horn crafted at the Workbench from 5 Finewood and 2 Resin . Its primary input is not an attack: it plays a drink emote and consumes the first mead in your inventory. It blocks for 4, weighs 1 and has no upgrade levels. Mead can be drunk straight from the inventory without one, so the horn is for the toast rather than any mechanical benefit.

MeadTasty.d: The nectar of the Gods, divine mead. Tasty Mead is a Black Forest-tier consumable fermented from Mead Base: Tasty , six bottles from one base after two in-game days. It regenerates stamina for the duration and cuts health regeneration by 50%, which slows healing rather than draining health. The stamina regeneration stops the moment you do anything that spends stamina, such as attacking or sprinting, and unlike the stamina meads there is no cooldown, so a second bottle can go down as soon as the first effect ends. Dvergr barrels in the Winding Tunnels and the pots in Ashlands charred ruins also

TrophyTheElder.d: This severed head oozes power. Offer it to the Sacrificial Stones.

TrophySeekerQueen.d: She has seen enough. Offer it to the Sacrificial Stones.

Thistle.d: Beautiful but prickly. Thistle is a Black Forest and Swamp material picked from thistle plants, which grow in clusters of 1 to 5 and regrow 240 minutes after picking. The blue glow around the stem is what makes a patch findable, so it is far easier to gather after dark than in daylight. Most of a picked stack ends up in Sausages .

AxeBerzerkrLightning.d: Carnage spreads around you when you wield these axes, such that Thor himself would be proud. Thundering Berserkir Axes are the Iolite version of the Berserkir Axes , made at the Black Forge from the base pair, 5 Flametal , 1 iolite and one Flametal Battle Idol . They add 10 lightning on top of the unchanged 140 slash and 80 chop, keep 57 block and 300 durability, and every hit has a 25% chance to arc chain lightning. Upgrades add 5 slash and 3 chop a level but nothing to the lightning. Converting the axes resets them to quality 1.

Tin.d: A bar of pure tin ready to be worked. Tin is a metal bar smelted from Tin Ore , which sits as small shiny deposits along Black Forest shorelines and yields 2 to 4 ore a deposit to an antler pickaxe or better. It stacks to 30, weighs 8 a bar and cannot be carried through a portal, so it comes home by boat or cart. The bulk alloy recipe at the forge takes 5 tin with 10 Copper and returns five Bronze , the same ratio as the single-bar recipe in one craft instead of five. Ancient chests hold bars as loot.

TinOre.d: Unrefined tin. Needs to be refined in a smelter. Tin Ore is the unrefined form of Tin , mined with any pickaxe from the small shiny deposits along Black Forest shorelines and riverbanks. A smelter turns it into tin, and one tin with two Copper at a forge makes Bronze . Barrels in Black Forest ruins, a cauldron down in the Hole and gutted tuna also yield it. It stacks to 30, weighs 8 a piece and cannot be carried through a portal, so every load comes home by cart or boat.

MushroomBzerker.d: Some say you can eat everything you find in the forest. That is not the case with this mushroom. Toadstool is a consumable mushroom sold by the Bog Witch, and only once Moder is dead. It carries no health, stamina or duration values at all: eating one clears the active food slots the same way Bukeperries do, which is the only reason to carry it. It weighs 0.1 and stacks to 50.

MeadHasty.d: The squirrel must be quick on its feet as it runs up and down the trunk of the world tree. Although it no longer visits Valheim, there are still those who remember it... Tonic of Ratatosk is a Swamp-tier consumable fermented from Mead base: Ratatosk , which is mixed at a mead ketill and yields six bottles after two in-game days in the fermenter. It raises walking and running speed by 15%, but swimming speed by only 7.5%, so half the benefit carries into water. It is named for the squirrel that runs messages up and down the world tree.

Torch.d: Torch It brings light and warmth, drives back the darkness. Torch is a one-handed light source that counts as a club, made from one Wood and one Resin with no crafting station needed. It deals 4 blunt and 15 fire on a three-swing chain with double damage on the last hit at 4 stamina a swing, blocks for 3 and burns through 20 durability. It can be equipped in either hand, and while it is out it counts as a fire, so Necks , Greylings , Greydwarfs and untamed Boar keep their distance. Chests in Meadows huts, lumber camps, wood houses and stone ship settings hold spares.

TorchMist.d: It brings light and warmth, drives back the darkness.

YagluthDrop.d: The remains of Yagluth, a twisted spirit torn between this world and the next.

TrollHide.d: A thick and sturdy hide. This is why trolls are so hard to kill. Troll Hide is a material dropped by Trolls , the sleeping ones in troll caves included, and cut from Trollfish . It weighs 2, stacks to 20 and can be carried through a portal. It makes the troll hide armour set and cape, the light option at the Black Forest tier, which trades armour rating for a sneak bonus and no movement penalty.

CapeTrollHide.d: Trollskin is tough and supple. Troll Hide Cape is a cape crafted at the workbench from 10 Troll Hide , 10 Bone Fragments and one Bronze Protection Idol . It gives 1 armour, rising by 1 a quality level to 4 at quality 4, and has 500 durability. Its value is the set bonus: worn with the Troll Leather Hood , Troll Leather Tunic and Troll Leather Trousers , all four pieces together grant Sneaky.

HelmetTrollLeather.d: Trollskin is hard to work but makes exceptional armour. Troll Leather Hood is a helmet crafted at the Workbench from 5 Troll Hide , 3 Bone Fragments and one Bronze Protection Idol . It gives 6 armour and 500 durability, upgrading to quality 4 at 2 more troll hide and 1 more bone fragment a level for 12 armour. It carries no movement penalty. The sneak bonus only applies with Troll Leather Tunic and Troll Leather Trousers worn as well.

ArmorTrollLeatherLegs.d: Leggings of tough troll hide. Troll Leather Trousers is a leg armour piece crafted at the Workbench from 5 Troll Hide and one Bronze Protection Idol . It gives 6 armour, 2 more per quality level to 12 at quality 4, on 500 durability. The trousers carry no sneak bonus alone: the +15 Sneak needs the Troll Leather Tunic and Troll Leather Hood on as well, which is 5 Troll Hide per piece.

ArmorTrollLeatherChest.d: Trolls are hard to skin but their leather is tough and warm. Troll Leather Tunic is a chest armour piece crafted at the Workbench from 5 Troll Hide and one Bronze Protection Idol , with no other material involved. It gives 6 armour, 2 more per quality level to 12 at quality 4, on 500 durability. Worn with Troll Leather Trousers and the Troll Leather Hood it adds 15 to the Sneak skill.

TrophyFrostTroll.d: The leathery skin bears the faded tracery of ancient symbols.

TrophyForestTroll.d: Trophy Trophy Troll Trophy The leathery skin bears the faded tracery of ancient symbols.

Turnip.d: A dense vegetable, rich with nutrition. Turnip is a crop grown from Turnip Seeds , which come from one source only, the clusters of yellow flowers growing wild in the Swamp. It weighs 0.3, stacks to 50 and can be carried through a portal. Alone among the farmed crops it cannot be eaten raw, so every harvest goes through the Cauldron, most of it into Turnip Stew . The files also list it as a pickup on a Dvergr prop, so loose turnips turn up around Mistlands structures with nothing planted.

TurnipSeeds.d: Plant to grow a healthy turnip.

TurnipStew.d: Nutritious and restorative. Turnip Stew is a Swamp-tier food cooked at a level 2 Cauldron from one Boar Meat and 3 Turnip . It gives 18 health and 55 stamina for 25 minutes at a health regeneration value of 2. It weighs 1 and stacks to 10. The stamina is the point: 18 health is little for the tier, so it fills a slot next to a health dish rather than replacing one. Food Health 18 Stamina 55 Regen 2 hp/tick Duration 25 min

TrophyUlv.d: A rugged tail from a not so good boy.

UndeadBjornRibcage.d: A relic of savage strength, perfect for forging armour that bears the wild’s fury.

TrophyBjornUndead.d: These eyes are finally vacant for good.

StaffRedTroll.d: Summons a raging beast to cause death and destruction. Trollstav is a two-handed blood magic staff crafted at the Galdr table from 15 Charred Bone , one Troll Trophy , 3 Flametal , one Bloodstone and one Flametal Battle Idol . Casting it summons a troll to fight for you at 120 eitr and 60% of your current health, half again the health the Staff of Protection takes. The summon's strength scales on Blood Magic. It holds 300 durability, blocks for 48 and upgrades to quality 4.

ArmorBerserkerUndeadChest.d: Crafted from the shattered bones of a tormented bear. Vilebone Cage is a chest armour piece forged at the Forge from 4 Bear Hide , 3 Vile Ribcage , 4 Linen Thread and one Black Metal Protection Idol . It gives 18 armour, 2 more per quality level to 24 at quality 4, on 1000 durability, against the 7 of the living Patterns of the Bear . Its matching pieces are Vilebone Drapes and the Vilebone Visage .

ArmorAshlandsMediumlegs.d: The first man to roam Midgard preferred to tread lightly. Wearers of these trousers could learn a thing or two from him. Trousers of Ask is a leg armour piece forged at the Black Forge from 15 Linen Thread , 4 Lox Pelt , 10 Asksvin Hide and one Flametal Protection Idol , the same bill as the Breastplate of Ask . It gives 28 armour and 2 more per quality level, reaching 34 at quality 4 on 1000 durability. The two pieces together are 56 armour at no cost to movement, and the set bonus needs the Hood of Ask as well.

ArmorBerserkerUndeadLegs.d: Thick hides and bone fragments woven into a rugged skirt. Vilebone Drapes are leg armour forged at the Forge from 10 Bear Hide , one Vile Ribcage , 4 Linen Thread and one Black Metal Protection Idol . They give 18 armour and 1000 durability, gaining 2 armour per upgrade level to reach 24 at quality 4. Each level costs another 5 bear hides, 1 ribcage and 1 linen thread. They weigh 5 and carry no movement penalty.

ArmorMageLegs_Ashlands.d: Whether or not the first sorceress actually wore trousers exactly like these, we can never know.

FistBjornUndeadClaw.d: These claws will rend flesh and bone alike. Vilebone Maulclaws are fist weapons forged from 2 Bear Hide , 2 Vile Ribcage , 2 Black Metal , 4 Linen Thread and one Black Metal Battle Idol . They deal 60 pierce and 20 slash, block for 5 and have 300 durability, gaining 4 slash per quality level to quality 4. The primary attack is a two-hit chain with double damage on the second hit, and at 12 stamina a swing it costs twice what Paws of the Bear does. The kick costs 20 stamina, adds knockback and staggers for 6x, and backstabs do 6x damage.

HelmetBerserkerUndead.d: Trophy and one Black Metal Protection Idol . It gives 12 armour, plus 2 per quality level to 18 at quality 4, on 1000 durability. The Vilebone Cage already starts at 18, so the visage sits 6 armour behind the rest of the set until it is fully upgraded.

Vineberry.d: These juicy berries are both sour and sweet. Food Health 30 Stamina 30 Eitr 30 Regen 1 hp/tick Duration 15 min

VineberrySeeds.d: Looks like they could crumble at any moment. Vineberry Seeds are the planting stock for ashvine, harvested from the Vineberry Cluster that grows on the vines over the charred ruins of the Ashlands. Only 20% of harvests return seeds, and those that do give 1 to 4. They are sown on cultivated ground with the Cultivator and stack to 100.

VoltureEgg.d: Warm to the touch, and full of protein. Food Health 20 Stamina 60 Regen 1 hp/tick Duration 20 min

VoltureMeat.d: Given that this bird feasts on all kinds of things, you'd better cook its meat before you even think about eating it. Volture Meat is a raw food dropped by Voltures in the Ashlands. Eaten raw it gives 70 health and 24 stamina over 20 minutes at 6 health regen, high for uncooked meat. Only the iron cooking station will take it, the wooden one refuses it outright, and it burns to Coal if left on. Recipes that list the raw cut will not accept Cooked Volture Meat in its place. Food Health 70 Stamina 24 Regen 6 hp/tick Duration 20 min

TrophyVolture.d: It's like a vulture, but it thrives in volcanic climates.

TrophyCharredMage.d: A warm glow seems to almost emanate from within. Handle with care.

TrophyCharredMelee.d: Fractures line this skull, as if it has taken many hits over the years.

FeastMeadows.d: Meadow Boar Consumable Whole Roasted Meadow Boar Food Health 35 Stamina 35 Regen 2 hp/tick Duration 50 min

Wishbone.d: This ancient bone remembers the location of many forgotten things. Wishbone is a utility item dropped by Bonemass and the only thing in the game that locates buried objects. Worn, it throws off green particles and a ding from about 20 metres out, both quickening and rising in pitch as the distance closes; digging where it peaks uncovers muddy scrap in the Swamp, silver veins in the Mountains or buried treasure in the Meadows. A find stops registering once it has been mined or opened. It takes the single utility slot, so it cannot be worn alongside Megingjord or Wisplight .

Demister.d: A bound wisp to guide you through the thickest of mists. Wisplight is a utility item crafted at a Workbench from 1 Silver and 1 Wisp , and it has a single quality level. Clearing the Mistlands mist in a 10 metre radius around itself is its whole function. It occupies the accessory slot, so it can be worn with a full armour set but never alongside Megingjord or the Wishbone . The orb trails loosely behind the player, and a sharp change of direction can leave you standing in fog for a moment.

WitheredBone.d: A giant bone, knotted like old wood. Withered Bone is a material mined out of the muddy scrap piles in Sunken Crypts and looted from chests in Swamp graves and ruins. It weighs 1, stacks to 30 and can be carried through a portal. Ten of them are the offering that summons Bonemass at a Forsaken altar, and nothing else in the game asks for them.

CapeWolf.d: Wolves are natural survivors. This one was just unlucky. Now its pelt will warm you in the snow. Wolf Fur Cape is a cape crafted at the workbench from 6 Wolf Pelt , 4 Silver , one Wolf Trophy and one Silver Protection Idol . It gives 1 armour, rising by 1 a quality level to 4 at quality 4, and has 1000 durability. It resists frost, and since the materials all come from the mountains it is usually the first cape to replace a frost resistance mead.

ArmorWolfChest.d: A wolfskin jerkin, warm and wild-looking. It protects against the cold. Wolf Hide Chestpiece is a chest armour piece forged at the Forge from 20 Silver , 5 Wolf Pelt , one Chain and one Silver Protection Idol . It gives 20 armour, 2 more per quality level to 26 at quality 4, on 1000 durability, and costs 5% movement speed. It is worn with Wolf Hide Trousers and the Drake Helmet , which the silver tier uses in place of a matching hood. It is resistant to frost, so the chestpiece carries the cold protection while the matching trousers do not.

ArmorWolfLegs.d: Shaggy breeches of wolfskin. Wolf Hide Trousers is a leg armour piece forged at the Forge from 20 Silver , 5 Wolf Pelt , 4 Wolf Fang and one Silver Protection Idol , taking fangs where the chestpiece takes a Chain . It gives 20 armour, 2 more per quality level to 26 at quality 4, on 1000 durability. Worn with the Wolf Hide Chestpiece the pair is 40 armour and 10% off movement speed, and the two together cost 40 Silver.

WolfJerky.d: Chewy and full of flavor. Wolf Jerky is a Mountain-tier food cooked at the Cauldron from one Wolf Meat and one Honey . It gives 33 health and 33 stamina at a health regeneration value of 3, and runs 30 minutes, five longer than Wolf Skewer . It weighs 0.5 and stacks to 20, so a full stack is 10 weight, which is why it travels better than the stews. Food Health 33 Stamina 33 Regen 3 hp/tick Duration 30 min

WolfMeat.d: Wolf Meat is a raw food dropped by Wolves in the Mountains. Raw it returns 50 health but only 5 stamina over 25 minutes at 3 health regen, well below what the same meat is worth cooked or in a dish. Both Wolf Jerky and Wolf Skewer call for the uncooked cut, and Cooked Wolf Meat will not substitute in either. A plain cooking station handles it, with no iron station needed, and it burns to Coal if left on. Food Health 50 Stamina 5 Regen 3 hp/tick Duration 25 min

WolfPelt.d: A pelt of shaggy fur. Wolf Pelt is a material dropped by Wolves in the Mountain and pulled from the bedrolls in Morkhalla ruins. It weighs 1, stacks to 50 and can be carried through a portal. It makes the wolf armour set and the wolf fur cape, and it is the cape that carries frost resistance, the alternative to keeping mead brewed for the Mountain.

TrinketSilverDamage.d: Assume the sharp and furious mind of a wolf. Wolf Sight is a Mountain-tier trinket forged at the Forge from 5 Silver , 5 Wolf Fang and one Fenring Trophy . It fires at 55 adrenaline and gives 20 Bows skill, 20 Spears skill and 10% pierce damage for 30 seconds. Thirty seconds is short next to the 50 on Crystal Heart , the other Mountain trinket, so the window suits emptying a quiver rather than settling into a long fight.

WolfMeatSkewer.d: Dripping with taste. Wolf Skewer is a Mountain-tier food cooked at a level 3 Cauldron from one Wolf Meat , 2 Mushroom and one Onion . It gives 65 health and 21 stamina for 25 minutes at a health regeneration value of 3. It weighs 0.5 and stacks to 20. The onion comes from Plains farming while the wolf meat comes from the Mountain, so the recipe needs a foothold in both biomes before it can be cooked. Food Health 65 Stamina 21 Regen 3 hp/tick Duration 25 min

TrophyWolf.d: Frozen in death, the hair matted with blood and a silent howl lodged in its throat.

Wood.d: Good, strong wood to build with. Wood is the base building and crafting material, chopped from beech trees, beech and birch stumps and fallen logs, and picked up loose from the branches lying on the ground. Every kind of Greydwarf drops it on death, brutes and shamans included, and troll cave chests hold it. It weighs 2, stacks to 50 and can be carried through a portal. Beech gives wood while birch and oak give Finewood , and beech falls to a stone axe, which is why wood is available from the first minute in the Meadows.

ShieldWood.d: A simple wooden shield. Wood Shield is a round shield crafted at a Workbench from 10 Wood , 4 Resin , 4 Leather Scraps and one Wooden Protection Idol . It blocks for 6, weighs 4, holds 200 durability and upgrades to quality 3, and costs 5% movement speed. It blocks 4 less than the Wood Tower Shield and has far less block force, but it can parry.

ShieldWoodTower.d: A rough but heavy wooden shield. Wood Tower Shield is a tower shield crafted at a Workbench from 10 Wood , 6 Leather Scraps and one Wooden Protection Idol . It blocks for 10, bashes for 10 damage, weighs 4, holds 200 durability and upgrades to quality 3. It costs 10% movement speed and 10% more stamina per dodge roll. Like every tower shield it cannot parry, so it trades the Wood Shield 's timed block for 4 more block power and far more block force.

AtgeirWood.d: It might not hurt a lot, but it has reach! Wooden Atgeir is a training polearm crafted at the Workbench from 5 Wood , 3 Finewood , 2 Corewood and one Bronze Battle Idol , and it also turns up in chests in heath ruins and stone houses. It deals 1 pierce, blocks for 12 and has 175 durability, and even at quality 4 it only reaches 4 pierce. Both attacks cost 8 stamina, so the full three-swing chain and the 3m spin can be practised without draining the bar. Wielding it costs 5% movement speed.

AxeWood.d: If this axe could chop wood, wouldn't that be strange? Wooden Axe is a training axe crafted at the Workbench from 5 Wood , 3 Finewood , 2 Corewood and one Bronze Battle Idol , and it also turns up in chests at ship burial settings. It deals 1 slash and 1 chop, blocks for 12 and has 125 durability, reaching 4 of each at quality 4, so its chop is too low to fell anything. Both attacks cost 4 stamina, the cheapest of any axe, which is the point of sparring with it. It costs 5% movement speed.

BattleaxeWood.d: Intimidating, but not as intimidating as the real thing. Wooden Battleaxe is a training two-handed axe crafted at the Workbench from 5 Wood , 3 Finewood , 2 Corewood and one Bronze Battle Idol , and it also turns up in chests in abandoned log cabins. It deals 1 slash and 1 chop, blocks for 12 and has 200 durability, reaching 4 of each at quality 4. Both attacks cost 8 stamina, so the wide primary arc and the faster half-damage secondary can be drilled without a stamina bill. It still costs 15% movement speed, the same as every real battleaxe.

THSwordWood.d: Would you be careful with that, please? Wooden Greatsword is a training two-handed sword crafted at the Workbench from 5 Wood , 3 Finewood , 2 Corewood and one Bronze Battle Idol . It deals 1 slash, blocks for 12, weighs 4 and has 200 durability, gaining 1 slash a level to reach 4 at quality 4. Both attacks cost 8 stamina, with 2.6m of reach on the chain and 3m on the sweep, and it costs 5% movement speed rather than the heavier penalty a real two-hander carries. Dvergr treasure chests in the Mistlands also hold copies, the only container in the loot tables that hands one out ready made.

KnifeWood.d: Some people would say this knife is better for butter. Wooden Knife is a one-handed knife crafted at the Workbench from 5 Wood , 3 Finewood , 2 Corewood and one Wooden Battle Idol , and it also turns up in chests at stone ship settings. It deals 1 slash and 1 pierce, but it blocks for 12 against the 2 of every metal knife. Both attacks cost 4 stamina: the primary is a three-hit chain, the secondary a forward leap for triple damage, and backstabs deal 6 times damage. It upgrades to quality 4, adding 1 of each damage type a level, and holds 200 durability.

MaceWood.d: One has to wonder why someone made this instead of a simple club. Wooden Mace is a one-handed club crafted at the Workbench from 5 Wood , 3 Finewood , 2 Corewood and one Bronze Battle Idol , and it also turns up in chests in dungeon rooms and surface ruins. It deals 1 blunt, blocks for 12, trains Clubs and triples backstab damage. The primary attack is a three-swing chain with double damage on the last hit at 8 stamina a swing; the secondary deals 2.5x damage for 4. It upgrades to quality 4 and 200 durability, adding 1 blunt per level, so even fully upgraded it hits for 4.

TurretBoltWood.d: Sturdy wooden missiles that can provide a tough defense against foes.

SledgeWood.d: This should probably hurt more than it does. Wooden Sledge is a two-handed club crafted at a Workbench from 5 Wood , 3 Finewood , 2 Corewood and one Bronze Battle Idol , and it also turns up in chests in burial chambers and swamp ruins. It deals 1 blunt and gains 1 per quality level, so a fully upgraded one still only hits for 4. It blocks for 12, holds 100 durability and swings the standard sledge ground slam at 8 stamina, hitting everything within four meters. The damage makes it a practice and novelty weapon; it still costs 15% movement speed.

SpearWood.d: This is just as sharp as a real spear, if a real spear was made out of wood. Wooden Spear is a one-handed spear crafted at a Workbench from 5 Wood , 3 Finewood , 2 Corewood and one Bronze Battle Idol , and it also turns up in chests in Black Forest ruins and stone houses. It deals 1 pierce and gains 1 per quality level, so a fully upgraded one still only hits for 4. It blocks for 12, holds 100 durability, thrusts at 4 stamina and throws for 1.5x damage at the same cost. The damage makes it a practice weapon rather than a usable one.

SwordWood.d: Mostly harmless, unless you're very persistent. Wooden Sword is a training one-handed sword crafted at the Workbench from 5 Wood , 3 Finewood , 2 Corewood and one Bronze Battle Idol . It deals 1 slash, blocks for 12 and has 200 durability, gaining 1 slash a level to reach 4 at quality 4. Both attacks cost 4 stamina, the three-swing chain and the triple-damage thrust alike, so the timing can be drilled without a stamina bill. Each upgrade level asks for 10 Finewood, more than three times what the first craft costs, and the bronze idol puts the recipe behind the Black Forest anyway.

SpiceForests.d: Thyme and marjoram carefully harvested and dried, before being mixed together. This blend will turn even the most basic of ingredients into a delicious feast.

CrossbowRipperBlood.d: Ready to rend your enemies to pieces. Wound Ripper is the Bloodstone form of the Ripper , made at the Black Forge from the base crossbow, 8 Flametal , one Bloodstone and one Flametal Battle Idol . It keeps the Ripper's 220 pierce, 160 chop, 200 durability and 3.5 second reload, and adds 0.2% damage for every point of health you are missing, counted in points rather than percent, so a viking down 100 health hits 20% harder. Converting a Ripper resets it to quality 1.

TrophyWraith.d: The shed skin of a wraith, a flowing robe only visible by moonlight.

TrophyGoblinKing.d: The crownless head of a dead king. Offer it to the Sacrificial Stones.

ArmorDress9.d: A fancy yellow dress, with beads and silver fibula brooches. Excellent for a feast!

ArmorDress8.d: A yellow dress, with a purple shawl around the shoulders. Warm and stylish!

MushroomYellow.d: An energetic glowing mushroom. Yellow Mushroom is a consumable picked in Burial Chambers, Troll Caves and Sunken Crypts. It gives 10 health and 30 stamina over 10 minutes at 1 regeneration, twice the stamina of a surface Mushroom for a third less health. It is also the only thing in a dungeon that regenerates, returning to the same spot 240 minutes after it is picked. Tame Boar refuse it, so it is no use for taming and goes either into a mead base at the ketill or straight down raw. Food Health 10 Stamina 30 Regen 1 hp/tick Duration 10 min

ArmorTunic9.d: A yellow tunic worn with beads and silver jewelry. Sure to attract attention from other vikings.

ArmorTunic8.d: A yellow tunic, worn with a fashionable cape made from fine purple wool.

YggdrasilPorridge.d: Made with sap from the great tree. Even a mouthful imparts a warm glow to your whole body. Yggdrasil Porridge is a Mistlands-tier eitr food cooked at a level 5 Cauldron from 4 Sap , 3 Barley and 2 Royal Jelly . It gives 80 eitr along with 27 health and 13 stamina for 25 minutes at a health regeneration value of 3. It weighs 1 and stacks to 10. Sap is tapped from Yggdrasil roots in the Mistlands and barley is Plains farming, so the recipe needs both biomes producing before a mage can keep an eitr bar filled. Food Health 27 Stamina 13 Eitr 80 Regen 3 hp/tick Duration 25 min

YggdrasilWood.d: Godflesh, wood from the Great Tree. Yggdrasil Wood is a material cut from the giant Yggdrasil shoots that grow through the Mistlands, either by felling a standing shoot or by chopping up the half logs one leaves behind. It weighs 2, stacks to 50 and can be carried through a portal. The shoots need a black metal axe or better, which puts the material behind Plains-tier tools even though it only grows in the Mistlands. Broken shoot props inside ruined Dvergr guard towers drop it as well.

YmirRemains.d: The earthy remains of the giant Ymir.

TrophyGoblinBruteBrosShaman.d: In the choice of 'ride or die', he picked the latter.
